articleTitle: Black-start strategy of the HVDC system based on series-connected hybrid converter for offshore wind farms
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The offshore wind power has been developed rapidly in recent years. The series diode-rectifier-based hybrid HVDC (SDRH-HVDC) consists of a DR and an auxiliary MMC, which are series-connected at the DC side. The SDRH-HVDC has been a promising solution for transmitting offshore wind power for its low cost and small footprint. But there has been no detail and feasible control strategy about its black-start to the present. In this paper, a black-start control strategy that utilizes the low voltage ride through (LVRT) capability of wind converter is proposed to achieve a smooth power transition from auxiliary MMC to DR and prevention of the inrush current of transformer at the moment of switch closing as well as the active power balance between wind farm, auxiliary MMC and DR. Simulation results in MATLAB/SIMULINK verify the effectiveness of proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Control of series-connected diode rectifier and MMC for three-wire-bipolar-structure based HVDC
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the increased penetration of renewable sources and the increased load demand, how to upgrade the power transfer capacity draws lots of attention. Converting the existing AC transmission lines to DC is one of the most attractive solutions. This paper proposes a three-wire-bipolar-structure based high-voltage-direct-current (TWBS-HVDC) for wind power transmission, where the rectifier station consists of 12-pulse diode rectifier and a modular multilevel converter MMC (DRMMC) which are connected in series at the DC-side. Such a system has the ability to increase the power transmission capability and more importantly, reduce the investment during the transmission solution conversion. A control strategy is also proposed, especially for the DR-MMC, to enable the reliable operation of the TWBS-HVDC for wind power transmission. With the control strategy, the wind-farm-side AC voltage and frequency are well manipulated and the DC voltage sharing between the DR and MMC is well control. In addition, the mode switch from HVDC to HVAC is also investigated. Simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed hybrid DR-MMC based TWBSHVDC system.

articleTitle: Study on the optimal capacity allocation of converter stations for flexible DC interconnection systems in multi-distribution areas
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The flexible management of flexible loads in direct current (DC) distribution systems can improve energy management effectively, reduce system investment and construction costs and increase the penetration of new energy. In this paper, a method to optimise the capacity allocation of converter stations in the DC distribution system is proposed, and the flexible load scheduling strategy of the system is considered. A two-layer multi-objective optimisation model is established with the objectives of lowest system investment and construction cost, maximum revenue and highest new energy penetration rate. Converter station capacity constraint, energy storage charging and discharging constraint and converter power constraint are taken into account as constrain condition. Taking actual scenario as an example, optimisation model is established and solved by particle swarm optimization algorithms (PSO). The results show that the strategy proposed in this paper can achieve flexible and effective management of the flexible load, and the converter station capacity obtained by optimisation has a certain degree of economy.

articleTitle: Internal dynamic simulation analysis of new DC load switch arc chamber
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The DC load switch which relies on the rapid increase of arc voltage to realize natural commutation is actively promoted in the flexible DC distribution network. When it is disconnected, there will be an arc in the gas arc chamber. The arc voltage directly determines the speed and success or failure of commutation. It is proposed to apply the gas arc chamber with metal grid to the main flow branch of natural commutation DC load switch. Based on magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), the arc model of gas arc chamber with metal grid is established by finite element method, and the segmentation of arc by metal grid is realized by assuming the plasma sheath, Then the calculation of the rapid rise process of arc voltage is realized. Through the temperature field distribution and arc voltage variation curve in the arc chamber, the process of helium arc moving along the arc channel and being cut by metal grid under the action of magnetic field is analysed, and then the feasibility of rapidly increasing the arc voltage by using this scheme is revealed. The research results provide some theoretical guidance for the design of natural commutation direct current load switch.

articleTitle: L/HVRT scheme of offshore permanent magnet synchronous wind turbine
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: A low/high voltage fault ride through technology scheme of offshore permanent magnet synchronous wind turbine generator (PMSG) is proposed. When the offshore PMSG operates during low/high voltage faults, the reason for the unbalanced power generation between the generator side and the grid side is analyzed, and the jump mechanism of the DC bus voltage is explored. The chopper circuit is connected in parallel with the DC bus capacitor to dissipate the unbalanced power through the unloading resistance, stabilize the DC capacitor voltage and reduce its fluctuation. According to the low/high voltage ride-through technical standards of China, the inverter station control scheme for offshore PMSG is designed, and the reactive power compensation strategy is proposed. the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Current-controlled offshore wind turbines connected with DRU-HVDC
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the fast development of the offshore wind farms, how to reduce the transmission cost draws increasing attention. Diode-rectifier-unit based HVDC (DRU-HVDC) is a potential way to address this issue. For such a system, the control of the line-side-converter of wind turbines plays a key role on its reliable operation. This paper proposes a novel current-controlled solution for the offshore wind turbine converters, which consists of an inner current control loop, phase-locked loop, active/reactive power loop and frequency control. Comparing with the historically-reported voltage-controlled turbines, the proposed control eliminates the dq voltage control loops, providing the advantages of less parameter tuning. Simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed current-controlled offshore wind turbines connected with DRU-HVDC during the start-up, string outage and reactive power compensation outage.

articleTitle: Research on subsynchronous oscillation risk of new energy power generation in AC/DC hybrid system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: When wind power is in an AC/DC hybrid power system, it may cause subsynchronous oscillation, especially when the AC power grid of HVDC sending-end is weak, which leads to subsynchronous oscillations of thermal power units in the area. The monitoring results in the past projects show that when subsynchronous oscillation occur in new energy power generation (NEPG), a certain amplitude of subsynchronous frequency current components are injected into the power grid. According to the planning and construction of the National West-to-East Power Transmission Project, a large amount of thermal power will be built in the Yanmenguan-Huinan HVDC sending end area as a support, and the region has abundant NEPG as well. This paper studies the subsynchronous oscillation risk of Yanhuai HVDC and NEPG near the sending end to the thermal power units in the area. The influence of different factors on the risk is analysed. The research results show that the risk of synchronous oscillations is greater when the nearby thermal power units and NEPG have fewer operating units, and the sub-synchronous current generating stations are closer.

articleTitle: A multiplexing alternate arm multilevel converter with high submodule utilization
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The miniaturization requirement of the modular multilevel converter (MMC) has drawn great attention in the applications, e.g. distant offshore wind power integration system and flexible grid interconnection. Based on the alternate arm multilevel converter (AAMC), this paper proposes a multiplexing AAMC (M-AAMC) topology, which can reduce the number of submodules (SMs) significantly. The stacks of SMs in the middle arms of the proposed AAMC are drawn out to operate at time-division multiplexing modes by controlling the states of the additional arm selection switches. In this way, the M-AAMC can achieve the compact design of MMC with a 75% submodules (SMs) reduction. And the phase-shift switching (PSS) scheme is applied to the multiplexing conduction modes for energy balance of the proposed converter stacks, which permits the M-AAMC to operate at wide-range AC voltage magnitude variations. Finally, the simulation results within the MATLAB/Simulink have verified the feasibility of the proposed M-AAMC topology.

articleTitle: An open-source platform for modelling, simulation, and performance analysis of multi-converter, mixed-generation power systems
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Existing power system modelling and simulation tools are chiefly developed for analysing conventional grids that operate close to nominal frequency during disturbances; as such they are inadequately suited to analyse modern renewable generation sources, which may transiently operate in off-nominal frequencies and over much broader timescales. This warrants development of improved analytical tools for emerging converter-dominated systems. Existing simulation platforms, such as electromagnetic transient (EMT) and transient stability (TS) simulators, provide accuracy and computational efficiency, but are also limited in terms of analytical tools required for drawing broader general conclusions. This paper presents a systematic method to develop and expand positive-sequence, average-value analytical models of converter-based generation systems. The paper develops a new open-source platform for converter-dominated grids, which enables additional analyses including small-signal stability assessment, state trajectory analysis, and controller optimization. Using the proposed method, performance and stability matrices can be readily obtained to assess multi-converter, multi-machine systems. Due to its implementation in decoupled phasor domain, the developed method provides faster performance than existing time-domain simulators, whilst retaining its accuracy in off-nominal frequencies. The developed platform and its capabilities are exemplified using an IEEE benchmark system.

articleTitle: Latent fault identification method of circuit breaker operating mechanism based on acoustic signals
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The information collection and fault diagnosis of the mechanical state is the basis for improving the safe and reliable operation of the high-voltage circuit breaker (HVCB). Based on the LW30-252 SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> HVCB, the fault simulation platform is built in this paper. It simulates five typical latent faults, including gear pin wear, anchor bolt loosening, closing spring fatigue, oil buffer leakage, spindle stuck. And a fault diagnosis method based on mixed cepstral coefficient convolutional neural network (MCCCNN) is proposed. Taking the sound of the circuit breaker as the detection signal, the Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC), Gammatone filter cepstral coefficients (GFCC) and power-normalized cepstral coefficients (PNCC) of the acoustic signal are combined into mixed cepstral coefficients (MCC), and then input into the convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify the fault. And it is verified on the measured HVCB latent fault acoustic data set. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively realize the five latent mechanical fault diagnosis of HVCB.

articleTitle: Offshore-DC-breaker less MTDC for wind power transmission with diode rectifier
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Diode rectifier based HVDC (DR-HVDC), which uses the diode rectifier at the offshore and the modular multilevel converter at the onshore, is now considered as a potential solution to reduce the cost of the offshore power transmission system. When the DR-HVDC is used in an offshore multi-terminal HVDC (MTDC) system, it is crucial to ensure that the offshore wind farms are able to continue operation after a DC fault. Although DC breaker can be installed offshore to isolate such a DC fault, it increases the cost of the system dramatically. Therefore, this paper investigates the operation of diode rectifier based offshore MTDC without using the offshore DC breaker. A strategy, which inserts a few additional submodules in the DR, is proposed to fast decrease the DC fault current which feeds from the offshore wind farms to the fault point. With the proposed strategy, the DC switch, instead of the DC breaker, is able to isolate the DC fault. Meanwhile, a fault-ride-through method of the diode-rectifier connected offshore wind turbines is proposed in the paper to ensure the continuous operation after the fault and enable its rapid recovery. Simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Impedance-based sub-synchronous torsional stability analysis in a HVDC system connected to multiple thermal power plants
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Multiple large thermal power plants with different torsional frequencies can be successively built around the HVDC converter station, where complex torsional interactions may exist among the shafts of multiple power plants or between the power plants and HVDC system. For the torsional stability analysis of single power plant with single shaft considered, the commonly used complex torque coefficient method has been proven to be effective, but can hardly be applied to the multi-machine scenarios with multiple shafts concerned. Focusing on the sub-synchronous torsional stability of the multiple shafts of thermal power plants, this paper presents an impedance model of the thermal power plant to equivalently characterize the internal mechanical shaft characteristic to the external electrical characteristic in the sub-/super-synchronous frequency range. With the proposed model, the torsional oscillations among multiple power plant shafts and HVDC system can be conveniently been analyzed from the pure equivalent circuit perspective. Its effectiveness is evaluated for the practical Lu-Gao-Zhao HVDC system in PSCAD/EMTDC. In addition, the method introduced in this paper can also been applied to the uniform analysis of the multitype sub-synchronous oscillations in the power systems containing large amount of thermal power plants and different power electronic devices.

articleTitle: Research on prediction method of harmonic impact of large-scale new energy integration on HVDC converter station
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The new energy system is mainly composed of power electronic equipment, Although the inverter is generally equipped with filters, considering the AC system harmonic impedance, the new energy still has the problem of excessive harmonics. At the same time, with the access of large-scale distributed new energy sources, the aggregation effect of harmonics will have an impact on the power quality of nearby AC systems and HVDC converter Station. In this paper, the research on the harmonic characteristics of new energy is carried out, and the mechanism and evaluation method of new energy harmonic generation are analyzed. The method for evaluating the influence of harmonics based on transfer impedance is proposed. Multi-harmonic source phase superposition method based on probability statistics is proposed. The evaluation method proposed in this paper provides an effective means for evaluating the impact of new energy access, which is conducive to predicting the impact of new energy access on the harmonic characteristics of converter stations, and taking control measures in advance.

articleTitle: A multi-port DC circuit breaker with fault-current limiting capability
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The DC circuit breaker (DCCB) is the key equipment to realize the fast interruption of fault currents for VSC-based DC grids. At present, the hybrid DCCB characterized by low loss and fast breaking is widely considered as one of the important development directions in the future. However, the hybrid DCCB requires a large number of cascaded power electronic modules in the transfer branch to withstand the electrical stress in the breaking process, which not only directly leads to high development cost, but also seriously restricts its large-scale applications. In order to adapt to the protection requirements proposed by VSC-based DC grids and reduce the construction cost, based on the study of operation principles of fault-current limiters and the traditional two-port hybrid DCCBs, a multi-port DCCB with the fault current limitation capability is proposed in this paper, which not only improves the fault current limitation performance, but also reduces the energy dissipation stress of the metal oxide varistors, and moreover ensures the continuous and reliable operation of VSC-based DC grids to the greatest extent. Finally, the performance of the pro-posed multi-port DCCB with fault-current limiting capability is verified in PSCAD/EMTDC, which shows that the proposed multi-port DCCB has significant effectiveness and adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on the standardization of lightning arresters layout at AC side of ±800kV UHVDC converter station
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: UHVDC converter station is the key position of UHVDC power system. Once lightning damage accident occurs, it may cause large-area power outage and have a very serious consequence. Therefore, UHVDC converter station requires reliable lightning protection measures. At present, the electrical distance between AC side arrester and protected equipment in UHVDC converter station has not been standardized. This paper will give the critical value of safe electrical distance between AC side arrester and protected equipment by simulation calculation. Firstly, the lightning intruding wave overvoltage level on the equipment on the AC side of UHVDC converter station under typical operation mode will be given by simulation. Secondly, the critical value of safety distance between AC side arrester and protected equipment of converter station will be studied and determined. Thirdly, for the condition that the distance between the AC side arrester and the protected equipment of UHVDC converter station exceeds the critical value of safety distance, the strengthening measures of lightning protection of UHVDC converter station are proposed. The research results will provide data support for the standardized layout of lightning arresters in UHVDC converter stations.

articleTitle: Current predictive control of Quasi-Z source three-phase four-leg direct matrix converter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of voltage transfer ratio of three-phase four-leg direct matrix converter, a new topology of Quasi-Z source three-phase four-leg direct matrix converter with high voltage transfer ratio is proposed, and then a current predictive control method is proposed to improve the control strategy of this new topology. The three-phase four-leg direct matrix converter and Quasi-Z source are organically combined to solve the problem of voltage transfer ratio; Using the concept of “virtual DC link”, it is equivalent to the virtual connection between rectifier stage and inverter stage. Space vector modulation is used for virtual rectifier stage and current predictive control is used for virtual inverter stage. In the strategy of controlling the virtual inverter stage, the current predictive control is used to replace the original three-dimensional space vector modulation, which significantly reduces the complexity of the control strategy. Simulation results show that the new topology proposed in this paper can better solve the problem of voltage transfer ratio; The control strategy makes the output current close to the reference sinusoidal current, and its waveform shows good sinusoidal, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed new topology and new control strategy.

articleTitle: Comparison of heat resistance of silicone products used for encapsulant in power modules
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Power devices are developing towards high power density and miniaturization, which proposes requirements for the heat resistance of encapsulation materials. In this paper, six kinds of silicone products widely used as the encapsulant in power modules were compared. Based on thermal gravimetric analysis (TGA), morphology, and Fourier infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) results, it was found that few heat-resisting fillers filled silicone elastomers with the excellent short-time and long-time heat resistance is potential to apply in power modules at high temperature. For commercial silicone gel, with increase of aging time, the hardness is increased due to compacted molecular network and reduced free volume, which is caused by thermal oxygen aging reaction. Due to the inhomogeneous reacted regions and adhesion to ceramic substrate, the inhomogeneous stress leads to the breakage of hardened silicone gels. This paper provides the deep understanding of behaviors of silicone gel and verify the feasibility of silicone elastomers at high temperature, which is beneficial to high-temperature encapsulation for power modules, especially for SiC products.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic transient modeling and simulation of distributed synchronous condenser
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: A new type of high-capacity synchronous condenser installed in converter stations cannot effectively solve the problem that renewable energy increases transient overvoltage. To solve the issue , this paper studies the small-capacity distributed condenser installed in new energy stations. First, this paper establishes the electromagnetic transient model of the wind power transmission system with the condenser via LCC-HVDC. Then, the influence of distributed condenser on the transient characteristics of wind turbine under DC bipolar blocking fault is simulated and analyzed. Finally, the suppression effects of centralized and distributed phase controllers on transient overvoltage at the wind turbine end are compared and analyzed, and the research proves the effectiveness of distributed phase controllers in suppressing transient overvoltage in new energy measurement.

articleTitle: A method of voltage level selection for offshore wind power VSC-HVDC transmission project
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Offshore wind power has been widely promoted around the world, owing to its abundance and being environmentally friendly. Voltage source converter based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) transmission technology has been utilized for wind power transmission system because of its advantages. In offshore VSC-HVDC transmission system, the DC voltage level is an important index of power transmission capacity. Based on the steady-state current operating interval of the insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBT), the value range of DC voltage for offshore VSCHVDC transmission system is given, and the value range of DC voltage is revised according to the IGBT transient current limit. Furthermore, the DC voltage level of offshore VSC-HVDC transmission system is determined according to the current limitation requirements of the DC marine cables. On this basis, a 900MW offshore wind power VSC-HVDC transmission project has been taken as an example, the process to select the DC voltage level of the project case is given. The method of voltage level selection proposed is conducive to improving the operation reliability of the offshore VSC-HVDC transmission system, and plays a positive role in improving the utilization rate of offshore wind power and the power system resilience of the onshore power grid.

articleTitle: Analyzing and tuning the time scale characteristics of the short circuit current of the synchronous condenser in the UHVDC inverter station of the heavy load center
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The synchronous condenser with fast control has been installed in UHVDC inverter station recently to remain voltage and avoid continuous commutation failures (CCFs) during short circuit faults. However, the synchronous condenser can produce excess short circuit current (SCC) which may cause relay protection failure if the total SSC exceeds the interrupting capacity. It seems that there is a contradiction between the ability to avoid CCFs and the effect of the excess SSC for the synchronous condenser in the heavy load center with high level SCC. In order to solve the contradiction, the time scale characteristics of the synchronous condensers SCC are analyzed and tuned in this paper. Firstly, the synchronous condensers SCC is formulated in different time scales related to CCFs and relay protection. Then the relationship between the SCC and manufacture parameters, initial conditions together with excitation control of the synchronous condenser is investigated. Thus the time scale characteristics of the synchronous condensers SCC are discovered. And then a tuning strategy of the time scale characteristics of the SCC is proposed to ensure the ability to avoid CCFs as well as reduce the adverse effect on relay protection. Finally, simulation study is performed to validate the work.

articleTitle: Coordinate control strategy for hybrid HVDC system based on DR-MMC with offshore wind farm integration
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Offshore wind farm integrated by hybrid rectifier, which is composed by series-connected diode rectifier (DR) and MMC, to onshore grid is investigated in this paper. As the instinct conduction characteristics of DR, whole HVDC system shows different characteristics. In this paper, steady operation principle is analysed, and multi-target coordinate control strategy based on current droop for the hybrid HVDC system is proposed. Simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness of proposed control strategy during steady operation and start up.

articleTitle: Research on volt-ampere temperature characteristics of metal oxide surge arrester on DC line
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The operating characteristics of Metal Oxide Arrester (MOA) depend on its volt-ampere characteristics. Due to the nonlinearity of nonlinear metal oxide resistors (MOV), the volt-ampere characteristics of MOV are temperature and voltage amplitude Values, current waveforms, and many other factors. In this paper, according to the actual operating conditions of MOV, the dynamic volt-ampere characteristics at different temperatures are studied in sections to obtain the volt-ampere characteristic curve and voltage-temperature curve of MOV transient inrush current at different temperatures. The results show that: DC MOV presents a significant negative voltage temperature coefficient in the small current section, and the smaller the current value, the greater the absolute value of the negative temperature coefficient; in the operation section (30/60 us), lightning section (8/20 us), steep wave section (1/5 us) and high current section (4/10 us), the volt-ampere curve of DC MOV is not greatly affected by the ambient temperature, and the temperature coefficient of the high electric field area is not obvious; multiple lightning strikes The temperature coefficient of DC MOV has a transition from negative to positive in the operating section, and the absolute value of the temperature coefficient is very small. The maximum temperature coefficient of DC MOV is 0.0468%/℃; MOV is in the lightning section (8/20 us ) Presents a weak positive temperature coefficient, the maximum temperature coefficient of DC MOV is 0.0183%/℃; MOV presents a weak positive temperature coefficient in the steep wave region (1/5us), the maximum temperature coefficient of DC MOV is 0.0687%/℃; MOV is large The current zone (4/10us) exhibits a weak positive temperature coefficient, and the maximum temperature coefficient of DC MOV is 0.029%/℃.

articleTitle: Climbing behavior design and obstacle surmounting algorithm of caterpillar-imitation robot for transmission rope delivery
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: It is fetal that the inspection and maitenance of the apparatuses at the power tower end run with the safety rope as the auxiliary help for the operator. Based on System Engineering Principle and intelligent techniques, a caterpillar-imitation robot is designed according to the function modularization by using machine vision, sensing techniques, and algorithms for the rope delivery. To adapt service condition, the climbing procedure is divided into four stages for the robot behavior design with modeling of kinematics and mechanics. The robot is constructed and runs by 8 flexible legs, 8 clusters of guide-drive wheels, and additional compressive devises as the walking organs. Logical algorithms are conceived and developed for obstacle-overcoming. Parallel reaction from the obstacle is used to compare with the threshold value for judgement of the obstacle. Simulation has been made and results show that the system design and obstacle-overcoming algorithm have reached the expectation.

articleTitle: Lightning impulse characteristics of positive polarity of 110-500kV composite insulator and comparative analysis of U50%
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</sub> of insulator is an important model for line lightning protection. The acquisition of U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</sub> includes empirical formula and test measurement, but there is a certain degree of error between the calculated value of empirical formula and the real value. However, the development of test requires a lot of human and material resources and is restricted by the difference of specific test conditions, so its universality is poor. Aiming at the composite insulator used in 110-500kV line, the positive polarity standard / short tail lightning impulse flashover test is carried out in the plain, the influence of waveform and voltage level on U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</sub> of insulator is compared and analyzed. Then, the U50% fitting formulas for composite insulators under the action of standard wave and short-tail wave are presented. Finally, the differences between U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</sub> in other similar tests and U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</sub> under different wave shocks are compared. The reason may be that the application of U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</sub> model is limited due to the differences of test conditions in different tests. It's suggested that a complete flashover database should be established in subsequent insulator research. And artificial intelligence can be used to predict the flashover characteristics of insulators to guide practical application in engineering.

articleTitle: Development of four-terminals DC circuit breaker based on commutating path multiplexing
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Multi-terminal flexible DC power grid plays an important role in large-scale new energy integration, which usually requires the installation of multi-terminal DC circuit breaker(MTCB) at the intersection of multiple DC lines. At present, the research on multi-terminal DC circuit breaker is mostly limited to theoretical simulation calculation, and there are few experimental studies and engineering applications. In this paper, a four-terminals DC circuit breaker based on commutating path multiplexing is proposed, which combines with the compact natural commutation scheme of hybrid gap, greatly reducing the cost and volume of the circuit breaker. The commutation characteristics of four-terminals hybrid DC circuit breaker equivalent prototype at 10kV voltage level were tested. On this basis, the equivalent prototype of the circuit breaker test results show that under 10kV voltage level, the four-terminals circuit breaker topology can achieve breaking of 11kA in 2.8ms by natural commutation method.

articleTitle: A multi-port hybrid DC circuit breaker based on current injection
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Against the background of the application of the Voltage Source Converter (VSC)-based DC grid technology, fault isolation by combining the converter without fault self-clearing ability with DC circuit breaker (DCCB) is one of the most promising solutions for multi-terminal DC system protection. However, in order to ensure the selectivity of protection, the traditional two-port DCCB needs to be configured at both ends of each DC line, and the huge investment cost limits its largescale application. In view of the above problems, a multi-port hybrid DC circuit breaker based on current injection (CIMPHCB) is proposed in this paper. Multiple DC lines effectively reduce the cost under the premise of ensuring selectivity by sharing one transfer branch and energy dissipation branch. In the CI-MPHCB transfer branch, the thyristor is used to replace IGBT as the switching element, which cooperate the pre-charge capacitor are used to realize the transfer of fault current, which further reduces the cost while ensuring the bidirectional blocking of fault current. Finally, the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed CI-MPHCB are verified based on PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform.

articleTitle: Analysis of the multi-mode oscillations of offshore wind farms
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Multi-mode oscillation (MMO) is more prone to happen in the offshore wind farm (OWF) than the onshore, which seriously impacts the safe operation of the system. In this paper, the mechanism for the MMO of the OWF is analytically studied. First, the impedance model (IM) of a grid-connected OWF is derived with the AC submarine cable modelled as a distributed parameter circuit (DPC). Second, since the DPC of N π sections can be approximately seen as composed of N identical capacitances in daisy-chain connection, based on the consistent control theory for homogeneous systems, the IM of the DPC is decoupled into N subsystems, each of which is composed of a τ circuit. The IM of the DPC is the weighted sum of the IMs of the N subsystems. As each τ circuit has one tip (jump between ±90°) in the amplitude(phase)-frequency characteristics (APFC), the IM of the cable will have N tips (jumps) in the APFC and is much more prone to intersect with the IM of the OWF. Thus, resonance is more likely to happen at multiple frequency points. Finally, effectiveness of the methods proposed and conclusions drawn is validated via study cases.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional reconstruction of transmission channel hidden trouble distance measurement based on multi-eye monitoring equipment
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the popularization of transmission channel visualization and intelligent identification technology, effective management and control of hidden dangers in power transmission channels has become more and more important. The clearance distance of a hidden hazard is an important criterion for judging the degree of hazard of a hidden hazard. However, the currently applied ranging technology has a relatively large error. This paper proposes a technology suitable for feature extraction and feature matching of transmission channels. And image set is obtained by feature matching. We generate a depth map of the three-dimensional space scene of the transmission channel. Based on the reconstructed depth map, the hidden danger in the transmission channel is measured. It can improve the efficiency of daily inspections and operation and maintenance management of transmission line hidden dangers and channel scenarios. It can help operation and maintenance personnel find hidden dangers in time. Thereby, the safe and stable operation of the line can be guaranteed.

articleTitle: Load-source optimization model for the participation of multiple types of aggregated flexible loads in wind power consumption
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Flexible loads are highly effective in the accommodation of blocked wind power by participation in grid regulation. Given the fact that some flexible loads with small capacity are widely distributed, it is suggested that aggregation of flexible loads should be performed for participation in grid regulation with a model established for load-source optimization. In the paper the regulation characteristics of various types of flexible loads, including high energy consuming loads, electric vehicle loads and electric boiler loads, are analysed and a load aggregation model is established. To fully explore the potential of complementary regulating capacity in multiple flexible loads, a load source optimization model with multiple types of flexible loads participating in wind power consumption is developed. Considering multiple time scales, the load-source optimization model includes a day-ahead energy optimization model and an intraday power optimization model. The models are verified in feasibility and effectiveness based on algorithm.

articleTitle: The active and reactive power characteristic analysis and decoupling control of current source PWM rectifier
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The current source PWM converter has the advantages of continuous and adjustable DC current and strong ability to limit short circuit current, and it is suitable for DC ice melting application of transmission line. In this paper, the mathematical model of current source PWM converter is established, the active and reactive power characteristics of constant current load and constant resistance load are analyzed thoroughly, the double closed-loop controller of active and reactive power decoupling is designed, and the simulation research is carried out in Simulink. The results show that the proposed method can realize active and reactive powers decoupling control. When the system voltage drops, it can also output stable DC current.

articleTitle: Research on AC/DC hybrid power supply system for easy access of distributed generation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the development of social economy and the continuous expansion of power system construction scale, the social demand for electricity is increasing day by day. However non renewable energy is very limited, and the current energy utilization mode alone can not meet the power demand of the country's huge power consumption system. Therefore, we must be based on the current energy utilization structure and make effort to improve the utilization efficiency of renewable energy, so as to alleviate the problem of energy shortage in China. In this paper, an AC / DC hybrid power supply system is proposed, which provides an intelligent power supply platform for distributed power generation. It can be compatible with the existing low-voltage power supply system, making full use of the advantages of distributed power generation, meeting the plug and play and local consumption of electric energy. Through the local conversion of DC-DC, the system reduces the process of DC-AC-DC conversion and reduces energy consumption fundamentally. In the output control strategy, the equal current circulation suppression strategy is used to fundamentally eliminate the danger of circulation and optimize the system efficiency. Simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A synchronous rectification control method of bidirectional full-bridge LLC resonant converter with SIC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Bidirectional LLC resonant converters have the advantages of ZVS and ZCS characteristics, high switching frequency, high transmission efficiency, wide voltage gain range, bidirectional power flow characteristics and etc which are widely used in intelligent micro-grid, new energy power generation, electric vehicles, uninterruptible power supply system(UPS) and other fields. Meanwhile, with the development of silicon carbide(SiC) as the third-generation semiconductor material, the power density and efficiency of LLC resonant converters have been greatly improved. This paper proposes a new synchronous rectification control method suitable for the SiC bidirectional full-bridge LLC resonant converters. Whether the SiC LLC converter works in the boost or buck mode, all of SiC MOSFETs can realize ZVS and ZCS through the zero-crossing detection module.The strategy proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the effect of circulating power of SiC converter, improve the output voltage gain of the converter, and further realize the bidirectional flow of energy. This paper analyses the principle of the control strategy in detail, establishes the equivalent model of the fundamental wave, analyses its voltage gain characteristics and soft switching characteristics, and completes the derivation of the corresponding formulas. Finally, the proposed control strategy is verified by PSIM simulation.

articleTitle: Study on pressure spread characteristics of arc fault in critical area of UHV oil-filled equipment
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Large-scale oil-filled equipment such as AC transformers, converter transformers and reactors are important equipment in UHV transmission systems. However, the sudden pressure rise caused by arc faults will cause explosions of oil-filled equipment, which seriously threatens the safe and stable operation of the power system. The tap-changer and ascending flange are the critical areas of UHV oil-filled equipment, with a higher probability of internal arc faults than the rest of the equipment. In order to clarify the pressure spread characteristics of tap-changers and ascending flanges during arc fault, the pressure distribution characteristics were analyzed based on finite element simulation. Based on the gas-liquid two-phase flow model and the compressible model, the generation and transmission of pressure waves were simulated, and the pressure distribution law and evolution process at different times were analyzed after arc energy was loaded at different fault locations. The results show that the pressure near the fault point is the highest, and the pressure peak decreases significantly with the increase of distance. The time to reach the peak pressure of different parts is obviously different, which shows the feasible to judge the arc fault location based on the pressure distribution characteristics of multiple monitoring points.

articleTitle: Online localization method for local defects in power cables based on electromagnetic coupling
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to solve the shortcomings of the frequency domain reflection(FDR) method which can only locate cable defects offline, this paper proposes a cable defect online location method based on FDR and electromagnetic coupling technology. Firstly, a cable containing local defects is modelled based on a parametric model of cable distribution, and a Kaiser window function is used to add a window to the original localisation spectrum to improve the sensitivity of the localisation of cable defects. This was verified on 105 m and 500 m power cables in the laboratory by varying the load resistance at the end of the 105 m cable under offline testing to simulate the line conditions under different cable loads and to analyse the effect on the reflection intensity at local defects and at the end of the cable. In the powered test case, the 500 m cable was energised by a series resonant platform and tested using the proposed online location method in order to test the effectiveness of the proposed method. The simulation and experimental results show that the method is able to locate the defective points online when the cable is energised, compared to the offline location test method.

articleTitle: Modelling and harmonic analysis of metro traction power supply system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The large number of nonlinear loads used in urban metro rail traction grids distorts the voltage and current on the load side, then generates harmonics. The resulting capacitive characteristic harmonics current component provides feedback to the power grid, thus causing additional power losses and equipment damage. To solve this power quality problem, a detailed dynamic simulator of the metro traction power supply system is developed, which includes the corresponding 24-pulse rectifier and low-voltage power distribution system. Based on the established simulator, a study of the harmonic content and characteristics research of the 24-pulse rectifier and low-voltage electricity-consuming equipment are performed. In combination with the digital simulator, we presented and disused the lower-order frequency harmonic currents of the 35kV AC bus exhibiting capacitive characteristics. The results lay a technical foundation for harmonic equivalent impedance calculation and harmonic current suppression of the metro traction power supply system.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of distribution network considering reactive power auxiliary service in market environment
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to achieve optimal resource allocation and maximize social and economic benefits, power market reform is an inevitable trend in the development of the power industry. Research on distribution network optimization under the power market environment has become an important issue. This paper analyses the characteristics of distribution network dispatching in the electricity market environment from three aspects: market stakeholders, reactive power service price and the difference with traditional dispatching. Then, considering the reactive power auxiliary service, the two-stage distribution network optimization scheduling model is established. The first stage is active power optimization, and the second stage is reactive power optimization. And the two-stage model solving process is designed. Finally, the model proposed in this paper is simulated through improved the IEEE-33 node test example. The calculation results indicate that reactive power resources can be better allocated and economic benefits of power suppliers can be improved considering the reactive power auxiliary service market.

articleTitle: Research on key parameters of UHV half-wavelength AC arrester
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The sources of energy in our country are very uneven. UHV half-wavelength AC power transmission can be regarded as one of the selectable schemes to send large capacity of electric power via long distance. Insulation coordination research is the foundation for the engineering application of half-wavelength AC transmission. The arrester is the most important protection device in the insulation coordination of transmission lines and substations. Therefore, it is the main research work to determine key parameters of UHV half-wavelength AC arrester. Based on the distribution of power frequency voltage, the continuous operating voltage of UHV half-wavelength AC arrester is determined. And the rated voltage of the UHV half-wavelength AC arrester is also determined considering the temporary over-voltage of half-wavelength transmission line and the rated voltage difference of arresters. Then nominal discharge current and protection level of the UHV half-wavelength AC arrester are recommended. According to energy absorbing capacity of the conventional UHV arrester and overvoltage calculation results of China Electric Power Research Institute, the paper determines energy absorbing capacity of the UHV half-wavelength arrester. The research results can provide technical support for the design and manufacture of arresters for UHV half-wavelength AC project.

articleTitle: Analysis of the unbalanced current among paralleled MMCS caused by commutation failures in hybrid cascaded UHVDC system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The hybrid cascaded ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission system, which combines the advantages of the line commutated converter (LCC) based and modular multilevel converter (MMC) based UHVDC system, has good engineering prospects. In this topology, the rectifier side adopts LCCs, and the inverter side adopts an LCC connected in series with three paralleled MMCs. In this paper, the mechanism of unbalanced current among the paralleled MMCs induced by commutation failures of LCC is analysed. Firstly, the cause of unbalanced current is explained by combining the control strategy and the change of the inverter equivalent topology after commutation failures. Furthermore, the main factors affecting the unbalanced current are analysed, including the smoothing reactor, the constant current control on the rectifier side and the voltage dependent current order control (VDCOL). Finally, the validity of the mechanism analysis is verified by simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC platform. The technical route and key points of limiting unbalanced current are also put forward.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of dynamic reactive power of LCC-HVDC receiving-end power grid with dynamic load
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Firstly, this paper analyzes the mechanism between reactive power and transient voltage of line commutated converter HVDC (LCC-HVDC) receiving-end power grid, and the physical process in three periods is sorted out according to the time scale. The interaction between dynamic load and LCC-HVDC during AC system fault is studied. Based on this, the necessity of dynamic reactive power compensation is proposed. The simulation analysis shows that the dynamic reactive power compensation can effectively improve the transient voltage stability during fault, and can effectively prevent the diffusion of dynamic load transient instability in the heavy load area, and the compensation effect of connected to the low-voltage bus is better than that to the high-voltage bus. The research results of this paper have a significant effect on improving the transient voltage characteristics of LCC-HVDC receiving-end power grid with high proportion of dynamic load, and can guide the actual operation of the project.

articleTitle: Failure analysis of fuse for external protection of capacitor bank
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The fuse has the characteristics of easy installation and use, low cost, and low investment. It is widely used at home and abroad as a protection device for internal failures of units (single) shunt capacitors above 1kV. This article specifically analyzes a fuse failure for external protection of capacitor banks. Focusing on improving the reliability of the fuse used for external protection of shunt capacitors, analyze and give reasonable suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on series and parallel characteristics of intergrated gate commutated thyristors
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the development of DC systems, there are more and more scenarios for power device IGCT applications. However, the capacity of a single device is not sufficient to meet the demand, which makes the series and parallel use of IGCTs an unavoidable situation. This paper analyzes the use of IGCT in series and parallel, studies the factors of static and dynamic voltage division of the device, and proposes methods to improve the voltage consistency. For the parallel use of IGCTs, the reasons for the uneven current flow are also analyzed,and the methods to improve the current sharing effect are given.

articleTitle: Operation of high-frequency-linked power router as virtual synchronous generator
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Power router is an effective way to integrate high proportion renewable generations. However, the high penetration of distributed generations reduces the inertia of a islanded microgrid, which can lead to unexpected frequency fluctuations during the changes of generation or load. As a novel structure of power router, high-frequency-linked power router can be used for the primary frequency regulation in addition to synchronous generators. With the energy stored in its converter capacitors, the power router runs as a virtual synchronous generator and increases the inertia of a microgrid. The dynamic behavior of the islanded microgrid with a power router is studied and simulation results validates that by proper control the power router improves the system inertia and reduces the frequency fluctuations.

articleTitle: The detection of ethylene gas based on cantilever-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Cantilever-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy has a low detection limit and high sensitivity, which is increasingly favored by researchers. At present, there are few reports on dissolved gases in transformer oil, and no research on C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> gas has been carried out. In this paper, the wavelength of the laser is first tuned by changing the driving current and temperature so that the wavelength of the laser is in the center of the absorption peak of the gas, where the high level is 4.2 V, and the laser wavelength tuning is completed when the laser temperature is 25.6°C. Secondly, the experimental study of frequency characteristics is carried out in this paper, and the corresponding relationship between the pure photoacoustic signal of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> gas, the experimental signal-to-noise ratio and the frequency is obtained, and the optimal frequency point of 10Hz is obtained. In this paper, the relationship between gas concentration and photoacoustic signal was established, and a linear fitting coefficient of 0.945 was obtained. In the experiment, the system noise and detection limit were studied, and the value of system noise was 0.498 mV, and the detection limit of gas was 1.25 ppm, which proved the practicability of the method.

articleTitle: Key technology of hybrid cascaded UHVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The Baihetan-Jiangsu UHVDC transmission project is one of the backbone links of the West-East power transmission project in China. To meet the needs of the Baihetan-Jiangsu UHVDC transmission project, this paper proposes a hybrid cascaded HVDC transmission technology, in which sending-end adopts LCC and receiving-end adopts LCC-VSC in series. This technology can possess advantages of both LCC and VSC. This paper introduces the topology and key equipment of the hybrid cascaded HVDC system. Among them, the hybrid DC filter (H-DCF), the hybrid DC energy release device (HDCERD) and fast bypass switch are innovatively utilized for the first time. Secondly, the control strategy of the system is studied, including the start-stop strategy, AC fault analysis and DC fault analysis. To verify the feasibility of the proposed hybrid cascaded HVDC transmission system, simulation tests for the system start-stop, AC fault and DC fault are carried out based on the simulation model built in PSCAD. The test results indicate that the hybrid cascaded HVDC technology has a smooth start-stop, flexible operation mode, reliable fault ride-through, and is feasible in engineering.

articleTitle: Pre-acceleration protection strategy for medium voltage DC distribution network based on superconducting fault current limiter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to propose a protection strategy for MVDC distribution networks based on SFCLs. A pre-accelerated protection scheme based on SFCLs is designed, aiming at the line fault isolation in MVDC distribution networks. Based on the physical characteristics and working principle of superconducting tape, a simplified SFCL physical model is established. A 10 kV hand-in-hand MVDC distribution system model is built on the MATLAB / Simulink platform to verify the limiting effect of SFCLs on short circuit current. The result shows that when a short circuit fault occurs in the line, the SFCL enters the high resistance state, which can effectively suppress the short circuit current from a high value of 5 kA down to below 1 kA. With the help of the cooperation of the SFCL and the DC circuit breaker, the scheme can accurately judge the fault location and clear the fault, with small numbers of SFCLs and low cost. Compared with the traditional pre-acceleration protection strategy without SFCLs, its fault clearing time is shorter and the protection reliability is higher.

articleTitle: A refined model of turboprop regional aircraft on-board electric power system for fault reconstruction simulation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of the aviation industry, more and more regional flights have been put into commercial use to meet the needs of different regions. In order to respond to the call for “carbon neutrality”, regional aircrafts also need to develop towards the trend of “more-electric”. When designing an on-board electric power system, a large number of simulation experiments are required to measure the operation of the entire system in steady state and various fault conditions. Therefore, there is an increasing demand for more accurate modeling of on-board power systems. Especially under fault conditions, it is extremely helpful for the design of the reconstruction diagram to accurately simulate the reconstruction sequence under fault conditions. In this paper, the hardware modeling of the contactor and the hardware interlock structure are modeled, which makes the modeling of the on-board power system more accurate. This paper also builds a classic turboprop regional aircraft power system at the behaviour level, and carries out the simulation under steady state and TRU fault conditions, showing that both the transient process and the reconstruction sequence can be accurately simulated.

articleTitle: Time sequence probabilistic influence of traction load with small sample of newly high-speed railway on power grid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: More and more traction stations of new high-speed railway are connected to the power grid, and the major challenges to the power grid has been brought. This paper proposes a probabilistic method for the timing influence of traction load with small sample on power grid based on non-parametric Bootstrap and kernel density estimation. Firstly, in view of the small sample problem of traction load test data, the timing samples of traction load of are obtained using the non-parametric Bootstrap. Secondly, the equivalent three-phase model of the traction power supply system is obtained through the voltage/current transformation matrix of the traction transformer. The three-phase power flow calculation model of the power system with traction load is established. Then, the three-phase time sequence probabilistic power flow is calculated by the Monte Carlo simulation, and the Kernel density estimation (KDE) is used to calculate the probability distribution of output random variable. Finally, the timing influence of traction load on the voltage amplitude and unbalance degree of grid nodes are analysed by the modified IEEE-14 bus three-phase system. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Typical scenario analysis of low-voltage distribution network with distributed photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the generation of typical scenarios of distribution network is studied. Firstly, the pre-processing approach of missing values and outliers in the measured data is proposed. Then the simulation model of distribution network with distributed PV and multi-load is constructed, and the evaluation indexes are put forward to describe the key operation characteristics. Case study is carried out based on typical distribution network, and typical scenarios of distribution network are constructed considering the impact of weather and penetration of distributed photovoltaic, which is of great significance for the planning and operation of low-voltage distribution network with high proportion of distributed PV.

articleTitle: Design of spanning frame used for bearing network of UHV transmission line
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the goal of the whole process of sealing the net without power failure, and the frame body being convenient for transportation and installation, combined with the design requirements of the allowable stress method, under the consideration of the situation, a spanning frame for the load bearing of the net sealing is designed. The frame adopts a modular design, the main columns are arranged on both sides of the line to be spanned, a rotating mechanism, a spanning arm, a balance arm and a mast are set at the top of one column, and a docking device is set at the top of the column on the other side. Make the spanning arm span over the spanned line. Through analysis (simulating the situation of wire falling into the net), the frame body for sealing the net can provide reliable protection during the live crossing construction of the UHV transmission line.

articleTitle: Frequency selection method of multi-terminal interconnected system of urban power grid based on low frequency AC
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Compared with power frequency transmission, the capacity of low frequency transmission is stronger. This paper presents a frequency selection method of multi-terminal urban power grid with interconnected partitions based on LFAC. The method aims at the multi-terminal urban system with ring topology. The traversal algorithm is used to determine the partition serial number, support power and line transmission distance of each tie line in turn. The method calculates the current distribution along each tie line under the distributed parameter model, and determines the upper limit of transmission frequency of the whole system, which provides guidance for subsequent engineering project.

articleTitle: Analysis of optimal operation interval of electric energy router with common high-frequency bus
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the increasingly prominent problems of energy shortage and environmental pollution, the development trend of largescale new energy generation, high permeability distributed generation, new energy vehicles and large-scale energy storage system is irreversible. The high-level development of multiple source charges also brings problems such as harmonic pollution and loss increase to power system. As the core device of the new power system, the electric energy router (EER) can not only control the power flow but also improve the power quality and self-healing of the system. This paper focuses on the analysis of the optimal operating interval of the EER with common high-frequency bus, studies its operating mechanism, carries out simulation verification analysis, Finally, guided by the efficiency index, according to the proposed simplified circuit model, the objective function including the efficiency index is established, which is solved by genetic algorithm, and the optimal operation interval of EER under two different operation modes is obtained.

articleTitle: Applications of integrated optical electric field sensor
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Electric field measurement is an important research method in many fields of science and technology. This paper expounds the measurement principle of the integrated optical electric field sensor (IOES), and carries out various engineering applications such as DC transient electric field, power frequency electric field, lightning impulse, electromagnetic pulse (EMP), etc., and compares the measurement results with the voltage probe. The experimental results show that the IOES can be applied to broadband electric field measurement, and has the advantages of strong anti-interference ability

articleTitle: FEM calculation of the sheath currents in 110Kv cables
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Cross-bounding system is the most commonly used method to reduce sheath current. The sheath currents of cables are induced by currents in the cable cores, and sheath currents also increase when the loads increase gradually. The current carrying capacity of the cable is limited by sheath currents further, owing to their thermal effect, which is not favourable to the heat dissipation and operation of the cable. The sheath currents of single cable and the sheath currents of single loop cables in the case of cross-bounding interconnection are calculate by FEM including configurations of three phase cables in square triangle, horizontal and right angled triangle with the same distance between the cable cores. The results show that the right triangle arrangement should be preferred in order to minimize the sheath circulation.

articleTitle: Capacitor voltage ripple suppression strategy of MMC submodule based on high harmonic injection
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: As the energy storage component of the modular multilevel converter (MMC), the voltage fluctuation of the sub-module capacitor determines the selection of the switching device and its safe operating range. In order to suppress the capacitor voltage ripple in the control strategy, this paper analyses the voltage ripple characteristics of sub-module capacitor, and introduces zero sequence voltage as another degree of freedom to suppress the capacitor voltage ripple based on the relationship between capacitor energy current amplitude and phase current amplitude and frequency. Combined with the third harmonic theory, an improved voltage ripple suppression strategy of MMC sub-module capacitor with high frequency harmonic injection is proposed. Finally, a system simulation model is established based on the PLECS simulation platform, and a 200V experimental prototype is built for verification. The experimental results verify that the improved MMC sub-module capacitor voltage ripple suppression strategy has the ability to effectively suppress the capacitor voltage ripple.

articleTitle: Packaging and modelling method of renewable energy equipment based on unified interface
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy power generation in the power system, the characteristics of renewable energy equipment have a greater impact on the power grid. It is necessary to accurately simulate the renewable energy equipment. Encapsulating the internal logic of the controller directly into a digital model is an important technical route to realize the accurate simulation. However, the current commonly used electromagnetic software includes ADPSS, HYPERSIM, PSCAD, MATLAB and RT-LAB, with different packaging methods, which brings high technical threshold and huge workload. This paper investigates the user-defined modelling methods of these five software, refines the common characteristics, and puts forward the user-defined modelling idea of “unified interface”, which realizes single modelling and multi-platform reuse. This paper proposes a renewable energy packaging and modelling method based on “unified interface”, which includes code architecture, functional architecture, interface function form, programming requirements and conversion methods of different software. Finally, through the case of a photovoltaic controller of a manufacturer, the high consistency of different platforms verifies the correctness of the renewable energy packaging and modelling method based on “unified interface”.

articleTitle: Small signal stability analysis of LADRC based DFIG driven wind turbines during weak AC grid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: During weak power grid, the interaction between the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind turbines and the power grid impedance can easily induce system instability issue, and thus threaten the safety of the system. The linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) is a potential way in improving the damping of the DFIG system, due to its excellent anti-disturbance ability. In this paper, the small-signal impedance model of the DFIG with LADRC is established. Based on the proposed model, the interaction between the DFIG and the weak grid is analysed in detail. Electromagnetic simulations are then performed to validate the correctness of the theoretical analysis. It shows that compared with the traditional proportional integral control with the same control bandwidth, the LADRC can obviously improve the phase margin of the DFIG system, and thus enhance the small signal stability of the DFIG system.

articleTitle: A novel frequency support strategy for VSC-HVDC system with large wind power integration
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In the context of carbon neutralization, wind farms with abundant wind energy will develop fast to replace the traditional thermal power units. In addition, the voltage source converter based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) technology is a promising way to integrate and transmit wind power. However, with the increasing penetration rate of wind power, the frequency stability problem of the new power system will become prominent. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes a novel frequency support strategy for VSC-HVDC system with large wind power integration. Firstly, the virtual inertia control of VSC-HVDC is studied to provide active power support fast by extracting energy from the parallel capacitors of the VSC. Secondly, the frequency-based speed control of the wind turbines is proposed to balance the mismatched power. Moreover, the recovery control of the VSC-HVDC and the wind turbines are discussed. Finally, simulations of a VSC-HVDC with large wind power integration have been conducted in PSCAD/EMTDC to validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: A novel fault ride through equivalent test method for submodule with integrated energy dissipation equipment
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The most effective solution for fault ride through (FRT) of the converter valve is to install an energy dissipation device. A newly proposed solution is to install an energy dissipation device in the submodule. In this scheme, only analyses the control strategy and cost of the energy dissipation branch. However, switching the energy dissipation branch has a non-negligible impact on the normal operation of the capacitor and switching devices in the original power module, and the energy dissipation resistor itself also needs stress assessment. In this paper, an equivalent test method of submodule FRT is proposed based on the submodule with an integrated energy dissipation device, and the correctness of the method is verified by PSCAD simulation.

articleTitle: Cantilever PAS detection for C2H6 decomposition
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Ethane (C2H6) gas is produced due to transformer overheating and discharge faults. Therefore, high sensitivity quantitative analysis of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas content is of great significance for early prediction of transformer faults. In this paper, according to the demand of high precision detection of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas, a photoacoustic spectroscopy (PAS) detection platform is built by using quantum cascade laser (QCL) and silicon microcantilever microphone. In addition, the input voltage and operating temperature of the laser are scanned in this paper. It is found that the optimal input voltage and operating temperature of the laser are 7.5 V and 25°C, respectively, and the optimal operating frequency of the experimental platform is 20 Hz. At the same time, this paper also measured the relationship between C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> concentration and PA signal strength under the background of He. It was found that there was a good linear relationship between the concentration of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas and the pure PA signal strength, and the detection limit was calculated to be 2.3 ppm.

articleTitle: Study on contact degradation of ARC contact of SF6 circuit breaker for reactive switching
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Frequent operation of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> circuit breaker for switching capacitor banks leads to radial loss and stress relaxation of arc contact, and contact degradation occurs, which seriously affects its performance and operating life. In order to study the influence of radial loss and stress relaxation on contact degradation of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> circuit breaker arc contact, this paper established a contact resistance model based on Holm theory, and obtained the relationship between radial loss and increase of contact resistance, then influence of arc contact stress relaxation on contact resistance was studied through theoretical calculations. Results show that contact resistance increases with the increase of radial loss of arc contact. When inrush current peak is 15kA, radial loss reaches 0.2366mm, and contact resistance increases by 54μΩ. At the same time, it is found that stress relaxation during long-term deformation will lead to a decrease in contact force. It is predicted that stress loss will be close to 40% of initial stress after 20 years, and stress relaxation will increase contact resistance by 50μΩ.

articleTitle: Transformer fault identification method based on multi-source data
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
