abstract: In order to improve the utilization rate of transformer multi-source data and the accuracy of transformer fault discrimination, this paper proposes a transformer fault discrimination method based on multi-source data. Firstly, based on the transformer real-time data acquisition and online monitoring device, 27 kinds of transformer operation sensing data are extracted, and the transformer multi-source data are processed using principal component analysis to realize the transformer multi-source data dimensionality reduction; secondly, the support vector data description algorithm is introduced as the transformer fault discrimination method, and the relevant parameters are optimized by the particle swarm optimization algorithm to improve the transformer fault discrimination capability; finally, the model is validated with an actual transformer operation data. Finally, the results show that the diagnostic accuracy of the model proposed in this paper is 96.1% higher than that of WOA-SVDD, GWO-SVDD and SA-SVDD fault diagnosis models, which verifies the accuracy of transformer fault discrimination proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the effect of trace elements in copper-chromium contacts on the current cut-off level of vacuum switches
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The current cut-off phenomenon of vacuum switch will generate high overvoltage in the electrical circuit, which threatens the safety and insulation of electrical equipment. Adding trace elements to the contact material is one of the important measures to reduce the cut-off level of vacuum switch. In this paper, based on the research background of adding trace element Te (tellurium) to CuCr (copper-chromium) contacts, the oscillating circuit and detachable vacuum interrupter are used to measure the interception value of CuCrTe contacts with different additions and different processing techniques, and study the trace elements. The effect of element Te on the cut-off value of CuCr contacts preliminarily proves that the improvement of contact material can affect the level of cut-off value. The results show that adding Te element to the CuCr contact can reduce the cutoff value of the material. As the content of Te element in the contact increases, the cut-off value decreases unidirectionally, and the high-frequency oscillation of arc voltage and current near the cut-off moment is more pronounced. Obviously, it indicates the threat of back-arc heavy breakdown. The experimental results can provide a reference for the comprehensive optimization of copper-chromium contact trace element addition and switch performance indicators.

articleTitle: Research on the noise field characteristics of amorphous alloy transformer cabinet based on modal analysis
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Amorphous alloy distribution transformers (AMDT) have been widely used in the power transmission and distribution industry due to their excellent energy-saving performance, but the high noise has effected the wide applications of the AMDT. At present, most of researchers are mainly focusing on the magnetostrictive characteristics of the transformer core, and there are few studies coupling with the acoustic and the structure to estimate the acoustic field characteristics in the tank of the AMDT. According to the structural dynamics equations and the acoustic-vibration coupling characteristics of the closed elastic plate with rectangle shell structure, a coupling model of the elastic plate shell and the acoustic cavity structure is established to analyze and verify the correctness of the model by FEA in the paper. The interaction between the cabinet structure and internal noise of the AMDT is studied. The finite and boundary element coupling analysis methods show the interaction between noise and sound-structure of the transformer cabinet, and a method based on a modal interaction is proposed to determine the sound pressure level of the noise for the AMDT. The research results can provide theoretical guidance for the design and noise reduction of amorphous alloy transformers.

articleTitle: A new IGCT-based converter-breaker integrated line-commutated converter and its clamping operation strategy
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel converter-breaker integrated line-commutated converter (ILCC). This converter is on the basis of cross-clamping devices, which shows prosperous application for the mitigation of commutation failure occurred in line-commutated converter based high voltage direct current (LCC-HVdc) system. On the basis of high-capacity integrated gate commutated thyristor (IGCT), its corresponding clamping operation strategy and design method of ILCC are presented. Based on the analysis, an LCC-HVdc study case is developed in PSCAD/EMTDC applying an LCC station as the rectifier and a ILCC station as the inverter. The simulation results show the commutation failure mitigation process and prove the proposed ILCC's correctness and effectiveness. Finally, the commutation failure mitigation capability and economic cost of ILCC are also discussed compared with other existing converters. It has outstanding advantages in commutation failure mitigation, and economic cost.

articleTitle: Seismic vulnerability analysis of the 500kV suspended DC filter circuit system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to accurately obtain the seismic response and vulnerability analysis of DC filter circuit equipment, the circuit model containing 500kV DC filter and pillar equipment are established by the finite element method to obtains the displacement and stress responses of 30 seismic waves under 4 different acceleration peaks, and then gives the vulnerability curve of the circuit equipment. The results show that: the first-order vibration mode of the capacitor bank of the suspended DC filter changes from rotational deformation to bending deformation before and after the tube bus connection; the seismic weak position of the DC filter circuit are the stress responses of the bottom of the post insulator, as well as the displacement of the middle layer of the suspended DC filter; The vulnerability curve of the circuit equipment has obvious nonlinearity, which indicates the vulnerability increases rapidly at a certain PGA. The seismic response of equipment under this condition should be fully considered in the construction of seismic facilities.

articleTitle: Non intrusive current measurement method for multi conductor in DC distribution network
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: At present, the power grid is undergoing digital transformation. In order to realize the digitization of the power grid, the first thing to do is to build a power grid wide sensor network with intelligent sensors, and carry out real-time measurement and upload of current, voltage and other state quantities of routes and equipment in the power grid. Most of the existing current measurement methods are intrusive, and can only measure the current on one line. In the lines and equipment of DC distribution network, there are scenes of multi-conductor current measurement such as separated conductor and multi-core cable. Therefore, a non-invasive multi conductor current measurement method is proposed in this paper. Using tunnel magnetoresistance (TMR) as the sensitive element, the non-contact multi conductor current measurement target is realized by using electromagnetic field theory and genetic algorithm. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by simulation analysis of an example.

articleTitle: A novel frequency based voltage droop control method for VSC-DC segmentation systems
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Urban power grid faces such problems as short circuit current exceeding standard, flexible power flow control, and cascading failures. Therefore, voltage source converter (VSC)-DC segmentation technology has a very promising prospect in the urban power grid. However, the coordinated control of the VSC-DC segmentation system should be further studied. In this paper, a novel frequency based voltage droop control method (VDM) for VSC-DC segmentation systems is proposed. Firstly, the advantages and the disadvantages between the master slave control and the VDM of the VSC-DC segmentation systems are discussed. Secondly, a frequency based VDM is proposed for VSC-DC segmentation systems. By utilizing the nature control characteristics of the VDM, the proposed method can respond to the frequency deviation faster, attenuating the frequency problem for the segmented system. Lastly, both theoretical analysis and simulations validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Calculation and Study on the influence of insulator surface pollution on its insulation performance
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The voltage equalizing characteristic of line insulator string is an important electrical performance to be considered in insulator selection and long-term operation. Especially in dusty areas, due to the influence of geographical and natural conditions, bird droppings and dust accumulation are often the problems to be faced in the operation of insulator strings. In this paper, considering the influence of stray capacitance and phase to phase, the simulation calculation model is established for the typical porcelain insulator string and composite insulator string of 500kV line. The electric field calculation and analysis under normal working conditions, bird droppings working conditions and pollution accumulation working conditions are carried out respectively, and the potential, electric field distribution characteristics and insulator voltage sharing characteristics of insulator string under different working conditions are obtained. The effects of bird droppings with different particle sizes and positions on the electric field distribution of insulator strings and the effects of pollution caused by sand and dust settlement on the insulation and long-term operation reliability of insulator strings are revealed. The research conclusion has positive guiding significance for line insulator string operation and maintenance and condition assessment.

articleTitle: Study on transient over-voltage mechanism at sending end of wind power via DC system dominated by highproportion power electronic equipment
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Large-scale new power supply based on power electronics equipment will replace traditional synchronous rotating equipment and lead to changes in the operation characteristics of power grid. Under the characteristics of the new power grid, it is necessary to consider the transient reactive power response characteristics of DC converters and new energy frequency converters one after another, and further explore the occurrence mechanism of transient over-voltage from the perspective of the characteristics of power electronic equipment. In this paper, large-scale wind turbines are selected to replace the weak AC power grid of traditional rotating equipment, and the transient characteristics of the grid voltage under the support of weak rotating equipment with the participation of the PLL phase-locking process of the wind turbine are explored. Combined with the electromagnetic transient simulation model for comparison and verification, the research shows that the PLL phase locking process of the wind turbine will have an impact on the transient over-voltage of the sending-end power grid.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration and operation strategy of hybrid energy storage system for assisting renewable energy grid integration
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Renewable energy power has obvious volatility, uncertainty, and anti-peak shaving characteristics. For the power system which has already built pumped storage power stations, in order to improve the absorption capacity of large-scale renewable energy, a battery energy storage system (BESS) optimal capacity determination and a pumped storage - BESS joint economic operation strategy are proposed in this paper, realizing the function of renewable energy source (RES) output smooth, RES planned output curves tracking, system peak-valley power difference reduction. Firstly, considering the RES planned output power range and short-term power change limitation, the BESS power reference is extracted based on moving average filtering. Secondly, minimum requirement of BESS power and energy can be determined. Then, aiming at power system overall economic benefit maximized, the Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS) optimal operation model and joint economic operation strategy are proposed. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model and strategy is verified by a case.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of reducing the action times of tap changer at rectifier and inverter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the strategy of reducing tap changer action in view of many converter flow accidents in China this year. Firstly, the working principle of the tap changer in HVDC transmission project is analyzed, and the principle of the traditional tap changer control strategy is analyzed. On this basis, an improved tap changer control strategy which reduces the tap changer control strategy suitable for the rectifier and inverter are proposed, which is designed by taking HVDC as an example. Finally, it is verified by RTDS simulation model, The conclusion shows that this strategy can effectively reduce the action times of tap changer.

articleTitle: Research on harmonic interaction based on Ningxia power grid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to promote the transformation of energy advantages into economic advantages of the autonomous region and promote the development and consumption of new energy power in Ningxia, the third UHV DC transmission project in Ningxia is planned and constructed. The DC project starts from Ningxia and ends in Hunan. The DC voltage is ±800kV and the designed transmission capacity is 8000mw. After a large number of new energy sources in Ningxia power grid are gathered and sent out through the third DC circuit, with the access of a large number of wind power photovoltaic new energy sources, several problems faced by Ningxia power grid are that the power grid is highly power electronic, a large number of new energy sources such as power electronic equipment and wind power photovoltaic fluctuate intermittently, which may lead to more prominent problems such as harmonic problems and reactive power balance in Ningxia. Therefore, it is necessary to study the typical harmonic interaction of Ningxia power grid, so as to lay the foundation for the subsequent harmonic suppression scheme of the third DC.

articleTitle: A novel solution for handling with the extreme shoot-through fault in MMC-HVDC system based on IGCT
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The protection thyristor is commonly applied in the high voltage direct current modular multilevel converter (MMC-HVDC) for handling with extreme shoot-through faults. To reduce the building complexity and costs, a novel solution of MMC-HVDC system based on the integrated gate commutating thyristor (IGCT) with central overvoltage breakdown function is proposed. Estimation of the fault current based on the equivalent model considering the stray inductances shows that the di/dt limiting inductor in IGCT based MMC sub-module (IGCT-SM) can help limit the fault current. The experiment result in a MMC valve system based on IGCT shows that the proposed solution can realize the discharging of the DC capacitor below 4.5 kV in IGCT-SM during the fault. The peak fault current in IGCT-SM is about 600 kA, which is consistent with estimation. During the whole extreme shoot-through fault test, the explosion proof of IGCT is verified, which performs like the protection thyristor.

articleTitle: Effect of nozzle ablation amount on the generation amount of decomposition products for SF6 circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Non-uniform arc burning in the nozzle is a common latent fault of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> circuit breaker, which will affect its breaking performance. When arcing, PTFE in the nozzle is vaporized and involved in the formation reaction of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products. Non-uniform arc burning leads to PTFE excessive vaporization and significantly affects the type and concentration of some SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products, which can provide a basis for the latent fault diagnosis. In this paper, 16 times of 31.5kA short-circuit current breaking tests were carried out by two 40.5kV SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> circuit breakers respectively. The uniform and non-uniform ablation nozzles were obtained. It was found that the concentrations of SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> were almost not affected by the amount of nozzle ablation. However, when the mass loss of excessive ablation nozzle is 1.8g more than the normal one, CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> of excessive ablation nozzle are 807.5uL/L, 22.5uL/L, 9.0uL/L and 116.9uL/L more than the normal one, respectively. CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> can be used as characteristic decomposition products to diagnose non-uniform arc burning in the nozzle. This study is of great significance for the latent fault diagnosis of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> circuit breakers based on decomposition product analysis.

articleTitle: A PDE constrained optimization based approach to evaluate the effect of the floating conductor transmission lines
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The floating potential induced by the parallel transmission line is an important factor for the insulation coordination and ground switch design. In the case of HVDC transmission lines, it is more complicated to predict the potential on the parallel floating conductors due to the occurrence of the ion flow field. In this paper, the original nonlinear problem is reformulated to a PDE constrained optimization problem and the floating potential is obtained by minimizing the accumulated charges on the floating conductors. The obvious merit of the proposed approach is that all the boundary conditions are explicitly satisfied. The proposed method is applied to investigate the effect of the space charge to the floating potential on the practical HVDC transmission lines. Numerical results show that the presence of the ion flow field significantly enhances the potential on the parallel transmission lines, which can be a reference for the future floating potential prediction.

articleTitle: CNN-LSTM neural network with attention mechanism for fault diagnosis of high voltage circuit breakers
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In the current fault diagnosis of high-voltage circuit breakers (HVCB), the traditional methods are limited by prior knowledge and manual experience. The accuracy of convolutional neural networks (CNN) isn't good enough, and there are often false positives or false negatives, which don't realize the effective monitoring of HVCBs. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on convolutional neural network-long short-term memory network (CNN-LSTM) with attention mechanism. First, the CNN with attention mechanism is used to extract the features of the mechanical fault. The fusion of the attention mechanism makes the CNN pay more attention to the high-importance features, which solves the problem that the CNN does not distinguish the importance of the features and causes the loss of important features. Then, the long short-term memory (LSTM) module is introduced as a classifier to improve the ability to utilize and process the features extracted by the CNN module, so as to complete the task of fault classification. The experimental results show that, compared with CNN, CNN-LSTM and other intelligent diagnosis methods, the CNN-LSTM with attention mechanism proposed in this paper obtains higher-precision diagnosis results, which provides a reliable basis for fault diagnosis of HVCBs.

articleTitle: Simulation research of attenuation characteristic of 220KV power cable in different life stage
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Due to the long-term operation of power cable, the insulation degradation will occur, which will affect the relative permittivity and conductivity of main insulation, thereby affecting the transmission characteristics. Injected signals of different frequencies will attenuate differently due to the existence of capacitance and inductance. The reflected wave measurement method based on transmission line theory has been widely researched as a cable non-destructive testing method. When analysing the reflected signal, higher accuracy will be achieved by considering the attenuation and phase shift of injected signal along the line. Based on the transmission line theory, this paper simulates an actual 220kV single-core cable, considering the influence of skin effect and frequency variation of relative permittivity and conductivity of XLPE in different life stages, and then analyses and compares the attenuation characteristic of injection signal with different frequencies, which can provide a reference for the designing of high-precision reflected-wave-based measurement method.

articleTitle: Application of genetic algorithm in path planning of high-voltage transmission lines
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The path planning of high voltage transmission lines is affected by many factors. The planning of high voltage transmission lines is generally based on the experience of the staff and the simplified influencing factors in recent years. The purpose of this study is to comprehensive consideration of multiple influencing factors and combining with genetic algorithm to propose a smart high voltage transmission line path planning method. In the planning area, a variety of factors are converted into the construction cost of the transmission line, with the cost of the transmission line as the optimization goal, the initial path is randomly generated in the planning area to form the initial population, and the population is selected, crossed, and mutated. After iterating the prescribed algebra, the planned high voltage transmission line path is output in the planned area. Genetic algorithm can be applied to path planning of high voltage transmission lines while comprehensively considering multiple influencing factors. The experimental results show that in the planned area, the genetic algorithm can recommend low cost high voltage transmission lines. It provides a method of transmission line planning that comprehensively considers a variety of influencing factors and combines genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation of the space distribution characteristics of the leakage magnetic field in the transformer
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The power transformer is the key equipment of the power system. Statistics show that two types of winding defects, winding deformation and inter-turn short circuit, are main causes of transformer fault. Therefore, timely and effective online monitoring of winding defects is the basis for ensuring the stable operation of transformers. At present, online monitoring methods of winding defects such as vibration method and dissolved gas analysis have low sensitivity and cannot accurately identify defects. Previous research shows that winding defects will change the space distribution of leakage magnetic field, so monitoring leakage magnetic field provides a new idea for online monitoring of winding defects. In this paper, the finite element simulation model of transformer is constructed, and the space distribution characteristics of leakage magnetic field under different winding defects are obtained. The results show that there are obvious differences in the space distribution of leakage magnetic field under different winding defects. On this basis, the optimal arrangement scheme of leakage magnetic field sensor is proposed, and the performance requirements of the sensor is given that the measurement range of the sensor should include 0.06 1.1 T and the resolution should be better than 1 mT.

articleTitle: Analysis of harmonic current characteristics injected into unility grid by urean rail transit
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Non-liner electrical devices are heavily used in urban rail transportation, which is a typical case of the trend of power-electronics on the power demand side of new energy-dominant power system. Analysis of harmonic current injection caused by urban rail transportation is of great significance to the safety and stability of the power grid as well as power quality. Based on actual test data of a certain urban rail transportation, the electric power consumption throughout a whole day is analysed; harmonic current content as well as 95% probability of the 2nd to 25th harmonic currents is calculated; assessment with reference to the national standard limits is carried out; the correlation between dominant harmonic current and fundamental apparent power through curve fitting is revealed. Then, harmonic current content and potential risk caused by the no-load closing magnetizing inrush current are investigated. Finally, the key research issues on technology supervision and management of urban rail transportation harmonic current injection are discussed. The work of this paper may be a technical reference for the planning, operation, and harmonic current prevention of the increasing rail transportation in the new energy-dominant power system.

articleTitle: Injection principle based monitoring method of secondary circuit of zero-sequence current transformer in ungrounded distribution network
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: As the basis of grounding line selection in ungrounded distribution system, the zero-sequence current collected by zero-sequence current transformer is very important. By summarizing and analysing the abnormal problem of the secondary circuit of zero-sequence current transformer, a monitoring method of the secondary circuit of zero-sequence current transformer based on injection principle is proposed. This method can detect the secondary circuit without affecting the normal operation of the line, find the abnormal state of the circuit in time, and ensure the reliable operation of the secondary circuit. It effectively improve the correct rate of fault line selection in the ungrounded distribution network.

articleTitle: Voltage and current control of microgrid under unbalanced load
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: For the problem of the three-phase unbalanced load in the microgrid, a control strategy based on the delta-connected static synchronous compensator (SSC) is adopted to achieve both reactive power compensation and unbalanced load compensation at the same time. Firstly, the mathematical model of the delta-connected SSC is established to analyze the principle of SSC to compensate the unbalanced loads. Secondly, the control strategy of SSC is studied from three aspects, and the compensation current is accurately detected based on the instantaneous power reference current detection method. Using dc control method to control the output current, so that SSC can accurately output compensation current. In order to reduce the impact of the negative sequence current generated by the unbalanced load on the voltage of the dc side, balance control method is a dopted for dc side voltage, the active component is added to the reference current to balance the total voltage, and the zero sequence current isadded to the reference current. Thephase-to-phase voltage is balanced by means of sequencecurrent components. Finally,asimulation modelis established in the Matlab/Simulink environment to verify the relevant theoretical analysis and the proposed control strategy, the results show the effectiveness of the designed control strategy.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of three-phase PWM rectifier
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The cascade system of three-phase PWM rectifier and DAB resonant converter are widely used in the field of new energy power generation. Studying the impedance stability before and after the cascade is helpful to analyze the stability of new energy grid connection. In this paper, the small-signal impedance model of the cascade system is first established, and then the influence of the controller PI parameters on the system impedance stability is analyzed, and a method for optimizing the system impedance stability through the PI parameters is obtained.

articleTitle: Lifespan evaluation of polyimide films modified by nano-TiO2 based on weibull distribution and lognormal distribution
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The electrical lifespan data of polyimide (PI) films modified by nano TiO2 are dispersible due to the difference of preparation process and test environment. Among the existing studies on solid insulation lifespan evaluation, phenomenological models generally assume that the test data of the electrical equipment life obey a specific probability distribution based on intuition or some experiences, and it often is ignored that the accuracy of lifespan evaluation depends on whether the probability distribution model can accurately reflect the dispersibility of lifespan data. Therefore, in order to reduce the error caused by subjective factors on the selection of probability distribution model, PI films modified by nano-TiO2 with mass fraction of 3% and thickness of 25 μm were prepared in this paper. The lifespan distribution, failure probability distribution and density distribution function of lognormal distribution and Weibull distribution were compared. The median lifespan for the lognormal probability distribution model and the characteristic lifespan for the Weibull probability model were obtained by lifespan evaluation. It is found that the lifespan evaluation result of lognormal distribution is more radical than that of Weibull distribution. But, lognormal distribution is better than Weibull distribution model in evaluating the consistency of ageing mechanism for the samples under different voltages.

articleTitle: High voltage transmission line live working risk early warning method based on big data frequent itemset mining
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The complexity of power monitoring data is high, and the efficiency of early warning analysis is low due to the relevance of live line operation risk information. Therefore, a risk early warning method of live line operation of high voltage transmission line based on large data frequent itemset mining is proposed. According to the main contents of live line operation, the risk factors of live line operation are analyzed from static and dynamic aspects. Collect the defect and abnormal data of equipment related to live line operation, and mine the characteristic information of line operation state. The early warning level is divided into five levels, the early warning rule set is created, and the minimum threshold of support and confidence is designed. Using the iterative method of layer by layer search, the association rules are extracted according to the frequent itemsets, the matching historical records are found in the live working database, and the risk is warned. The analysis results of engineering examples show that the high-voltage transmission line live line operation risk early warning method based on big data frequent itemset mining can improve the accuracy and real-time of early warning, and is more applicable in engineering application.

articleTitle: Fault location method based on edge detection
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The fault location accuracy greatly affects the reliability of the power system. In this paper, a fault location method based on edge detection is proposed. Using Canny operator and Otsu threshold, different fault parameters can be adaptively selected according to different fault waveforms to achieve high-precision fault location. The fault location results of reduced-scale experiment and 110kV transmission line short-circuit fault show that the fault location method proposed in this paper has higher fault location accuracy than the wavelet fault location method based on the modulus maximum.

articleTitle: Research on ablation characteristics of XLPE Cable buffer layer based on electrothermal coupling method
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Ablative white spots are often been found on the buffer layer by disassembling high-voltage XLPE fault cables. To study the ablation characteristics of buffer layer, the white spot chemical elements in different positions of the buffer layer were analysed by using Energy Dispersive Spectrometer (EDS), and the conductivity of the white spots buffer layer were measured. The results of EDS showed that the white spots outside the buffer ablation area are the gouache precipitated by itself. The Conductivity measurements results showed that the precipitation of sodium polyacrylate reduces the conductivity of the buffer layerCwhich affected the local resistance heating when the overvoltage happened. Based on the experimental results of conductivity measurement, the electrothermal coupling simulation model of high voltage XLPE cable was established, and the heat generation characteristics of white spots buffer layer were calculated when the high frequency overvoltage happening. The simulation results show that the higher the overvoltage frequency is, the greater the resistance heating is generated and the higher the temperature is caused around the white spots buffer layer, finally it may be ablated by electric heating.

articleTitle: A robust estimation method of exponentially decaying DC component
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The accurate estimation of the magnitude and time constant of the decaying DC (DDC) component are important for enhancing the measurement data quality of power system marketing applications and the performances of power system control applications. It is a challenge to achieve the accurate DDC estimation in heavy noise condition. This paper proposes a new DDC estimation method based on the least-squares based polynomial fitting technology to improve the DDC estimation accuracy of noisy signal. Firstly, the magnitude and variation rate of the DDC component are estimated by fast polynomial fitting of the successive full-DFT estimation sequence which are computed recursively. Then the DDC time constant is derived using the estimated DDC magnitude and variation rate, and the estimated DDC magnitude is modified using the time constant-based compensation coefficient. The estimation bias of the DDC parameters can be iteratively reduced and the accurate estimation can be obtained. It is encouraging that, from the numerical test results, the magnitude and time constant errors of the proposed method are 8 times and 1000 times smaller than those of the other methods in heavy noise condition.

articleTitle: Application and analysis of reactive power regulation of synchronous condenser in weak power network
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the popularization and application of UHVDC long-distance transmission technology, the phenomenon of "strong DC and weak AC" is becoming more and more obvious, which leads to the reduction of short-circuit capacity of AC power grid, and the problems of reactive power impulse resistance and voltage stability of power grid are becoming more and more prominent.It has a great impact on the stable operation of the converter station and increases the commutation failure probability.Aiming at the characteristics of dynamic reactive power compensation and improving system short-circuit capacity of the synchronous condenser, the State Grid Corporation of China has put forward new applications for the field of the synchronous condenser, and analyzed its application background, reactive power regulation principle, control strategy and advantages of reactive power transmission and voltage stability in the converter station, and put forward the defects in the application of the current synchronous condenser, so as to perfect the research in the later stage.

articleTitle: Electric field calculation near corner tower of high voltage transmission line using unilateral periodic boundary condition
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: At present, the calculation of electric field near the corner tower of high voltage transmission line ignores the end effect of transmission line. However, in fact, the end effect of transmission line will affect the charge distribution on the transmission line calculation model. In view of this, this paper uses the charge simulation method to calculate the charge distribution of the high-voltage transmission line near the corner tower, and proposes to use the unilateral periodic boundary condition to eliminate the end effect of the transmission line, so as to improve the charge distribution on the transmission line calculation model. Compared with the existing electric field calculation methods around the corner tower, the results of the proposed method have a slight deviation, but the overall deviation is negligible, which verifies the existing electric field calculation methods near the corner tower.

articleTitle: Research on investment benefit quantitative evaluation system of regional AC/DC hybrid distribution system based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of new energy, new materials and power electronic technology, as well as the rapid development of the national economy and the continuous progress of production technology, users have higher and higher requirements for the quality of services provided by the power industry. Therefore, in order to improve the energy efficiency level of the distribution network, it is necessary to carry out quantitative evaluation and analysis of the investment benefits of the power grid in the stage of power grid planning and construction. In this paper, a method for evaluating the grid structure of DC distribution network based on AHP is proposed, and combined with different application scenarios of DC distribution network, the advantages of ring topology and radial topology of DC distribution system under different conditions are verified. The evaluation method proposed in this paper can quantitatively evaluate the system investment benefit in multi-level and multi-dimensional, and has good practicability.

articleTitle: Analysis method of cable body defects based on broadband impedance
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to study the faults and problems of power cables during operation, this paper proposes a method for analyzing the defects of the cable itself based on broad-band impedance. First, build a transmission line model based on transmission line theory,propose an improved method for capacitance testing method and test the parameters of the defective cable capacitance; then through the modeling of the defects of the cable itself, the types of different defects were compared;finally, analyze the changes in the amplitude and phase of the cable input impedance spectrum when there are serious defects in the cable. At the same time, the influence of different types of defects on the resonant frequency of the input impedance is studied, and the aging of the cable is characterized by the change of frequency.

articleTitle: Swelling mechanism of silicone coating on insulation of cable accessories
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The composite interface of cable and accessories insulation has long been in a complex environment of combined action of electricity, heat and moisture. The interface coating silicone characteristics play a key role in the interface reliability. In this paper, based on coating silicone grease on cable accessories, the effects of thermal, corona and wet aging on the swelling process of silicone grease on the surface of silicone rubber and the variation of silicone rubber properties after swelling were studied. The results showed that thermal aging, corona aging and wet aging accelerated the swelling of silicone grease. Thermal aging increases the diffusion rate of silicone grease in silicone rubber by increasing the relative motion between silicone grease and silicone rubber molecules. Corona aging destroys the crosslinking structure of silicone rubber by strong oxidants such as ozone and high energy charged particles, which promotes the swelling of silicone grease. Humid aging increases the polarity of silicone grease due to water absorption, and water molecules enter the rubber, which leads to deep swelling. Three kinds of aging destroyed the surface morphology of silicone and silicone rubber.

articleTitle: Research on corrosion effect of buried steel under leakage current of AC transmission line
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The corrosion of buried steel pipelines is becoming more serious because of the stress corrosion, stray current corrosion and other reasons(e.g. [1-2]). This paper aims to study the various alternating current (AC) interference densities on the stress corrosion cracking (SCC) behaviors of different sizes X80 steel samples in the simulated soil electrolyte environment by using an electrochemical method(e.g. [4-7]).

articleTitle: Design, development and test of a novel DC chopper for offshore wind power HVDC system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: DC chopper is one of the key technologies of offshore wind power voltage source converter based high voltage direct current (HVDC) systems, used to consume the system surplus power in case of onshore power grid failure. In this paper, a novel DC chopper topology structure is proposed. It combines the corresponding advantages of concentrated DC chopper and modular DC chopper. It can effectively solve the problem of direct series voltage balance of large-scale power devices and has the advantages of no water cooling system and low manufacturing cost. Then the detailed design and development of the modular solid-state switch based on integrated gate commutated thyristor (IGCT) and the concentrated dissipation resistor are presented, followed by the corresponding functional verification tests. Furthermore, the overall 120 kV DC chopper equipment is developed based on IGCT and finally achieved the ability to break 1.5 kA current in 500 Hz to dissipate 180 MW power at different duty ratios, which has reached the worlds leading level. And it is especially appropriate for offshore wind power HVDC system engineering application.

articleTitle: Coordinated control strategy of multi-type power coupling system participating in primary frequency regulation of AC-DC hybrid power grid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Wind power, photovoltaic (PV) power, thermal power and hydropower are connected to AC-DC power grid through the same power coupling point, which is common in North China. Such physical properties make it possible for multiple types of power sources to form a coupling system and behave as a large integrated power supply. How the coupling system participate in the primary frequency regulation (PFR) is a problem worthy of investigation. However, there is a lack of research in this field by now. In this paper, a coordinated control strategy of coupling system participating in PFR is proposed, that is, each power source separately measures the frequency and carries out PFR; the central controller of the coupling system is responsible for receiving related information of each power source, calculating and issuing the key parameters for each power source, such as the frequency control gain. A test system is established based on the actual regional power grid in Liaoning province, China. The simulation results under typical operating conditions verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy, which can realize the coordination of multiple power sources on the basis of ensuring the overall frequency regulation rapidity of the coupling system.

articleTitle: Safe distance test and altitude correction for live working with helicopter sling method on ±400kV DC transmission
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to provide a parameter basis for the application of helicopters in the live working of the ±400kV transmission line, and to ensure the safe development of the sling method helicopter live operation, a full-scale simulation was used to arrange the typical operating conditions in the sling method live operation process, and the ± switching impulse discharge test between live working gaps on ±400kV transmission lines, obtained the discharge characteristics of live working gaps under various typical working conditions, and clarified the lowest discharge position during the process of equipotential entry for sling method personnel, based on the calculation of the safe distance for live working on transmission lines The method ensures that the operation hazard rate is less than 10-5, and the minimum safe clearance distance for live working of the helicopter with the sling method of the ±400kV transmission line at the altitude of 5000 m and below was obtained.

articleTitle: Improvement of commutation failure predictive control considering AC voltage disturbance
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Commutation failure is one of the most common faults in HVDC system, and the predictive control of commutation failure is an important means to prevent commutation failure. In this paper, the disturbance mechanism caused by the AC filter to the predictive control of commutation failure is analyzed in detail from the aspects of discrete action characteristics and control principle of circuit breaker. And at the same time, the feasibility of control strategy improvement is also analyzed from the detection. In order to thoroughly solve the influence of slight AC system disturbance on commutation failure predictive control and HVDC transmission system, such as the input of AC filter,the characteristics of DC current variation during AC system disturbance and failure are analyzed, and the new electrical parameters are introduced as auxiliary criteria to improve the commutation failure predictive control principle. The simulation results show that, the optimized commutation failure predictive control has stronger ability to resist the disturbance of AC system, higher applicability to HVDC project, and is more conducive to the stable operation of HVDC system.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency evaluation and economic analysis of agricultural electric power substitute equipment in rural facilities
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The reform of agriculture and the development of electric energy have promoted the substitution of electric energy for rural agricultural facilities. The use of electric energy substitution equipment can improve economic benefits and reduce environmental pollution. Starting with the study of agricultural greenhouses and agricultural products drying, as well as photovoltaic and biogas power generation for heating, cooling and energy storage, a cold and thermal power system is formed.

articleTitle: Distributed autonomous control of microgrid based on finite-time algorithm
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The ever-increasing demand for more reliable and flexible energy supply for customers has pushed up the Microgrid (MG) to the center stage in the developments of distribution networks. If managed and control efficiently, MGs can provide distinct benefits to the suppliers as well as energy consumers. In this paper, a distributed autonomous control scheme is designed to achieve the optimal operation of MGs, as well as to replace the centralized control of MGs. For micro-sources, based on the necessary information exchanged with neighboring micro-sources in the MG, realize dynamic adjustment of power generation in the neighborhood of the optimal operating point by applying the finite-time control method. Simulation analysis shows that not only distributed control but also economical operation of the MG are achieved by proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Statistics and analysis of typical insulation faults in factory test of converter transformer
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Converter transformer was the key equipment in high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system. By the end of 2021, there are about more than 1000 converter transformers in operation in China, with different voltage rates from 200kV∼1100kV. It has been proved by operation experience that most of the converter transformer faults were caused by the quality defects of components, such as bushings, tap changers etc. The converter transformer faults due to insulation problems was rare, and most of those faults occur in the factory test stage. It can be concluded that those insulation test items of factory test can effectively assess the insulation quality of converter transformer. In this paper, the principle and methods to determine the insulation test level of converter transformer were also introduced firstly. The insulation test items of converter transformer were presented. Then, the typical insulation fault cases in the factory test of converter transformer in several HVDC projects were summarized and analyzed. Combined with typical insulation failure cases, this paper analyzed the causes of insulation failure from the aspects of design, raw materials, manufacturing process, etc. The measures to improve the insulation quality of converter transformer were put forward in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on passivity-based control with active damping control of three-phase converter in weak grid condition
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: To suppress the possible resonance of LCL filter in weak grid condition, a passivity-based control (PBC) strategy with active damping control is proposed. In this paper, the mathematical model of three-phase grid-connected converter in dq coordinate system is established, the PBC with different active damping schemes are introduced and analysed, and the controller is also designed. Then variant simulation results based on SIMULINK are also given in the paper, and the results show that the proposed method can improve the converter performance in weak grid condition, and the PBC with mixed active damping scheme has the best performance.

articleTitle: Research on capacity-increasing and transformation plan of port's shore-based power distribution network system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of load increase of typical port caused by the construction of ship shore power system, this paper studies the reconstruction plan of shore power system. First of all, the paper summarizes the specific situation of shore power in typical port. Then, the capacity expansion plan of shore power system is planed and the necessary measures for capacity expansion of the shore power system is constructed. Finally, not only the required steps of completion of shore power system is integrated, but the shore power system transformation program is also presented. The results of this paper have a certain application value.

articleTitle: Quantitative detection of SF6 decomposition components based on 7.46μm quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: During the long-term operation of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas equipment, various insulation defects inside the equipment will lead to the decomposition of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas. These decomposition products will react with trace H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> existing inside the equipment to generate SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> characteristic decomposition components such as SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Accurate detection of decomposition components such as SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> can effectively determine the operation state of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> equipment. As a new detection technology, tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS) detection technology has the advantages of high sensitivity, low detection limit and easy integration, which has great advantages in the power industry. In this paper, the TDLAS detection platform of SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is built, and the appropriate absorption band is selected according to the absorption characteristics of SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. It is found that the band can also be used for SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> detection. A method for simultaneous detection of SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> by a laser is proposed. It provides technical reference and support for the future development of SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> detection device based on tunable laser absorption spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Fault location method for MMC-HVDC transmission line based on adaptive optimal feature reconstruction
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Applying the regression mechanism of intelligent algorithm to transmission line fault location is a new research direction in recent years.The location accuracy of such methods largely depends on the feature selection of the training samples of the algorithm model.This paper proposes a feature extraction method that combines regression algorithm, waveform decomposition and optimization algorithm, which can adaptively extract optimal features according to training samples, thereby ensuring the location accuracy of the algorithm model to the greatest extent. Through the test in a MMC-HVDC transmission line simulation model, the optimal feature reconstruction method proposed in this paper can greatly improve the fault location accuracy of transmission line, and has good location performance in case of high resistance grounding fault.

articleTitle: Influence analysis and countermeasure research of dynamic characteristics of measurement system on bridge arm current differential protection in MMC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the action phenomenon of bridge arm current differential protection after AC fault recovery of a modular multilevel converter high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) project, the characteristics of differential current are analyzed.The influence of temporary block strategy and dynamic characteristics of measurement system on differential current are studied, and the mechanism of differential current and the reasons for the action of bridge arm current differential protection are revealed. Based on the real-time digital physics closed-loop simulation platform, the action phenomenon of bridge arm current differential protection in the field is reproduced and the influence of the dynamic characteristics of the measurement system on the bridge arm current differential protection of the bridge arm is analyzed. The optimization measures are proposed from two aspects: the dynamic performance of the measurement system and the configuration of bridge arm current differential protection . The research results provide technical support for the design of MMC-HVDC project and the impact assessment of dynamic performance of measurement system on MMC-HVDC protection.

articleTitle: Stability characteristics analysis and transmission capacity improvement of large-scale new energy base UHVAC sending system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy in power system, the safety and stability of large-scale new energy has become a common concern. Taking the transmission of ten million kilowatt new energy base in Zhangbei area through Zhangbei- Xiong'an 1000kV UHVAC transmission line as an example, this paper builds a PSASP electromechanical transient simulation model, which includes new energy model and distributed camera model with low voltage crossing function. The paper analyzes the constraints of the new energy transmission capacity, The influence of different configuration schemes on short circuit ratio of new energy and the suppression effect of transient overvoltage are studied. Finally, the optimization effect of transient overvoltage problem is verified by ADPSS all electromagnetic transient simulation. The results show that transient overvoltage and steady-state low voltage are the main factors restricting the transmission capacity. The distributed small-scale camera is installed at the generator end of the generator with low short circuit of new energy, which can effectively restrain the transient overvoltage problem and improve the overall output capacity of high-tech energy. The results of the study are of great reference value for planning, operation and design of the same kind of new energy delivery project in China.

articleTitle: Power grid partitioning methods based on improved GN splitting algorithm
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Considering the complex structure of the actual power grid, it is a key measure to partition the power grid reasonably to ensure the safe operation and effective control of the system. Existing methods for grid partitioning are relatively simple, and the accuracy of these methods are difficult to be guaranteed. This paper proposes a method by using improved GN splitting algorithm according to the idea of community detection. Firstly, using analytic hierarchy process (AHP) synthesized the active power betweenness and the voltage-weighted edge betweenness of the line, then defined the comprehensive weighted-edge betweenness based on index of two-factor. This betweenness is used to accurately describe the characteristics of the transmission line such as power flow, voltage and electrical distance. Secondly, using the consistency of flow direction and modularity function as evaluation indexes to verify the rationality of the partitioning results , and the entire partitioning process of the power grid is completed. The improved GN splitting algorithm reduce amount of calculation and increase the speed of area division. The test results of the IEEE 39-node system has verified effectiveness and practicality of this method.

articleTitle: The study of transmission line fault probability fuzzy model based on the ice disaster climate
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Power grid's weak links influence the safe operation of power system directly, this article will use the transmission line Fault probability fuzzy model based on the ice disaster climate to evaluate transmission lines weak links, so as to reduce the line fault. Firstly, the paper introduces the Fault probability fuzzy model; Then adopt the Pearson-III distribution curve to introduces the Fault probability fuzzy model under the ice disaster climate. The method in which the index of coherent value at risk is combined with the index of value at risk to evaluation the power gridfs weak links and the cascading failure model; Finally, the simulative results of IEEE 39-bus system show the reliability of the method. Through analysisCit is known that the method is better for power network planning and formulating preventive measures.

articleTitle: Application of three-phase voltage source PWM converter in mine electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The PWM converter has many excellent characteristics, in order to reflect the importance of three-phase voltage source PWM converters for the development of mine electric vehicle ,the working principle of the PWM converter is analyzed,the PWM converters can realize the AC and DC side control functions,V2G charging and discharging simulation model is built by using PSCAD software,the specific operating characteristics of PWM converter during charging and discharging are studied,through the analysis of the experimental data, the results show that the PWM converter can achieve unity power factor operation, and the harmonic pollution is small.

articleTitle: Passive filter design research in hybrid active filter design
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: There's an urgent need to apply active filter in HVDC project. The control strategy of active filter that imitating a resistor is effective to restrain the harmonic voltage. There are two strategies combined used: voltage feedback strategy and impedance offset strategy, which make the impedance of hybrid active filter extremely low at aim frequencies. The passive filter in hybrid active filter will influence the impedance finally reached. In this research, we designed several topologies of passive filter to design corresponding active filter. We calculated the impedance of each design, analysed the stability, simulate the filter performance and calculated the IGBT modules consumption. Besides, we calculated the equipment stable and transient rating voltage and current stress. Finally we concluded the suitable passive filter topology for hybrid active filter design.

articleTitle: Economic and technical analysis of reusing second-life EV batteries in energy storage system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Increasing number of electric vehicles on road has led to issues of handling of accumulating retired batteries. From practices in many countries with such a trend, to use those second-life EV batteries in energy storage system is becoming popular for solving waste handling and power supply securing at the same time. Though technical feasibility has already been verified, economic feasibility still seems to question the foundation of such a solution. This paper focuses on the economic and technical analysis of this solution based on engineering experience, compares and analyses the current technical approach and overall performance of energy storage system based on reusing second-life EV batteries, forecasts future technical trend and economic perspective of such system based on possible technical improvement and business mode of the market. At last, this paper gives a summary of how this special crossed industry could develop to a healthier cycling economy based on analysis above.

articleTitle: Grounding current distribution model and calculation of multi-loop high voltage cable
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Due to asymmetrical arrangement of multi-loop high-voltage cables and unequal distance of each section in cross-connection grounding, the induced voltage cannot be completely balanced, resulting in grounding current. When the grounding current is too large, it will affect the cable current-carrying capacity, increase the line loss and have a great influence on the cable, so the cable grounding current distribution is of great significance to the design and operation of the cable. In order to analyze the ground current distribution of multi-loop high-voltage cable, the induced voltage distribution and leakage current distribution of single-phase cable are analyzed through simulation and experiment, and the induced voltage and leakage current distribution model of single-phase cable is obtained. Secondly, the single-loop three-phase cross-interconnection system is built and the sheath grounding current is analyzed in the actual cable system. Finally, the grounding current distribution model of multi-loop cable system is obtained by simulating multi-loop three-phase cross-interconnection system.

articleTitle: A scalable FPGA hardware architecture based on crossbar for power electronics controller
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The FPGA is widely used in the power electronics controller to provide real-time control and parallel computing. The robustness and develop efficiency of FPGA affect the safe operation and development period of power electronic equipment, respectively. The existing works mainly focus on the FPGA hardware architecture oriented to one or several power electronic equipment. To improve the flexibility and scalability of FPGA in power electronics controller, this paper presents a novel hardware architecture based on crossbar, which can decouple different FPGA function modules. The proposed hardware architecture can significantly improve the FPGA scalable and accelerate the development period of power electronic equipment. A verification platform is also designed with the proposed hardware architecture. The implementation results show that the presented hardware architecture based on crossbar achieves better scalability and can decouple different function modules design, compared with the existing works.

articleTitle: Overvoltage and insulation coordination study for UHVDC transmission system that is hierarchically connected to 500kV and 1000 kV AC grids on line side
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Overvoltage and insulation coordination of converter station is one of the key technologies for UHVDC transmission project. The current level was upgraded to 6250A form 5000A, and the converter station was hierarchical access to 500kV and 1000kV AC grid in Shanghai Temple-Shandong and Ximeng-Taizhou DC project. We analyzed the major changes brought on insulation coordination, and calculated the level of protection and equipment insulation at each point. The design for insulation coordination was proofed to be reasonable through simulation calculation. The result of the research could provide important reference for equipment development of Shanghai temple - Shandong and Ximeng - Taizhou ±800 kV UHVDC project.

articleTitle: Research on non transient switching of capacitor bank based on electromechanical hybrid switch
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: When the capacitor is switched on, the main problem is that the residual current is not allowed to be switched on or closed, but it is often caused by the non switching of the capacitor. And pre breakdown and other inevitable problems are difficult to overcome by phase selection. In this paper, a new electromechanical hybrid switch is proposed to replace the general vacuum switch. Combined with the phase selection switching technology, the capacitor bank is switched for reactive power compensation to solve these problems, especially when the capacitor bank has residual voltage. Through theoretical analysis and simulation, the appropriate switching strategy is obtained to realize the non transient switching of the capacitor bank, The transient process when switching capacitor banks is avoided.

articleTitle: Research on topology and control of capacitor multiplexing modular multilevel converter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Based on the current research focus of lightweight modular multilevel converter (MMC), a capacitor multiplexing MMC (CM-MMC) with 100% utilization of capacitor is proposed in this paper. Compared with the conventional MMC, CM-MMC shares the same capacitor with a sub-module (SM) of the upper arm and a SM of the lower arm, and realizes "time-sharing multiplexing" of capacitor by controlling the newly introduced switches, which increases the utilization rate of capacitor from 50% to 100%, and decreases the number of capacitors by 50%. This paper uses nearest level modulation (NLM) method, and a capacitor voltage balancing strategy is designed to suppress the capacitor voltage deviation. Through the simulation results of MATLAB/Simulink, it is found that CM-MMC can successfully complete the mutual transformation between AC and DC of the system, and has excellent output characteristics. Moreover, compared with conventional MMC, the capacitor voltage unbalance degree and fluctuation rate of CM-MMC are declined, which can decrease the design requirements of capacitance. Therefore, the proposed CM-MMC can greatly reduce the weight and volume of the substation, and effectively realize the target of lightweight MMC substation.

articleTitle: A capacitive energy transfer high voltage DC/DC converter with active filtering arms
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The demand for integrating and transmitting a large amount of renewable energy over long distances continues to promote the development of high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmissions technology. For the upcoming need of HVDC grids, high voltage DC/DC converters are necessary to interconnect HVDC lines with different voltage levels. This paper proposes a nonisolated bidirectional DC/DC converter based on the capacitive energy transfer (CET) principle. The proposed converter is composed of only one energy buffering arm and two series-connected switches for energy transfer, moreover, one active filtering arm on each DC side to keep the current flowing smoothly and continuously. Thus, the proposed converter features lower cost, higher reliability, and greater potential for practical application. The operation principle and parameter design are shown in detail. The control scheme with equal amplitude mode for energy balancing and voltage/power adjusting is investigated. The feasibility of the proposed converter is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Influence of equipotential bonding on the lightning transient characteristics of high-speed railway grounding system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: When lightning strikes the communication tower of high-speed railway, the transient ground potential rise (GPR) and ground potential difference (GPD) are important reasons for the damage of signal and power supply equipment in the control room. In this paper, the equivalent circuit model of high-speed railway communication tower and control room ground grid including control room reinforcement conductor is established. The transient ground potential rise and the maximum transient ground potential difference of the control room ground grid are calculated by the time domain method in ATP-EMTP under the two conditions of two ground grids independent arranged or common arranged. The effects of reinforcement material characteristic on the GPR and GPD are also discussed. The calculation results show that equipotential bonding can reduce the maximum GPD between the control room ground grid and the communication tower ground grid. Moreover, the maximum GPD between different locations of the control room ground grid is significantly reduced after considering the potential equalization of the control room reinforcement conductor.

articleTitle: Effect of space charge accumulation on electric field distribution of high voltage cable
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Space charge location and amount are key factors affecting the local insulation performance. This work focuses on the effect of space charge distribution and charges accumulation amount on the electric field distribution of HVDC cables. In the experiment, the dielectric properties and the conductivity properties of the specimen from the operating cable are measured. The simulation model of the electric field of HVDC cables is established, and the effect of charge accumulation on the electric field in the insulation layer are calculated. The experimental results indicate that the dielectric constant of the XLPE cable insulation layer gradually decreases with temperature, from 2.43 at room temperature to 2.21 at 90°C. Conductivity increases with temperature from 5.23×10-15S/m at room temperature to 1.58×10-12S/m at 90°C. The experimental parameters are brought into the simulation model and the calculation results show that the maximum electric field of the insulation layer increases from 24.5 kV/mm to 26.2 kV/mm when the positive charges accumulate between the insulation layer and the inner semi-conductive layer, and it decreases to 22.8 kV/mm when the negative charge accumulate.

articleTitle: Research on arc extinguishing chamber electric field optimization and breaking characteristics of 252kV highspeed circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: High-speed circuit breaker can significantly shorten the breaking time and reduce the impact of short-circuit current, which is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of power grid. 252kV high-speed circuit breaker is taken as the research object, the design scheme of solid and hollow static arc contacts is proposed, the electric field distribution of arc extinguishing chamber is optimized, and the optimal relative position of moving end shielding cover and moving arc contacts is determined. The flow field under the condition of 50kA is studied in the model of arc chamber after electric field optimization. The results show that the maximum electric field intensity between hollow contacts is greater than that between solid contacts under the same opening distance, so solid static arc contacts should be adopted. The relative displacement of the moving shield cover and arc contact is determined to be 35mm as the best shielding scheme. the maximum pressure in the arc extinguishing chamber is 2.33Mpa and the maximum temperature is 26126K during arc burning, which appear on the surface of static arc contact. The results can provide a theoretical basis for the mechanism design and breaking characteristics of high-speed circuit breaker.
