articleTitle: A novel partial discharge pattern recognition for GIS with unbalanced sample based on conditional variational autoencoder
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Deep learning has been widely used in gas insulated switchgear (GIS) partial discharge (PD) pattern recognition with its powerful ability to automatically extract features. As a typical data-driven model, the diagnostic performance of deep learning methods will decrease with the reduction of the training sample size, resulting in lower recognition rates for minority class samples. In actual situation, the probability of failure of various insulation defects in GIS is not the same, so that the samples of various types of defects obtained in practical applications cannot maintain a balanced distribution. To solve the problem of class imbalance among training samples, this paper proposes an improved variational autoencoder (VAE) to augment the minority class fault samples. The PD signal is first converted into a time-spectrogram with high time-frequency resolution by S transform. Then use conditional AE to perform directed augmentation on unbalanced class samples. Finally, the obtained balanced data set is input into convolutional neural network to complete the fault diagnosis of PD. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves excellent recognition results under various unbalanced conditions, indicating that it has strong tolerance and high generalization ability for unbalanced samples.

articleTitle: Voltage stability control of DC microgrid for off-road hybrid electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: For off-road hybrid electric vehicles (HEV) with special purpose, the powertrain is required to not only supply mechanical driving power to achieve high mobility, but also provide high-power electrical energy for mission payload, benefiting from coordination of engine, generator, motor, planetary gear set, battery, super capacitor, and DC/DC convertor. Essentially, powertrain of off-road HEV is a typical DC microgrid. However, stability of DC bus is faced with great challenges induced by random, fast, and intense ground drag disturbance in multimode driving conditions and stochastic electrical load by different mission profile as well. To solve this problem, a voltage stability control strategy for DC microgrid of off-road HEV is proposed in this paper. A stochastic control problem containing Ito's stochastic differential equations is established and a new multi-objective cost function considering bus voltage, engine response and fuel consumption is proposed. The stochastic optimal control problem is transformed into a deterministic optimal control problem using first-order moment and secondorder moment, and the optimal power distribution is solved using a disturbance feedback control law. Compared with the rulebased strategy, this strategy can effectively suppress the sharp drop of bus voltage and reduce the impact of randomness on the system.

articleTitle: Variable spark gap detection system for suspension porcelain insulator string
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Through analyzing the application status of spark gap detection technology of suspension porcelain insulator string, the variable spark gap detection method and system in view of the high miss rate of fixed spark gap detection method were put forward . The typical data of distributed voltage of each insulator in different types of insulator strings were obtained from simulation calculation and actual measurement. Through the gap discharge test, the gap distance of spark electrode corresponding to different voltage values were obtained. The spark gap detection device with automatic adjustment of electrode gap was used to detect the variable spark gap of suspension porcelain insulator, which can take the methods of manual detection, UAV carrying detection, self climbing or self falling device automatic detection, etc. In the detection process, the spark electrode gap was automatically adjusted. According to the position of the insulator in the string and different distributed voltages, the corresponding spark electrode gap distance was adopted to detect piece by piece, which greatly improves the detection accuracy of low resistance insulators. The use of UAV carrying detection and automatic detection by self climbing or self falling devices can also greatly reduce the labor intensity and safety risk of operators.

articleTitle: Orderly charging strategy of charging stations based on dynamic time-sharing charging price response
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Currently, the phenomenon of idle charging facilities and charging queue coexist. The difficulty in charging electric vehicles and the low utilization rate of charging facilities have become a new contradiction. After investigating and analyzing the travel habits and charging characteristics of various electric vehicles, this article summarizes the construction of urban public charging stations and bus-specific charging stations, establishes a mathematical model that aims at the lowest charging cost for enterprise users. Formulate the dynamic service price guidance mechanism with the output reverse incentive of green new energy such as wind power and photovoltaic, and simulate and analyze the impact of load fluctuation under the time-of-use price response, dynamic service price response and orderly charging mode. The results prove the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Dual-mode frequency control of PV systems based on large disturbance identification
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Grid frequency supports, e.g., the virtual inertia control (VIC) and the frequency damping control (FDC), of photovoltaic (PV) systems, are more demanded than ever before. To improve the frequency quality in terms of important features, i.e., the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) and the frequency nadir, the dual-mode control has been proposed in the literature. The VIC and FDC are respectively implemented in different stages of the control process. For such a control method, the switching threshold between the control modes should be properly designed, where the grid operation characteristic and actual frequency dynamic should be considered. In this context, a novel dual-mode frequency control of PV systems is proposed in this paper. The virtual inertia mode (VIM) and frequency damping mode (FDM) of the dual-mode control are introduced at first. Then, a historical-data-based large disturbance identification method is realized to identify the switching threshold between two modes, which is obtained by the confidence interval. With the proposed method, the frequent switching between the control modes can be avoided, and the frequency support performance in the grids with different inertia levels is guaranteed. Simulation results validate the proposed dual-mode control method with large disturbance identification.

articleTitle: Research and application of array silicone rubber anti-bird baffle
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In recent years, the tripping faults of high-voltage transmission lines induced by bird damage have shown an upward trend. The anti-bird thorns, PVC anti-bird baffles, anti-bird windmills and electronic bird repellents used in the early transmission lines have been unable to meet the new bird-proof requirements. The original method has loopholes in insulation and discharge of bird droppings discharge channels. For example, the PVC anti-bird baffles age quickly, and they are installed above the truss cross-arms to prevent drone inspections and staff to perform insulator string maintenance. In addition, it cannot be used in combination with the early anti-bird thorns. The new characteristics of bird damage show that bird nests that cause bird damage are built in new “five upper” positions, namely: above the insulator, above the bow wire, above the anti-bird thorn, above the V-shaped string, and the overhead ground wire support. The hidden danger of bird damage is manifested in the leakage of the main insulator and the short circuit of the conduction-ground channel of the current bird droppings. According to the Eighteen Major Anti-Accident Measures of State Grid Corporation of China (2020 Revised Edition) and the insulating space around the insulator and the main space for bird droppings excreted by bird damage, this paper develops an array-type silicone rubber anti-bird baffle to Solve the new “five upper” bird's nest problem. It mainly adds the isolation layer of the truss cross arm, which can effectively block and cut off the flashover channel formed by the arc of bird droppings, and effectively prevent the occurrence of bird damage tripping accidents by changing the bird excretion path and channel above the insulator.

articleTitle: Analysis of disturbance to secondary cable caused by single-phase grounding fault in typical 10kv distribution network
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: When a single-phase grounding fault occurs in the 10 kV distribution network, the ground potential rise caused by the current injected into ground will affect the reliable operation of the adjacent secondary cables. The authors carried out a single-phase grounding fault test at a typical 10 kV distribution network true test site. This paper analyzes the ground potential rise near the grounding point and its disturbance to secondary cables laid in the ground when a single-phase grounding fault occurs in a 10kV distribution network. The current injected into the ground is measured by a current probe. Through the CDEGS simulation software, the ground potential differences between the injection point as well as the observation points and the voltage reference point are obtained, and the disturbance voltage between coaxial cable core and shielding layer is obtained. The simulation results are consistent with the test results. Through simulation, the influence of factors such as soil resistivity as well as the distance between on-site cabinet and inject point on the disturbance voltage of the secondary cable is analyzed. The research results provide support for the design of the power corridor of the urban distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on energy system design and energy management technology of solar airship
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Energy system technology is one of the key technologies of solar airships. The performance of the energy system has an important impact on whether the airship can fly normally and achieve the scheduled mission. In view of the requirements of the solar airship's long-term airship and complex flight conditions on the energy system. This thesis has carried out research on energy system design and energy management technology, and designed an energy system scheme suitable for solar airships. The energy system solution integrates solar arrays, battery packs and wind power generation, which greatly enhances the wind resistance and occupancy capabilities of the airship, and improves the reliability and energy balance of the system. In this thesis, combining the characteristics of the energy system and the flight mission, the optimal control strategy of the energy management system is proposed. This control strategy realizes the dynamic dispatch of airship energy and the optimal proportion configuration of each energy source, and realizes the maximum utilization of airship energy and lightweight design.

articleTitle: Analysis of infrared general measurement results of composite insulators in operation on 220 KV transmission line
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Silicon rubber composite insulator is favoured by power system because of its excellent anti-pollution flashover performance. Among them, the core rod is an important structural component to bear the mechanical load of composite insulator. In recent years, there have been many brittle fracture faults of composite insulators in China, which directly affect the reliability of transmission lines. The composite insulator is usually accompanied by abnormal heating during the aging process. As an effective live detection method, infrared temperature measurement can find the defects of composite insulator in time and reduce the occurrence of string breaking accidents. In this paper, the infrared general measurement results of composite insulators in operation of 220kV transmission line are analysed to verify the effectiveness of infrared detection and accumulate field experience. The results show that infrared general measurement can effectively detect abnormal heating composite insulators, and its detection results can correctly reflect the operation state of composite insulators, timely find the internal defects of composite insulators, and effectively improve the operation and maintenance efficiency. With the increase of service life, the number of abnormal heating of insula-tors gradually increases, showing a good linear relationship.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of the state of UHV transformer bushing based on multi-parameter information
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Because the fact that only a single signal sensing method is used in the most of the UHV transformer bushing, this way can not accurately determine theis type of the bushing failure. Thus, a method for evaluating the state of the UHV transformer bushing based on multi-parameter information is proposed in the paper. First, as the initial one-dimensional features, the partial discharge, temperature, humidity and leakage current data are obtained by installing four different types of sensors on the bushing tap. Based on this, two-dimensional and three-dimensional features are constructed. Then, the Lasso algorithm is used for feature optimization, which overcomes the misjudgement caused by the poor generalization performance of the evaluation model and the overfitting caused by the too high model complexity. Finally, the optimal features are used as the input of the comprehensive fuzzy evaluation model, combined with the membership matrix and the weight coefficient, so as to quantitatively evaluate the running state of the UHV transformer bushing. Through the analysis of the evaluation results, the status of the bushing can be effectively judged and estimated in the evaluation model. These can be provided an effective reference for improving the assessment accuracy of the UHV transformer bushing.

articleTitle: Stepwise estimation of harmonic state based on hybrid measurement
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Nonlinear loads such as power electronic devices are applied in distribution network, resulting in a sharp rise in harmonic levels. In order to evaluate the harmonic state of distribution network, a stepwise estimation method of harmonic state based on hybrid measurement is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the nonlinear state estimation equation based on the SCADA measurement data is solved by hybrid genetic algorithm. The estimation result and the PMU measurement data are used as the measurement to establish the linear estimation equation, then the second optimization is performed by the robust least square method to obtain harmonic state of each node in the distribution network. This method not only makes full use of SCADA measurement data in the distribution network to improve the redundancy, but also takes into account the linearity of PMU measurement equation to improve the accuracy of harmonic state estimation. Finally, the simulation analysis based on IEEE-13 node system verifies the rationality and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on ZnO-based electric field adaptively controlled structure in power electronic module
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Nonlinear composite (NC) shows promising prospect on addressing the problem of local electric field concentration in power electronic modules. In this paper, ZnO microvaristors/silicone rubber (SiR) composite is prepared to construct the electric field adaptively controlled structure in power electronic module. The influence of two factors, the nonlinear parameters of the NC and the length of the structure, on the electric field distribution has been studied by simulation. It is found that the electric field concentrates at the edge of the upper copper layer to the silicone gel, the triple junctions of metal-ceramic-silicone gel of the upper and lower copper layers and the triple junction of metal-base plant-silicone gel. When the electric field adaptively controlled structure is applied, the points of electric field concentration move from the end of the copper layer to the end of NC and the highest electric field intensities of the points decrease significantly. It shows the best electric field controlling effect when the nonlinear conductivity of the NC is S1 and length of the electric field adaptively controlled structure is 2.0 mm. The electric field intensities of the points can be limited below 10 kV/mm.

articleTitle: Parameter selection and experimental study of AC line arrester with external series gap at high altitude area
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to reduce the lightning flashover rate of transmission lines, it is necessary to install high-altitude line arresters in the vulnerable tower and phase. A series of key technical research, such as the structural design and parameter selection of the high-altitude AC line arrester, has been carried out, including the performance parameter research of the line arrester and the discharge voltage requirements of the line arrester series gap. The product design of line arrester is carried out, and the sample is developed. The sample of line arrester is tested to determine the product type, structure and parameter requirements of highaltitude AC line arrester. According to the special requirements of high-altitude application environment, the research on the discharge characteristics of line arrester with external series gap at high altitude is carried out. On the basis of the sample of developed high-altitude line arrester and the relevant performance test in low altitude area, the test items are completed in the Tibet high altitude test base at 4300m altitude. High-altitude line arrester is of great significance to ensure the safe operation of the line and reasonably coordinate the technology and economy of the project.

articleTitle: Optimization design of amorphous metal distribution transformer based on improved quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: As an energy-saving and environmentally friendly power distribution equipment, amorphous metal core distribution transformer (AMDT) has a huge market. The designing efficiency and main material cost of AMDT play an important role in improving the competitiveness and economic benefit of transformer manufacturers. Based on Visual Basic 6.0 software, AMDT was taken as the object of optimization design, and the main material cost of AMDT was taken as the objective function of optimization. Compared with the results obtained by the original design scheme, particle swarm optimization (PSO), quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO), and improved quantum particle swarm optimization (IQPSO) after optimizing the design variables, the results Shown that the IQPSO provides a much minimized solution and computation time than the other three kinds of methods. The feasibility and effectiveness of the IQPSO algorithm during the optimal design of AMDT are verified.

articleTitle: Research on fault characteristics and protection strategy of LCC-VSC cascade hybrid HVDC system on receiving end
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: LCC-VSC Hybrid HVDC transmission technology is a hot development direction in recent years. The scheme of LCC-VSC cascade at the receiving end can improve the flexibility of HVDC system, reduce the probability of commutation failure, and drive the development of new HVDC transmission technology. Due to the VSC, the fault characteristics of Hybrid HVDC system change greatly compared with conventional HVDC projects. The conventional protection strategy can not ensure the safety of DC system and equipment. Based on a real LCC-VSC Hybrid HVDC project and the real control and protection devices, a complete real-time digital simulation platform is built. The transient characteristics of different faults such as DC line fault, DC filter fault and VSC area fault are studied. According to the fault characteristics, the protection strategy of Hybrid HVDC topology is studied and verified by the real-time digital simulation platform. The research results show that the protection strategy can quickly and accurately detect and isolate faults, effectively reduce equipment voltage and current stress during faults, prevent equipment damage, and greatly improve the reliability of Hybrid HVDC system. The research results have been applied in Baihetan-Jiangsu 800kV LCC-VSC Hybrid HVDC transmission project.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics of partial discharge from typical defects of high voltage cables
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: High voltage cables are one of the indispensable equipment in power transmission and distribution. The partial discharge characteristics of high voltage cables can provide guidance for cables status assessment and maintenance. A partial discharge testing is carried out for four typical defects that may occur in high voltage cables. After that, three parameters of the partial discharge are extracted and discussed, the discharge magnitude, the pulse amplitude and the rise time. The dynamic withstand voltage characteristics of partial discharge induced by typical defect types of the high voltage cables are summarized. The results indicate that the dynamic withstand voltage characteristics of partial discharge induced by different defective are quite different, and the variation trends and variation intervals of different characteristic parameters are obviously discriminate. Based on the analysis and comparison of the dynamic withstand voltage characteristics of partial discharge for the high voltage cables, the defect type of the cables can be effectively identified, which has reference significance for the pattern recognition of partial discharge and the evaluation of cables status.

articleTitle: Method of identification of transient instability mode based on the ratio of generators transmission power limitations to rated capacities
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Transient angle instability and transient voltage instability are usually mixed and coupled in transient instability scenarios in complex grid. In this context, this paper provides a quantitative analysis method of the identification of dominant mode of transient instability in complex grid based on the ratio of generator transmission power limitation to its spinning capacity (TPLR). Differently from most existing work that analyzes the mechanism on the dominant mode of transient instability through direct method such as characteristic root which has low applicability for analyzing, an assessment method is conducted here through time-series simulation that specifically considers the limitation of transmission power of key generator under different installed scale. The transient instability mode can be identified based on the curve of TPLR, i.e. the ratio of transmission power limitation to the spinning capacity. The method is demonstrated on a complex transmission network with transient voltage instability and transient angle instability scenarios. The simulation results help verify the accuracy and applicability of the provided transient instability mode identification method.

articleTitle: Orderly charging strategy of electric vehicles in response to charging price in residential subdivisions
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Under the traditional construction mode of residential quarters, the installation of charging piles is difficult and the supporting investment is large. In order to solve this problem, combining the travel habits and charging characteristics of electric vehicle users in residential communities, a mathematical model based on the lowest charging cost of users is established, and a penalty factor for the capacity of the distribution transformer of the super cell is introduced. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to simulate and analyze the load fluctuation under three modes: disordered charging, time-of-use price response orderly charging and dynamic service price response orderly charging. Aiming at the charging piles for public and personal parking spaces in residential quarters, an orderly charging plan for installing charging piles in residential quarters parking spaces is proposed, which provides guidance and suggestions for the practical application of charging for electric vehicles in residential quarters in the future.

articleTitle: Study on the difference of fault detection effect of AC leakage current live test technology under operating voltage on different insulating parts of MOA
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Resistive current live test plays an important role in the technical supervision of metal oxide arrester (MOA). At the same time, there are some conditions that MOA can not find hidden dangers and defects through AC leakage current live test. This paper puts forward an assumption: the AC leakage current live test technology under operating voltage has different fault detection effects on different insulating parts of MOA. It is found that in the overall AC leakage current composition of the arrester, the resistance sheet and porcelain jacket account for a large proportion, and the proportion of FRP core insulating support rod and epoxy resin insulating cylinder is very small, so the AC leakage current test under operating voltage can effectively detect the faults on the resistance sheet and porcelain jacket, and it is difficult to detect the insulating support rod Fault on insulating cylinder (or insulating package). This study clears a blind spot of the safe operation of the arrester, provides a reference for the condition based maintenance of the arrester, and improves the operation and maintenance level of the arrester.

articleTitle: Lightning protection on the large crossing section of single circuit ±800kV UHVDC and double circuit of 500kV transmission lines erected on the same tower
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: For ±800kV UHVDC project, due to the limitation of corridor, some sections need ±800kV and 500kV AC lines to be erected on the same tower. When at the large crossing section ±800kV DC transmission line and 500kV line are on the same tower, the height of the tower is further increased, and the lightning area is increased, so it is important to research the lightning protection and adopt proper lighting protection measures. In this paper, the lightning protection scheme is determined by the criteria that the safe operation years of large crossing section of UHVDC project under lightning overvoltage shall not be less than 50 years. Based on Chizhou large crossing section that is erected in the mode of UHVDC and EHVAC transmission lines on the same tower of the UHVDC project from Baihetan to Jiangshu, the lightning shielding failure outage rate and back flashover outage rate were given, and the flashover outage rate while lightning stroke on the grounding wire in the middle of the large crossing section. Based on the results of the lightning overvoltage calculated above, the lightning protection measures were proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of system stability as affected by under-excitation limiter under a brushless high initial response excitation system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper presents the mechanism analysis of the dynamic stability about superimposed under-excitation limiter (UEL), used in a brushless high initial response (HIR) excitation system. A single-machine infinite-bus model is derived by using the synchronous machine model with the brushless (HIR) excitation system model (IEEE Type AC2C) and a superimposed multisegment UEL. Based on the linearized model, the relation between the auxiliary damping torque (?MD2) provided by UEL and the pertinent parameters of UEL is extracted. With the damping torque analysis (DTA) technique and superposition principle, it is shown that the dynamic stability of the system can be affected by the value of the slope of the boundary curves (KU) effectively. Additionally, the mechanism analysis shows the influence of the proportional gain (KP) and the integral gain (KI) of UEL on the damping torque of system. Then, results of the frequency-domain and time-domain simulations on a single machine connected to a large system are presented which confirm the conclusions of mechanism analysis.

articleTitle: Transient voltage measurement for UHV AC substation using non-contact electro-optic field sensor
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The transient voltage measurement for UHV AC substation is significantly important for the insulating of electric equipment. This paper proposed an improved non-contact field sensor. A y-cut z-propagation lithium niobate (LN) crystal is used as electrooptic crystal and the type of common path interferometer is adopted. Two plate electrodes are placed between the LN crystal parallel to x-axis, which decreases the signal induced by the electric filed from the undesired direction. The sensor was verified by laboratory experiments, and it has good performance under different waveform and frequency. The sensor was applied to measure the switching transient voltage in a UHV AC substation during the system tests. the waveforms of transient voltage during breaker-closing and -opening processes were obtained and compared with the waveforms from CVT. The results showed that the sensor could measure the transient voltage with high accuracy, which can be used to monitor the voltage for UHV AC project.

articleTitle: Research on the reliability theory and lifetime prediction model of IGCT gate driver
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Integrated gate commutated thyristor (IGCT) is a kind of core power semiconductor device in high-power applications such as renewable energy power generation and DC grids, which has competitive characteristics of high blocking voltage, large capacity and low loss. The existing theories and experiments show that gate driver is the key to the reliability of IGCT. Thus, in this paper, the reliability theory and lifetime prediction model is carefully researched. First, the failure mechanisms and failure modes of key components and printed circuit board of IGCT gate driver are analyzed. Based on that, the reliability models of key components such as capacitors, MOSFETs and solder joints in gate driver are built, followed by the overall reliability model of gate driver. Then the lifetime of IGCT gate driver under typical working conditions of DC grids is calculated, which is above 30 years. And the aluminum electrolytic capacitor is the crucial factor affecting the lifetime of gate driver. Finally, some optimization methods are proposed to lead the future design of IGCT gate driver.

articleTitle: Droop control strategy with amplitude limiting function for microgrid energy storage system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The energy storage system in microgrid usually adopts droop control strategy. When the diesel engine is connected to the grid, the operation power of the microgrid will change in a short time, and the operation mode of the energy storage power converter will also respond to the change. At this time, the traditional droop control cannot well adapt to it. The objective of this paper is to propose a droop control strategy with amplitude limiting function to improve the system operation stability after diesel engine is connected to the grid, avoiding the system transient impact caused by the operation mode switching of energy storage system. Firstly, this paper introduces the proposed amplitude limiting droop control strategy. Then, a simulation model based on Simulink is build, and simulation is carried out. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy does not need to consider the switching time synchronization between bidirectional ACDC control strategy and energy storage charge discharge control strategy. In case of unexpected failure and sudden exit of diesel generator during battery charging, its control mode will automatically switch to droop constant voltage mode, which can still maintain the stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: High-power electric propulsion wide-voltage power processing unit technology
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In response to the needs of high-power electric propulsion systems for power processing units that can adapt to a wide range of voltages and can achieve high-efficiency conversion throughout the range, this thesis plans to research on the technology of high-power electric propulsion wide-voltage power processing unit. This thesis proposes an isolated widevoltage flexible mainstream combined converter and its control method. By optimizing the number of series series on the secondary side of the dual-bridge topology, the stress of the device is reduced. By embedding a lossless spike absorption diode on the secondary side, the resonant voltage spike of the rectifier diode is effectively reduced. Through the optimized design of the smooth switching control strategy, the adjustment range of the converter is broadened. Through the control strategy of the in-phase shift switch of the leading bridge, the current sharing of the converter is realized and the power density of the converter is improved. The prototype developed in this thesis has an input voltage of 80-120V, an output voltage of 500-1500V, a rated power of 5kW, and a conversion efficiency of up to 95%, which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the related technology.

articleTitle: Line to line DC fault protection strategy of AC/DC hybrid transmission system containing MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to further analyze the fault characteristics of AC/DC hybrid transmission system containing MMC-HVDC,Based on the topology of AC/DC hybrid transmission system and modular multilevel converter(MMC), the mathematical model of MMC is derived ,The fault mechanism and characteristics of line to line DC fault are studied.Aiming at line to line DC fault of AC-DC hybrid transmission system with MMC-HVDC, a fault protection scheme combining current limiting circuit, locked-converter station and AC circuit breaker trip is designed.Based on Xiamen MMC-HVDC project,AC-DC hybrid system is built in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the protection scheme is simulated and verified.The results show that the proposed protection strategy can effectively reduce the fault current and improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on surficial electric field of HVDC transmission lines based on the inversion method
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: To abandon the empirical formula applied to evaluate the corona onset value and investigate the surficial electric field on the corona conductors, the authors present an inversion algorithm to reconstruct the surficial electric field intensity from the measured data. The original ion flow field problem is reformulated into a PDE constrained optimization problem and the traditional nested-loop method is extended to solve this problem. Numerical results show that the proposed approach is robust to the noise occurred in the measurements. This approach can be applied to investigate the surficial field distribution of the HVDC transmission lines with complex configuration.

articleTitle: Research on electric energy scheduling method of street lamp load group based on photovoltaic power generation and battery
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to optimize the power consumption management of the street lamp load group in the highway network, reduce the power supply pressure of the State Grid on the highway, reduce the large power consumption value of the highway in the late peak hours, so as to enhance the stability of the power grid. At the same time, in order to effectively use clean energy (solar photovoltaic cells) for power generation and reduce environmental pollution, this paper proposes a street lamp load group power dispatching method based on photovoltaic and battery. That is, the authors construct the basic electric energy management system architecture of street lamp load group, use particle swarm optimization algorithm, take the minimum power consumption of power supply company and the highest photovoltaic utilization rate of load group as the basic goal, and take into account the service life and cost of battery, put forward a multi-objective electric energy scheduling scheme for street lamp load group, obtain the optimal solution, and carry out simulation verification by Monte Carlo method. It shows the rationality of the power dispatching method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Influence of distributed photovoltaic access on power quality of distribution network and countermeasures in new power system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: China's distributed photovoltaic power generation projects will show blowout growth in recent years. The access of a large number of distributed photovoltaic will bring new challenges to the stability and power quality of the power grid. Starting from the operation characteristics of distributed photovoltaic, this paper analyzes the power quality emission characteristics of photovoltaic in detail and the impact of photovoltaic grid connection on the power quality of distribution network, such as harmonic, three-phase imbalance, voltage fluctuation and so on. Finally, the Countermeasures of the impact of distributed photovoltaic access on the power quality of distribution network are proposed from the perspective of supporting power grid planning, operation and management.

articleTitle: Analysis, design and experiment of MMC based on 6500V IGCT-PLUS device
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Integrated-Gate-Commutated Thyristor (IGCT) devices with the block voltage up to 6500V have been manufactured. Its application in modular multilevel converter (MMC) can significantly reduce the number of modules to optimize the converter. This paper firstly discusses the influence of increasing the rated voltage of modules on MMC characteristics such as the number of modules, dc support capacitance, weight, volume, cost, loss, harmonic. The rated parameters and component of module are designed based on IGCT-plus device of 6500V and 3800A. On this basis, the loss of the converter is analyzed by means of average equivalent method, and compared with that of MMC based on 4500V-IGCT and IEGT. Finally, both highcurrent switch-off and power-cycling running tests are carried out to verify the performance of designed module. The result shows that MMC module based on 6500V-IGCT has good stability and reliability. It has reference value for the application of IGCT with higher block voltage in MMC, thus improving power density and technical economy of MMC.

articleTitle: Research on overvoltage protection of adjacent distribution network by lightning striking plant grounding network dissipation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to study the lightning strike plant grounding network scattered flow on the adjacent distribution network overvoltage protection, the establishment of the installation of extended lead, the laying of vertical grounding body and the installation of isolation belt three plant and adjacent distribution line overvoltage protection model, analysis of the 10 kV distribution line and the adjacent plant grounding network spacing, soil resistivity and lightning current amplitude on the adjacent plant line lightning overvoltage impact, and compared the diversion method and insulation spacing method protection effect. The research results show that: the installation of extended lead, the laying of vertical grounding body and the installation of isolation belt can effectively reduce the distribution line overvoltage, the installation of extended lead voltage reduction effect is the best, voltage reduction efficiency is stable in more than 20%; distribution line and the adjacent plant grounding network spacing and soil resistivity has a great impact on the voltage reduction efficiency after protection, but the lightning current amplitude has little impact on the voltage reduction efficiency after protection. The research results can provide reference for the overvoltage protection of distribution lines when the actual lightning strikes the plant.

articleTitle: Simulation of reactance of built-in reactor in power transformer with field-circuit coupling method
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Using low-voltage winding series built-in reactor in power transformer was one of the effective methods to improve the impedance of transformer. It was useful and benefit for the impedance selection and design of power transformer by researching on the simulation calculation of leakage reactance under the normal operation and short-circuit fault condition of transformer with built-in reactor. In this paper, a finite element model was established based on the structural parameters of an actual power transformer with built-in reactor. The leakage magnetic field and leakage inductance parameters of the teansformer with built-in reactor under the normal operation and short-circuit condition were calculated respectively using “Magnetic-Circuit” coupling method, and the changes of leakage reactance were compared.The results show that, when the transformer was short-circuit, the short circuit current will passing through built-in reactor, which would cause the core framesaturated, and the leakage reactance of the built-in reactor would be reduced. The research results shown that the problem of leakage reactance reduction of built-in reactor should be considered in the design of short-circuit resistance of transformer, which was of great significance to guide the short-circuit design of power transformer.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent station site selection method based on multi-source and heterogeneous data
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The traditional station site selection work is mainly based on manual exploration by engineers whose shortcomings are timeconsuming, laborious, and uncertain. This paper studies the correlation between multi-source heterogeneous data, such as land spatial planning data, geographic data and power grid thematic data and power grid project station site selection. First of all, an adaptive particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm for processing the geographic information (GI_PSO) is proposed. The algorithm can not only adaptively adjust the particle's motion strategy and speed based on the particle diversity, but also adaptively adjust the number of particles based on the distance between extreme points. Second, the performance of the algorithm is evaluated in the extremum search of a PSO common test function. Then the multi-source heterogeneous data is processed to meet the needs of station selection, and the details of the algorithm used to find multiple sites is presented. Finally, an example of searching the optimal three station sites with the lowest cost in an area of about 60 km×45 km is used to verify the correctness of the method in the paper.

articleTitle: Comparison of power semiconductor solutions for the next generation offshore VSC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The Multilevel Modulation Converter (MMC) are eager for the compact design, especially for offshore VSC-HVDC systems. The saving space and weight could reduce the cost of the whole system. This paper introduces the available power semiconductors which can be used for the sub-module design of MMC, incl. Press-Pack-IGBT(PPI), IGBT modules, and Press-Pack IGCT. Additionally, it introduces the current and potential topologies to be the level-up solutions. Meanwhile, the power stack design is also discussed in mechanical and electrical design. The advantages and disadvantages are compared in electrical/thermal parameters, mechanical stack design, and system performance. The results may help to design the best cost-performance solution for the offshore VSC-HVDC system.

articleTitle: Application of straddling frame technology in overhead transmission line construction without power outage
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In wireline construction, the live-crossing construction technology that only needs to be crossed for short-term power outages or full-time power outages has gradually become an inevitable trend in the process of power grid construction, which makes the traditional "power outage crossing construction" operation mode gradually eliminated. In this paper, based on the construction technology of the closed grid spanning frame, a kind of spanning construction technology under the live condition of the overhead transmission line is proposed. Combining the structural characteristics of the grid-sealing spanning frame with the specific requirements and specifications of the live spanning construction, a complete grid-sealing spanning frame construction process including the rotation and docking of the spanning arm and the laying of the grid-sealing structure is formulated. On this basis, in cooperation with Guangdong Power Grid Energy Development Co., Ltd., in the construction of the 500kV Bohe Power Plant's transmission section live across the 220kV Dieqi Line A, the rope sealing structure was used to carry out the grid-sealing and spanning construction, so as to energize the new UHV transmission line. Cross-construction provides strong protection.

articleTitle: Study on applicability of metal oxide arrester simulation model considering residual voltage and energy characteristics
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper carries out experiments to apply different impulse current waves to the resistor of metal oxide arrester(MOA), and analyzes the residual voltage and energy characteristics of the resistor. In order to study the accuracy of arrester model, four arrester models of IEEE, CIGRE, Pinceti and MWR are selected for simulation. Comparing with the experimental results, the fitting degree of residual voltage and energy characteristics of each model is analyzed. It provides a reference for model selection and optimization in MOA simulation under different conditions.

articleTitle: A hybrid ride-through strategy for DC short-circuit fault in MMC-MTDC system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter based multi-terminal direct current (MMC-MTDC) system plays an increasingly important role in the power system. The DC short-circuit fault management is a crucial issue especially for overhead line transmission The blocking fault ride-through strategy has the disadvantages that the modular multilevel converter is uncontrollable after blocking and the process of restarting is complex. The non-blocking fault ride-through strategy has the problems that the fault current clearing speed is slow and the larger impulse current may occur. This paper proposes a hybrid fault ride-through strategy for MMC-MTDC. After the fault occurs, each converter station adopts the non-blocking fault ride-through strategy based on negative DC voltage control to quickly limit the fault current, so as to ride through the fault without blocking the IGBTs. If an overcurrent occurs at a converter station due to factors such as untimely DC voltage following, the overcurrent converter station is blocked and removed to ensure power transmission. Simulation results based on MATLAB/Simulink show that hybrid ride-through strategy can quickly block fault current after short-circuit fault in MMC-MTDC, and improve the ability to resist DC fault disturbance.

articleTitle: An optimal configuration method of DC reactor in LVDC microgrid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Short-circuit fault has a great impact on the safety of LVDC microgrids. In order to avoid damage to the DC equipment within microgrid, DC reactors need to be deployed to limit the fault current. This paper proposes an optimal configuration scheme of reactors based on the analytical solution of fault current. Firstly, the equivalent models of the different converters in DC microgrid are analysed. Secondly, the coupling situation of fault currents in different branches are discussed and the analytical solution of the DC fault current is calculated. Thirdly, the mathematical relationship between the current limiting reactors and DC fault current is established. Hence, the solutions of reactors in LVDC microgrid are calculated. Finally, the !375V LVDC microgrid is built in MATLAB to verify the validity and correctness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Problems caused by insulated overhead transmission line in medium-voltage system and the prevention methods
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to enhance the safe operation of medium-voltage distribution system, insulated coating is used to cover the transmission line. However, some problems are activated by the insulated overhead transmission line. Lightning-caused breakage of transmission line and lightning overvoltage are two problems that remain unclear. In this paper, the generation, development and evolution of lightning-caused breakage of transmission line are analyzed. Five stages, which are formation of pinhole in the insulated coating, lightning induced flashover, establishment of power frequency arc, continuous arc at the pinhole, and arc burning induced breakage of overhead transmission line. The amplitude of 5 kinds of lightening voltage influenced by the insulated overhead transmission line is also calculated. The results show that all the amplitudes of the overvoltage will decrease and the existing overvoltage prevention methods already meet the requirements. According to the development process, dredging and blocking methods to prevent lightning-caused breakage of transmission line are proposed. This work will provide safe and stable operation guidance for the medium-voltage distribution system with insulated overhead transmission line.

articleTitle: Optimized isolation and restarting strategy for UHVDC converter faults
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: As an important method to solve the contradiction between energy distribution and demand, Ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) power transmission has great advantages in long-distance, large-capacity, and cross-regional power transmission scenarios, and has been widely used. Aiming at the problems of long-time consumption, large power outage range, and power loss of the converter fault isolation and restarting process in a UHVDC project, an optimized strategy was proposed based on the analysis of the fault process. On the one hand, the converter protection area, as well as the connection mode of the breakers is optimized, and fast circuit breakers are added to speed up the process. On the other hand, the fault isolation and restarting strategy is optimized. By using the converter phase-shifting control to fast limit the fault current, using fast circuit breaker action to narrow the scope of fault isolation, the occurrence of pole isolation, pole restart, and large-scale machine and load shedding is avoided. Simulation verification shows that the optimized isolation and restarting strategy takes less than 0.5s in total, and only isolates the faulty converter to ensure the continuous power transmission of the unfaulty part, which significantly improves the reliability and economy of UHVDC transmission.

articleTitle: A capacity configuration planning method for regional integrated energy system based on bi-level optimization
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Equipment capacity configuration is one of the key processes in regional integrated energy system planning. In this paper, the research is carried out from two aspects: the capacity optimization of regional integrated energy system and the dispatching optimization between different types of equipment. Multi-energy complementary characteristics and energy cascade utilization of regional integrated energy system is considered, and a bi-level optimization model of capacity configuration is proposed. In the upper level optimization process, the fast and elitist multi-objective genetic algorithm based on non-dominated sorting (NSGA-II) is used to calculate the optimal configuration of the system equipment, while the mixed integer linear programming algorithm (MILP) is used to deal with the optimal dispatching operation in the lower level process. An industrial park is taken as an example, and the validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of the whole failure process of 35kV metal oxide varistor at outlet of main transformer
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Equipment failure occurs frequently at the low-voltage side of main transformer, and the most common faults is metal oxide arrestors (MOV) explosion and potential transformers (PT) damage under different ground fault. However, because of the lack for simulation model, it is quite difficult to conduct accurate analysis of the whole fault process, and the fault cannot be effectively prevented. To solve this problem, research on analysis and simulation of the whole fault process of 35kV MOV configured at the outlet of main transformer is carried out in this paper. Basic information and recording waveforms about the field fault in 110kV/35kV/10kV substation and relative theoretical analysis are presented first. Simulation model is established in PSCAD/ETMDC, and the simulation results are consistent with theoretical analysis and recording results. The whole fault process is: C-phase ground fault occurred first. Then, A-phase and B-phase voltage increased to line-line voltage from phase-phase voltage, and this overvoltage caused breakdown of A-phase MOV. As a result, the C-phase ground fault transferred to A-C phase ground fault. After the arc in MOV extinguished, the A-C phase ground fault changed back to Cphase ground fault.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid DC circuit breaker based on double mechanical switch
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The Hybrid DC circuit breaker is the key equipment for fault isolation in DC system. However, the existing forced converter hybrid DC circuit breaker still has the problems of high loss of auxiliary converter devices in main branch and high pre-charge voltage level. A novel hybrid DC circuit breaker based on double mechanical switch is proposed in this paper, under the premise of ensuring the two-way interruption of fault current, the main branch only adopts fast mechanical switch, and the low conduction loss of the main branch is realized by resistance zero-crossing circuit breaker. At the same time, the voltage level of pre-charging system is reduced by using controllable active oscillation circuit. Firstly, this paper introduces the proposed DC circuit breaker topology; Secondly, the working principle of fault current breaking is analyzed in detail; Finally, the performance of the proposed novel hybrid DC circuit breaker based on double mechanical switch is verified in PSCAD/EMTDC, which shows that the proposed DC circuit breaker has significant effectiveness.

articleTitle: Modal resonance index-enabled resonance area based dynamic interaction analysis and parameter optimization for PMSGs in multi-machine power system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper proposes a modal resonance index-enabled resonance area (MRIRA) scheme to analyse the dynamic interaction between a permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSG)-based wind farm and a multi-machine power system. In the MRIRA scheme, the proposed resonance area (RA), which is determined by the overlapping eigenvalue areas of the two open-loop subsystems, indicates that when the open-loop PMSG oscillation mode falls into these areas the probability of strong modal resonance between the two subsystems is high. A modal resonance index (MRI) is designed to evaluate the intensity of dynamic modal resonance. The MRIRA scheme also proposes a novel PMSG parameter optimization method to prevent the potential modal resonance by withdrawing the PMSG modes out of the RAs and maximizing the system MRIs. As verified by the simulation in the IEEE 39-bus benchmark model, the proposed MRIRA scheme can accurately analyse the risks of system resonance and effectively avoid potential modal resonance through improved VSC control parameter tuning.

articleTitle: System topologies, key operation and control technologies for offshore wind power transmission based on HVDC
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Offshore wind power (OWF) is considered a perfect energy source for the future low-carbon power system. However, the growing offshore distance and water depth would require more cost-efficiency and reliable techniques than the HVAC solution, which indicates the OWF HVDC transmission technique will be a promising solution. In this paper, the current situation of OWF-HVDC projects is introduced at first. Then, despite the most popular topology-modular multilevel converter, other alternative converters and system topologies with higher power density and cost-efficiency are presented, including the hybrid modular multilevel converter, alternative arm converter, and diode rectifier. Next, several multi-terminal topologies are introduced, which synthesize the advantages of different converters. Finally, the key technologies for OWF HVDC operation and control are summarized, including grid-forming control strategy for offshore wind turbine, harmonic instability suppression, and frequency regulation participation strategy design.

articleTitle: Review of typical technical schemes for medium and low voltage DC distribution
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper investigates the applications and engineering demonstrations of medium and low voltage DC distribution in various fields according to four typical application scenarios, particularly focusing on the technical schemes. On this basis, the characteristics and the application objectives of DC power distribution in different scenarios are summarized and concluded, and the typical technical schemes for DC power distribution in various typical application scenarios are proposed. These typical technical schemes can be used as benchmarks for future theoretical research, engineering design, practical application, and system evaluations.

articleTitle: Wide-area stability control strategy based on a novel branch transient transfer capability (BTTC) index
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The deep regulation of generation supply side, the new construction of the power grid and the continuous reshaping of the load structure lead to a more complex disturbance behaviour of the large-scale electric grid. Moreover, the stability situational awareness and control strategy face new challenges due to the appearing multi-group generator swings and transmission weak-line dynamic constraints transfer. In this paper, a novel index, Branch Transient Transfer Capability (BTTC), is designed for transient stability continuous evaluation, which is based on two-machine power system swing characteristics of the voltage node magnitude-phase spatial-temporal distribution and the characteristics of multiple branches power transfers. Therefore, the BTTC index has the unique abilities of the situation single modulation and critical instability judgement. Based on the aforementioned index, a new situational awareness and stability control strategy is proposed for the principle constraints dynamic monitoring and the wide-area control. The effectiveness of BTTC index and stability control strategy is verified by simulations of the Central China and North China HVDC-AC hybrid interconnected model.

articleTitle: Analysis of fault-induced inrush current of converter transformers in MMC-HVDC systems
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Following a single-phase-to-ground (SPG) fault on the valve-side of the converter transformer in the modular multilevel converter (MMC) high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) system, the fault-induced inrush current (FIIC) of converter transformers may generate and impact the protection. This paper reveals the generation mechanism and impacts of FIICs in MMC-HVDC systems for the first time. Focusing on the valve-side SPG fault, pre- and post-blocking characteristics of the valve-side SPG fault are analysed. The upper-arm submodule (SM) capacitors may suffer a severe overvoltage due to continuous charging. Meanwhile, the DC components in the lower-arm fault currents will continuously penetrate the converter transformer, leading to the saturation of the converter transformer and the generation of the FIIC. The FIIC will speed up the occurrence of zero-crossing in the grid-side currents, which helps to cut off the fault currents using the grid-side AC circuit breakers. In addition, the mal-operation of differential protection caused by the FIIC in the case of valve-side SPG fault is analysed in detail. Finally, simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC based on the ±320 kV Xiamen MMC-HVDC project have been conducted to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Control and simulation of STATCOM integrated energy storage system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: STATCOM integrated energy storage system can realize the coordinated control of active power and reactive power, that is, the system can be compensated in four quadrants, which can quickly compensate the active power and reactive power required by the system, flexibly solve some power quality problems in the power system, and smooth the fluctuations when new energy is connected to the grid, Moreover, compared with traditional discrete energy storage PCS and discrete SVG, it has the advantages of low cost, high performance and strong functional scalability. This paper takes the STATCOM integrated energy storage system as the research object, and conducts in-depth research on its control strategy. Since the STATCOM integrated energy storage system studied is a delta-connected cascaded structure, the control strategy is based on the more advantageous split-phase instantaneous current control in the case of three-phase unbalance, the system start-up control, SOC in-phase balance and inter-phase balance control are studied in depth. Finally, the control strategy is simulated and verified in the electromagnetic transient simulation software PSCAD.

articleTitle: Energy topology and grid-forming control scheme for inertia emulation in HVDC-VSC
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Large-scale integration of renewable energy sources (RES) is raising emerging issues of power system frequency stability. The lack of inertia in the use of power electronic converters (PEC) leads to a high rate of change of grid frequency (RoCoF) during load-generation imbalance conditions, which implies a systematic risk of cascading trips. This emerging issue has raised the risk of unexpected low-frequency load shedding and major power interruption events. Operators are thus forced to limit the share of renewable energy, but this measure will severely hinder the penetration of renewable energy in the future power system. Aiming to improve the friendliness of large-scale RES integration, the PEC, as the connection interface to the grid, is supposed to provide inertial support to enhance power system stability. This paper will propose a novel inertial simulation scheme (IES), including the energy topology design and the corresponding grid-forming control strategy, to imitate the dynamic behaviour of an equivalent synchronous generator (SG). When the PEC in the entire power system performs similar inertial characteristics as SG, the system frequency stability will be substantially improved, thus further increase in RES participation can be achieved.

articleTitle: Research on integrated complementary optimization of hydro and wind and photovoltaic power generation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Considering the impact of wind and solar energy random fluctuation characteristics on the safe and stable operation of power system, the construction of integrated water and wind and photovoltaic renewable energy integrated development base based on flexible dispatch of hydropower can promote sustainable and healthy energy development. In this paper, we propose an optimized operation model of integrated water and wind and photovoltaic power generation based on large system decomposition and coordination technology. Taking investment cost and economic efficiency as the objective function, the model is built into three levels, which are power supply ranking, calculation of electrical energy index, allocation of power supply capacity and load, and determination of operation cost, realizing water and wind and photovoltaic investment decision and complementary optimal operation. Finally, a census of the surrounding resources and sites of TS terrace hydropower station is conducted, and the integrated development of TS local power station is carried out according to the built model. The financial internal rate of return of capital funds under three scenarios are compared between integrated development and wind and photovoltaic direct grid connection and addition of energy storage equipment. It proves that the integrated development of water and wind and photovoltaic generation can realize the improvement of effective power absorption by wind and solar power networks, reduce the investment cost of consumption, and have good economic prospects.

articleTitle: Practical research on on-line monitoring and control function module of relay protection in smart substation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: At present, the power grid is carrying out the practical work of smart substation On-line monitoring and control function module of relay protection. Compared with traditional substations, the new-generation assurance system has been greatly improved in 7 functional modules, including fault archiving, special maintenance information patrol, fixed value checking, configuration checking, substation testing, intelligent alarm, and master station modeling. It can fully adapt to the functional requirements of smart substations and traditional substations. This paper analyzes the monitoring and analysis requirements of the assurance system based on the equipment configuration of the station control layer of the new generation of intelligent substations, and proposes a complete design scheme of seven functional modules from three aspects: functional requirements, implementation logic, and performance design. The practical application results in the power grid simulation laboratory show that the On-line monitoring and control function module of relay protection based on the guarantee system can be compatible with the traditional 103 substations and 61850 substations and achieve the expected goals and performance requirements. It has the value of promotion and application.

articleTitle: Refined modeling and real-time simulation of grid-connected DFIG
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper proposes a refined real-time co-simulation platform for Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS). The proposed detailed simulation model considers the aerodynamic, mechanical dynamic, and electromagnetic transients of individual DFIG and electromechanical transients of the power grid. The rotor kinematics equation is used as the interface between the mechanical and electromagnetic models. The Frequency Dependent Network Equivalent (FDNE) method is used to implement the hybrid simulation of electromagnetic and electromechanical transients. The real-time co-simulation platform is built through the combination of FAST developed by NREL, RT-Lab, and PowerFactory. To perform the real-time data interaction between FAST, RT-Lab, and PowerFactory, the communication module is developed based on UDP in this paper. Compared with the existing simulation tools, the proposed co-simulation platform highly enhances the simulation accuracy of WECS. Besides that, the simulation efficiency is also highly improved. The proposed simulation platform can be used for the studies of coupling dynamic analysis, grid-connected dynamic analysis, and hardware-in-the-loop simulation. The DFIG and IEEE 39-bus power grid are used as the case. The case study was conducted and analyzed, proving the correctness and accuracy of the co-simulation platform. Meanwhile, the simulation speed is fast enough for real-time simulation.

articleTitle: Research on snow removal of energized UHV DC wall bushing
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: When the surface area of the wall bushing in the UHV DC converter station is polluted, there is a risk of wet snow flashover in the snow climate. The snow removal in time of the wall bushing can reduce the risk of outdoor insulation. For the horizontal insulator, we designed snow removal tests under the influence of various factors. The effect of various snow removal factors on the discharge characteristics were studied on the short insulator (4 m), while the UHV full-size wall bushing insulator (10.87 m) was studied by withstand test. The energized snow removal test results showed that under the same snow removal ratio, a position with a lower electric field value along the string should be selected as the starting snow removal position. Simultaneous snow removal on multiple sections was easier to cause surface discharge than the continuous long gap snow removal. The ratio and the degree of discharge appear to decrease first and then increase in a “spoon” shape. It was recommended to remove snow from the middle of the bushing firstly, and the first snow removal ratio in a continuous area was from 13% to 20% of the insulation distance. The research results of this paper can effectively guide the energized snow removal operation of ±800 kV DC wall bushings, and provide a reference for the energized snow removal operation of outdoor horizontal insulation equipment of other voltage levels.

articleTitle: Single-ended time-domain line fault location method considering shunt capacitance
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved model-based single-ended time-domain fault location method on AC transmission lines. The proposed method only requires the instantaneous voltage and current measurements at the local end, and does not need any remote side information such as voltages, currents, equivalent source voltages or impedances. Compared to the existing single-ended time domain model-based method, the proposed method considers the shunt capacitance through the line by establishing lumped RLC line model. In addition, a low pass filter is applied to the measurements to improve the modeling accuracy of the lumped model. Finally, numerical integration methods are applied to convert differential equations into algebraic equations, and the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is adopted to solve the highly nonlinear fault location problem. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through many case studies in PSCAD/EMTDC, with different fault types, locations and resistances. The method only requires a short data window within half a cycle (10 ms) and a relatively low sampling rate of 10kHz.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and simulation of the alkaline electrolytic hydrogen production system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Hydrogen storage has become an important regulating resource for new power systems due to its low carbon and flexibility. However, the current hydrogen storage units in electro-hydrogen coupled systems mostly make use of existing experimental data or steady-state models of electrolytic cells, with less dynamic research. Therefore, this paper constructs a dynamic model of an alkaline electrolysis hydrogen production system to better suit the dynamic working conditions of power systems. Firstly, the alkaline electrolysis technology and process flow are briefly described, and a physical model of the system is constructed from the actual phenomenon and mechanism. Secondly, the control strategies of temperature and pressure are proposed to control the cooling water and gas flow respectively through on-off and PI control to ensure the safe operation of the system. Finally, MATLAB simulations are used to verify the validity of the model and strategy and to analyze the technical limitations of the dynamic operation of the system. The analysis results point out that the flexibility of the electrolysis system is greatly reduced compared to a single tank and provide technical parameters for the dynamic operation of the electro-hydrogen coupled system.

articleTitle: Review of electric vehicles charging and swapping facilities planning
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper conducts a review for EV charging and swapping facilities planning for the following aspects. Firstly, the various electric vehicle (EV) load forecasting methods are discussed, so as to classify and discuss the current situation of EV charging and swapping facilities planning. Then, the research status of collaborative planning of EV charging and swapping facilities and grid, the EV charging and swapping facilities planning considering carbon emission are summarized, respectively. Under the above research background, this paper summarizes the research status of EV charging and swapping facilities planning in domestic and overseas. Finally, the bottlenecks faced by the planning and development of EV charging and swapping facilities are summarized, and the future research direction is prospected.

articleTitle: Selection method of voltage level sequence for regional AC/DC hybrid power distribution system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The DC distribution network has better performance than AC in terms of transmission capacity, controllability, improving power supply quality, reducing line loss, isolating AC and DC faults, and flexible and convenient access to renewable energy. It is a hot spot in the field of power distribution research at home and abroad. This paper firstly introduces the basic principles for the selection of distribution voltage levels in AC/DC hybrid systems from the aspects of economy, safety and stability, uniformity, and applicability. Then, the AC/DC power distribution system is compared and analysed from the aspects of power supply demand and power supply capacity, line loss, power quality, reliability, etc., and the voltage level of DC power distribution is divided. Finally, the reference and basis of the DC distribution voltage level are given, which has good practicability.

articleTitle: Study on the fault inversion of large-scale EMT digitalanalog hybrid simulation and test based on ADPSS
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The new-typed power electrical system dominated by renewable energy produces immerging requirement for power system simulation technology. Electromechanical transient simulation, as the main power system simulation tool, can not simulate the precise dynamic characteristics of power electronics devices. Electromagnetics transient simulation (EMT) is difficult to be implemented in large-scale power system analysis due to its unbearable calculation cost. This paper proposes the new largescale EMT digital-Analog simulation technology based on ADPSS, which includes two kinds of parallel technologies and the advanced HVDC modelling technology.
