With these new proposed methods on ADPSS, it is achieved that the high accurate fault inversion study in East China Power grid, which demonstrates that the EMT simulation can be implemented in large-scale power system study with high accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the converter transformer voltage regulator based on IGBTs for HVDC system and coordination control strategy
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The on-load tap changer is a vital component of the converter transformer in HVDC system and is also the key equipment for power and voltage adjustment. It needs to have the ability to adjust the voltage with load and wide range. In recent years, accidents related to on-load tap changer bring serious challenges to the operation safety of HVDC projects and the entire power grid. In order to realize the voltage regulation while avoiding the inherent defects of traditional mechanical on-load tap changer, the converter transformer voltage regulator based on IGBTs is proposed, and the main circuit topology, related functional requirements of the voltage regulating device and the coordinated control strategy with HVDC system are proposed to realize the flexible and smooth voltage regulating of the converter transformer. Based PSCAD/EMTDC, the model with the primary parameters and control & protection system from the actual HVDC project utilizing the converter transformer voltage regulator is established, which verifies the proposed device and control strategy can effectively realize the voltage regulating function required by HVDC system. Compared with the discrete and slow characteristics of mechanical on-load tap changers, the regulator is capable of fast and continuous regulating and commutation failure defense.

articleTitle: Research on optimal planning and configuration strategy of battery energy storage power station for disaster prevention of urban secure power grid considering economic and reliability analysis
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper puts forward the planning and configuration principle of the battery energy storage station(BESS) of the urban secure power grid, and establishes the full-life cycle economic model of the BESS based on the configuration requirements in urban secure power grid for the emergency power supply. Taking the maximum annual equivalent income as the objective function, an economic allocation model of the capacity of BESS for urban secure power grid based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm(IPSO) was established to achieve the economic optimization of the capacity arrangement of energy storage power station while meeting the important load holding of the city under the disaster scenario of reliable support. At the same time, a reliability analysis model for energy storage capacity configuration results considering the impact of disasters is established to support the reasonable selection. Finally, the scheme comparison and optimization design are carried out based on the actual scenario of an urban secure power grid.

articleTitle: Research on operation and control of low voltage photovoltaic-energy storage DC building system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The spread of the power electronics, both for control and power applications, in the realization of apparatuses the DC transformation in building distribution and utilization system. Currently, the research and discussion of the operation scheme and control strategy for low voltage photovoltaic-energy storage DC building system, LVPESDCBS, are relatively less. Focusing on these, in-depth research and analysis for control and operation scheme are conducted, and the related application possibility for different types LVPESDCBSs is discussed in this paper. At the start, the existing operational control strategies for the DC system are summarized. Following this, the centralized operational control scheme, which applies to the existing buildings that need to be renovated to DC type, and the decentralized operational control scheme for newly built DC buildings are studied respectively. Taking these conclusions into consideration, a ±375V LVPESDCBS digital model with various types of AC/DC power electronic devices is established in PSCAD/EMTDC. The proposed control strategy and operational scheme are verified through normal operation and single-pole operation of this LVPESDCBS. Finally, extended marketability requirement discussions of future DC building based on three perspectives: data drives, converter devices, and the application of DC technology are presented.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant method for fault location of active distribution network based on matrix algorithm
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Fault location is of great significance for fault handling and power restoration of distribution network. In the traditional fault location method of active distribution network with new energy access, the matrix algorithm has poor fault tolerance and the optimization algorithm has slow location speed. A section location algorithm is proposed to combine the advantages of the matrix algorithm and the optimization algorithm. Firstly, matrix algorithm is used to quickly locate fault sections after the active distribution network fails. Then, the positioning result of matrix algorithm is verified by switching function. According to the verification results, it is decided whether to use the optimization algorithm to optimize the fault sections, and then output the final results. Finally, the simulation test by MATLAB shows that this method can achieve fault location rapidly with strong fault tolerance in active distribution network.

articleTitle: Influence of magnetic materials on the misalignment tolerance of IPT systems with high-frequency supply
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In an inductive power transfer (IPT) system, the magnetic core is usually used to improve the misalignment tolerance. However, considering the iron losses in magnetic materials, the addition of magnetic core may reduce the power transfer efficiency. Therefore, in this study, the influence of material and shape of magnetic core on misalignment tolerance of IPT system is comprehensively investigated. Firstly, the equivalent circuit model of IPT system is established, and the formulas for different types of losses are deduced. Then, 3-D Finite Element (FE) models of the IPT system with magnetic core in different shapes are established, and the performance of IPT system under different misalignment condition is simulated. The simulation results reveal that only if the material losses below a certain value and an appropriate core shape are adopted, the addition of magnetic material can improve the system efficiency, and the addition of magnetic core can effectively improve the misalignment tolerance. Finally, experimental validation on a 3-kW IPT system is performed under the conditions of no magnetic core, using ferrite core in radial pattern and hollow square shapes, using nanocrystalline core in radial pattern and hollow square shapes, respectively. The results verified the difference of the misalignment tolerance improvement of different magnetic core shapes and materials

articleTitle: Research on optimal grouping of passive filters based on back-to-back DC transmission system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that a large number of passive filters are configured in the back-to-back DC project and occupy a large area, an optimal grouping scheme of passive filters is proposed. Through the research on the switching strategy of passive filters, a reasonable reactive power control strategy is proposed to optimize the grouping of filters. At the same time, the main loop parameter calculation and simulation verification of power rise and fall are carried out. The verification results show that, This strategy can reduce the transient steady-state voltage when the filter is switched on and off, optimize the packet capacity of the filter, and ensure the safety and reliability of DC system operation.

articleTitle: Research on fuzzy control technology of virtual synchronous generator based on three-level NPC inverter structure
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) refers to a system that can simulate the operation of a synchronous generator (SG) composed of prime mover, converter, and control mode.Since the energy storage element contained in the VSG can provide inertia to the power system, it can be used to solve the problem of the sharp decrease in the inertia level caused by the large-scale use of power electronic devices in the current power system.The inverter used in this paper is a three-level NPC inverter. In order to seek the best inertial characteristics of the system, an auxiliary control system based on fuzzy control is designed. The system has a simple structure and does not change the original structure of the VSG. At the same time enhance its anti-disturbance.The application of this system can effectively alleviate the angular velocity oscillation caused by the load switching, While reducing the angular velocity overshoot, the angular velocity can be stabilized faster.This paper verifies the correctness of the control strategy through matlab/simulink.

articleTitle: The Study on the Aging Characteristics of XLPE under AC and DC conditions
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Along with the development of new energy and distributed system, XLPE cables for power transmission and distribution today may face complex operating conditions. In this paper, an aging test platform for simulation of complex conditions with local discharge interference under 2pC was established. The aging characteristic of XLPE under AC, DC and sudden grounding were valued through tracing the initiation, growth and partial discharge patterns of electric trees. The results showed that the existed ac trees are difficult to grow under dc conditions due to the space charge injection. However, trees were easy to grow and led to breakdown rapidly when the sample was grounded several times in a very short time since the abrupt voltage change cause the electrical-mechanic power lead to the breakage of molecular chains. The conclusions can be an important reference for the feasibility of using existed AC cables for DC usage from the view of insulation deterioration.

articleTitle: Abnormal analysis of DC voltage measurement in HVDC inverter station
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: After the inverter station of a HVDC project was put into operation, the voltage of bipolar DC high-voltage bus in inverter station was measured abnormally, which caused the DC voltage of the rectifier station to rise. According to the response characteristics of the control system and the sampling characteristics of the measurement system during the abnormal voltage measurement, the causes of the abnormal DC voltage measurement system are analyzed and investigated, so as to effectively solve the problem of abnormal DC voltage measurement. Finally, according to the observation and analysis of abnormal measurement phenomena in the troubleshooting process, the method of quickly locating the causes of abnormal DC measurement system is extracted, so that the operation and maintenance personnel can quickly formulate relevant countermeasures, which has reference and guiding significance for on-site operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on impedance scan acceleration method of VSC-HVDC grid-connected system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper presents a acceleration frequency scan method of harmonic impedance for offshore wind farm system connected through VSC-HVDC. Based on the principle of linear orthogonality of Fourier decomposition, multiple harmonic voltage sources at equal intervals are injected into the PCC points of the system at the same time, and the simulated measured voltage and simulated measured current of the parallel points of the VSC-HVDC system are obtained, and then the harmonic impedance of the VSC-HVDC is obtained. Compared with the single harmonic source injected frequency scan, this method can shorten the scan time, greatly improve the harmonic impedance frequency scan efficiency, and ensure the accuracy of the scan results. Finally, this paper uses the electromagnetic transient simulation software PSCAD / EMTDC to build an offshore wind farm grid-connected system through VSC-HVDC, and carries out the harmonic impedance frequency scan simulation, compared with the harmonic impedance frequency scan results of single harmonic source, the Bode diagrams of the two are almost consistent, which proves the accuracy and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Optimized distribution method for power device conduction loss in hybrid modular multilevel converter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: To promote the reliability of the hybrid modular multilevel converter consisting of half-bridge sub-modules (HBSMs) and full-bridge sub-modules (FBSMs), optimized power loss distribution on devices in HBSMs and FBSMs is investigated. At first, the different charging and discharging characteristics of HBSMs and FBSMs for hybrid MMC with the traditional control method are analyzed, and, the conduction loss distribution on power devices in hybrid MMC is calculated. To reduce the conduction loss of the lower IGBTs in the HBSMs, a new control method based on the flexible regulation of the average switching function of HBSMs and FBSMs is proposed. The interaction mechanism of HBSMs' average switching function on the conduction loss distribution is analyzed, and an optimal assignment method is derived to reduce the conduction loss of the lower IGBTs in the HBSMs. Finally, simulation results using PLCES and MATLAB/Simulink are presented to verify the analysis and proposed method.

articleTitle: Influence of excessive contact resistance on electrothermal characteristics of conductive connection structure
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: One of the common structures at the end of the bushing is a plug-in structure, in which the male and female heads are plug-in connection, and the entire structure conducts through strap contacts. Due to the combined effects of electricity, force and heat, the contact between the strap contacts and the guide rod is easy to be poor, and the contact resistance is easy to increase. In actual operation, the temperature rise is difficult to obtain by measurement. Thus, through COMSOL electro-thermal coupling simulation, it is found that after the contact resistance exceeds the standard 320μΩ, the contact point is the highest temperature of the whole structure, which is easy to cause the decomposition of SF6 gas and threaten the safety of the bushing. As the contact resistance increases, the temperature of the entire structure increases, and the maximum temperature and temperature rise are basically linearly related to the contact resistance. When the contact resistance is 3370μΩ, which is about 10 times the standard, the overall maximum temperature reaches the limit of 120°C in the IEC60137 standard. The simulation provides guidance for improving the reliability of the bushing and the optimization of the electrical connection performance.

articleTitle: Investigation on dielectric properties of epoxy resin impregnated paper composites for UHV DC wall bushing
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The DC wall bushing is a crucial equipment connecting the AC and DC power grid, which withstands the full voltage and full current of the system during operation and has drawn widespread attention for its insulation problem. As the main insulating material of the DC wall bushing, the dielectric performance of the epoxy resin impregnated paper composites is important to the service performance of the bushing. In this paper, a sheet sample of epoxy resin impregnated paper composites obtained from an 800kV UHV DC bushing was characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The dielectric properties of epoxy resin impregnated paper composites were tested by the broadband dielectric spectrometer under different test voltages and temperatures. A simulation model of an 800 kV DC wall bushing was established based on COMSOL for electric thermal coupling field calculation. It is found that the electric field distribution in the radial direction of the bushing reverses as the temperature gradient increases, which can be attributed to the impact of temperature on the dielectric characteristics of epoxy resin impregnated paper composites.

articleTitle: Research on hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell model
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the development of society and the progress of science and technology, energy plays an important role in human production and life.Hydrogen energy is a high calorific value, low pollution and renewable energy.Recent years,in order to achieve peaking carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality goals, the use of hydrogen energy is increasingly important.Hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell is widely used,compared with primary batteries and crude oil, it has less pollution to the environment and is a green, clean and efficient energy,therefore, it has a very good prospect of development and application in today's decreasing fossil fuels and energy crisis.In this paper, the hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell is taken as the research object, and the model of the fuel cell stack is established. On the basis of the model, the polarization characteristics,dynamic response characteristics and the factors affecting the stack voltage output of the fuel cell are studied. The simulation results show that the output curve of the model is similar to the actual measurement, and the dynamic characteristics are good.

articleTitle: Characteristics of overvoltage and approaches to encounter overvoltage suppression for DC submarine cable of VSC-HVDC transmission system powered by large-scale offshore wind
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Wind power generation is one of the most mature and commercial power generation methods in the field of renewable energy utilization. With the continuous consumption of coastal wind power resources, the development and utilization of offshore wind power resources is an inevitable trend. VSC-HVDC transmission is the best technical means for the collection and transmission of offshore wind power far away. The transient overvoltage of DC submarine cable is the decisive factor of equipment insulation level, manufacturing difficulty and project cost. Based on the practice of offshore wind power transmission through VSC-HVDC project, this paper studies the transient overvoltage characteristics and overvoltage suppression measures of DC submarine cable when AC and DC faults occur, and completes the simulation verification. The results show that the overvoltage suppression measures can effectively reduce the transient overvoltage level of DC submarine cable by more than 13%. The overvoltage suppression measures improve the safety margin of DC submarine cable and enhance the reliability of DC system. The research results have been applied in Rudong project, the first VSC-HVDC transmission system powered by offshore wind power in China.

articleTitle: Research on grounding mode of AC-AC converter system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The low-frequency power transmission technology uses lower frequency to transmit electric energy, thereby reducing the reactive power of the line and improving the transmission capacity of the system. Low frequency power transmission adopts Multi-modular matrix converter, in which the grounding method of the system is very important as a part of the system wiring method. In this paper, three possible grounding methods are studied, and the fault characteristics of single-phase or two-phase grounding faults under the three grounding methods were analysed. The conclusion shows that the 220kV low-frequency AC-AC converter system can provide the grounding point by using the grounding transformer to ground through the resistance, and the fault current was small when the fault occurs, and the overvoltage was not prominent. It is an ideal grounding method.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic and electromechanical properties of aluminum-coated carbon fiber conductor
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aluminum clad carbon fiber conductor is a new form of carbon fiber conductor. In this paper, simulation and test for aluminum-coated carbon fiber conductor were carried out. The finite element method was used to carry out numerical simulation calculation to explore the electromagnetic performance of the wire in the field of UHV power transmission. Pulley test, stress-strain test, ampacity calculation was carried out, and compared with aluminium cable steel reinforced of equal section. The research shows that the aluminum-coated carbon fiber wire has advantages in electromagnetic properties and current carrying capacity, and has high tensile strength of the mandrel, relatively small wire strain, and good mechanical properties.

articleTitle: Electrical properties of PI films with high thermal conductivity
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Polyimide (PI) films with excellent mechanical, chemical and high resistance properties, which are a kind of good insulating material in electrical equipment. The electrical equipment is oriented to the design of miniaturization and power maximization, and the high-power electrical equipment working for a long time produces a lot of heat, which results in equipment deformation and insulation layer aging. In this paper, high thermal conductive PI films were prepared by using nanoscale boron nitride (BN) silane coupling agent (KH550) surface modification, nanometer alumina and silica to improve the heat dissipation problem in electrical devices to work for long hours. These thermal conductive fillers are added in polyamide acid (PAA) with different mass ratios during the high thermal conductive PI film preparation. When the mass ratio of 6:2:2, the thermal conductivity filler reaches 10%, and the thermal conductivity of the film reaches 0.72 W/m . K. Moreover, the AC withstands voltage test results show that the AC breakdown electrical field strength of high thermal conductivity composite PI film is 12.6% higher than that of the pure one. The volume resistivity is basically unchanged.

articleTitle: Voltage fluctuation and ripple analysis method for DC grid connected PV converter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the development distributed photovoltaic (PV) sources and DC loadsCDC system will play an important role in large-scale distributed PV sources connecting to grid. The DC voltage of the system will also be affecting by voltage pulse and high-frequency ripple caused by PV converters. However, due to the relatively small scale of the DC system with PV connected, not enough attention has been paid. Based on the mechanism of power quality problems caused by PV, this paper presents a complete analysis method based on stationary wavelet transform (DWT) and FFT. This method is more stability and accurate than the voltage fluctuation and ripple evaluation method. It can analyse power quality problems causing by DC connecting PV converters from multi time scale, which is suitable in the future of complex DC system. Finally, the simulation case of distributed PV grid connection shows that the method is feasible and practical.

articleTitle: Analysis of abnormal discharge phenomenon of porcelain insulator of transmission line in offshore area
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Porcelain insulator is widely used in transmission line because of its excellent mechanical properties. Recently, abnormal discharge occurred on porcelain insulators of a 500kV transmission line in offshore area of Shandong Province, resulting in line outage accident. In order to analyse the causes of abnormal discharge, tower pollution test and insulation resistance test were carried out on this batch of insulators in operation. The test results show that the local pollution degree is low, and the equivalent salt density on the insulator surface is less than 0.04mg/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, but the measured insulation resistance value is less than 10m Ω, which is far lower than the standard value. The measured insulator string needs to be replaced immediately. Based on this, sampling tests such as temperature cycle, electromechanical damage load and breakdown resistance were carried out on insulators. The results showed that this batch of insulators failed to pass the test and were not coated with antipollution flashover coating, which did not meet the requirements of the regulations. The analysis results also show that the increase of abnormal fog water conductivity (salt fog) leads to the decrease of insulator surface insulation resistance, which is the main reason for the abnormal discharge along the surface.

articleTitle: Assessment of energy storage and dynamic response of modular multilevel converters for frequency support control actions
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Modular Multilevel Converters (MMCs) inherently possess an energy storage that can be used to help mitigate power imbalances due to perturbations in the system. Control systems use this reserve to release or absorb additional energy, from which additional power contributions are manifested based on the time derivative. However, this requires not only the controller response speeds to be sufficiently fast, but also the MMC to be capable of reaching the set point demanded from its controllers within sufficient time. Furthermore, large energy storage elements in the MMC have implications on its response speed. Detailed electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations may be used to determine the natural MMC response speed capability, but this comes at high computational costs, especially in larger MMCs. This paper derives a closed-form equation for the response speed of an MMC. It is obtainable without the construction of waveforms or iterative calculations, which makes it computationally efficient. Parametric studies are conducted and investigate the effect of different MMC parameters on its settling time. Results obtained from the model have been compared against those from EMT simulations. The model may be used as an initial design tool, particularly when the natural response speed of the MMC is a concern.

articleTitle: Partial discharge pattern recognition in GIS based on a novel one-dimensional convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In recent years, massive data-driven deep learning methods, especially convolutional neural networks (CNN), have made rapid progress in partial discharge (PD) diagnosis of gas-insulated switchgear (GIS). However, the two-dimensional CNN (2DCNN) converts PD signals into the form of picture, resulting in the temporal fine-grained information of PD signals being ignored. In addition, 2DCNN relies on massive data and perform poorly on unbalanced samples. To solve these problems, a novel one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1DCNN) is constructed to recognize GIS PD pattern. Firstly, a fault diagnosis method based on the combination of spatial pyramid pooling and 1DCNN is proposed. This method not only enables the network to handle data of different sizes, but also reduces the complexity of network structure and the amount of computation required. Then, the focus loss function is introduced to guide the model training, which can discover difficult-to-classify samples, alleviate the problem of sample imbalance, and further improve the model identification performance. Experimental results show that the proposed 1DCNN can achieve high accuracy and robust GIS PD diagnosis under small samples, and has good fault tolerance for unbalanced samples, which provides a reliable reference for GIS PD diagnosis.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of electric thermal integrated energy system considering dynamic characteristics
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the increasingly serious environmental and energy problems, the whole society and all industries have higher and higher requirements on the comprehensive utilization of energy, especially the integrated energy system has broken the original independent operation mode and become the strategic development direction of the future energy system. This paper takes cogeneration as the core, through the detailed analysis of the dynamic characteristics of the heat network, and taking into account the operation constraints of the thermal system and the power system, establishes the optimization scheduling model of the comprehensive energy system with the goal of minimizing the total operation cost of the electric heating system, and enhances the absorption capacity of renewable energy by giving play to the inertia of the heat network. The correctness of the proposed optimal scheduling model and the effective role of the scheduling scheme in promoting the comprehensive economy of the system and the consumption of renewable energy were tested with examples of IEEE6 power-6 node heat and IEEE33 power-16 node heat.

articleTitle: An efficient switching ripple communication method based on nonorthogonal FSK modulation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The well-known PSDM (power/signal dual modulation) technology, which adopts the switching ripples of output voltages as the carriers of information, enables digital communication between power electronic converters without dedicated communication lines. However, the existing FSK (frequency shift keying) and PSK (phase shift keying) modulation methods both have to be carried out under the orthogonality rule, which makes it difficult for the ripple communication rate to reach the Nyquist rate. In this paper, an efficient switching ripple communication method based on non-orthogonal FSK modulation is proposed, which can achieve significantly higher bandwidth efficiency. By solving the correlation matrix equation during demodulation process, one can decode the signals carried by different carrier frequencies, which are not necessarily orthogonal to each other within the demodulation cycle. Some special measures are taken to cope with the symbols of variable lengths. Research shows that, by taking the approach based on non-orthogonal FSK modulation, one can achieve a communication rate of about 2.3 times that of the method based on orthogonal FSK modulation, which can probably exceed the Nyquist rate. Numerical results of random coding and decoding verify the validity of the theoretical method.

articleTitle: Research on rapid simulation of temperature field of GIS equipment digital twin
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Simulation technology has been widely used in the power industry, and the development of digital twin technology has brought new opportunities and challenges to simulation. How to transform a large-scale complex system into a smaller-scale approximate reduced-order system under certain conditions and meet the accuracy and stability of the simulation is the key to rapid simulation. This article takes the temperature field of GIS equipment as an example to illustrate the realization of fast simulation. In the actual operation of GIS, the heat consumption of the heating part cannot be obtained through the sensor, and only the temperature distribution of the shell surface can be measured. Therefore, we use the inversion method for simulation. The digital twin can solve the problem of disconnection between the operation and maintenance of substation equipment and production design at this stage. By establishing a digital twin model of the equipment, a digital model asset library of substation equipment is formed, and the digital delivery of substation equipment is realized. The digital twin gathers equipment-related data, performs real-time analysis of the equipment status in the digital space, and improves the efficiency of data utilization.

articleTitle: On-line monitoring scheme of high voltage arrester based on TMR sensor current measurement
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the monitoring requirements of high-voltage arresters, an online monitoring scheme of arrester operating conditions based on TMR current sensor is proposed, which is realized by measuring the lightning strike current and leakage current of the arrester. In this paper, a sensing unit circuit for measuring the lightning current and leakage current of the arrester is designed. Experiments show that this method can effectively monitor the relative current of the arrester, which provides an effective technical means and necessary reference for timely detection of the arrester fault.

articleTitle: Non-contact three-phase voltage measurement method based on reference signal
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of three-phase low-voltage non-contact measurement, a non-contact three-phase voltage measurement method based on reference signal is proposed. Firstly, three voltage induction probes are clamped on three fire wires, and the measurement unit establishes the measurement circuit through the coupling capacitance between the fire wire to be measured and the induction probe; Secondly, by controlling the opening and closing of the switch, the fire wire voltage connected to the measurement unit is controlled to form different measurement circuits; Then, a high-frequency voltage reference signal is injected into different measurement circuits to detect the current of the measurement circuit; Finally, the voltage of the threephase fire wire to be measured is obtained by solving the nonlinear equations. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On the transient short-circuit of RCD snubber in high power three-level IGBT inverter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Besides the imbalance between the voltages of internal and external power device, the NPC three-level inverter with the 3RCD snubber circuit has a large short-circuit current in the commutation path, which increases the current stress of the power devices, and even endangers the regular operation of the power devices. In this paper, the four kinds of short-circuits generated by 3RCD in a three-level NPC inverter are presented, and their reasons are also analyzed. Theoretical analysis is verified by the simulation and experiments. The result shows that the 3RCD snubber circuit with the above shortcomings is not enough excellent to be used in high-power NPC three-level IGBT inverters. More effective methods should be proposed to suppress the transient over-voltage of IGBT.

articleTitle: Design, analysis and optimization for transformer windings in megawatt medium frequency DC transformer
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Medium frequency transformers working in several hundred to several thousand Hz are key components in the electromagnetic coupling link of Power Electronic transformer (PET). The increase of working frequency makes the overall volume of medium frequency transformers greatly reduced, thus significantly improving the overall power density of the system. But with the increase of transformer working frequency, the overall loss of transformer will also increase, this problem urgently needs to be solved. In this paper, eddy current effect of middle frequency winding is analysed theoretically. Subsequently, according to the specific requirements of high voltage megawatt level medium frequency transformer, the winding selection of the transformer is carried out, and the appropriate transformer winding form -- copper foil winding is selected. Based on the copper foil windings, the size of copper foil windings is optimized and analysed in combination with the calculation method of AC resistance of copper foil windings and ANSYS software simulation. Finally, the windings of a 1.5MVA transformer are optimized by using this optimization method, and the windings loss of the transformer is greatly reduced, and the efficiency is over 99%

articleTitle: A fast fault ride-through strategy for MMC based on negative DC voltage control
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The blocking fault ride-through strategy has the disadvantages of uncontrollable converter and complex system restart process, which reduces the reliability of modular multilevel converter. Therefore, a fault ride-through strategy without blocking the IGBTs based on negative DC voltage control is proposed. After DC side short-circuit fault occurred, the DC voltage is controlled to be negative by moving down the reference wave, so as to realize the rapid removal of DC fault. In addition, aiming at the problem of unbalanced capacitor voltage between output positive and negative level sub-modules in the process of fault ride-through, a double sorting control algorithm (DSCA) is proposed to realize the rapid equalization of capacitor voltage of sub-modules. The simulation results based on MATLAB / Simulink show that the fault ride-through strategy based on negative DC voltage control can quickly eliminate DC fault current, and the capacitor voltage of the sub-module remains balanced well.

articleTitle: Development of a new hybrid DC circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Hybrid DC circuit breaker has the advantages of short breaking time and low on-state loss. It is currently the mainstream solution used in DC transmission and distribution systems. However, the power electronic switch in the transfer branch limits the breaking capacity of the equipment and also the breaking cost per unit capacity is increased, which severely restricts the large-scale application and promotion of hybrid DC circuit breakers. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a new type of hybrid DC circuit breaker scheme. Firstly, its topology and working principle are explained, the current and voltage stress of key components are analysed, and then a simulation model is built. The breaking process is simulated, and the design of the test prototype is completed on this basis. Finally, a LC low-frequency oscillation test circuit is built to verify the breaking performance of the developed hybrid DC circuit breaker prototype. The results show that the developed prototype successfully breaks 50kA short-circuit current within 3 ms, which is basically consistent with the simulation results, and provides a reference for the subsequent development of large-capacity medium-voltage DC circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Design of a real-time simulation platform to support large-scaled renewable energy access to power grid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to better carry out the research on the interaction effects of source-grid-load-storage in the context of new power systems, it is particularly important to construct a simulation system that includes power equipment and control and protection (C&P) system. This paper designs and builds a simulation and verification platform for large-scaled renewable energy access to the grid. A renewable energy grid-connected system including a large-scale wind power and photo-voltaic power generation, collection and transmission system is constructed. The system adopts a semi-physical real-time hybrid simulation of digital models and dynamic simulation equipment. The steady-state/dynamic/transient characteristic analysis, the selection of key equipment technical parameters and the verification of C&P strategies of large-scaled renewable energy grid can be conducted with this simulation platform. The impact of large-scaled renewable energy and energy storage access on the power system can also be studied. The system provides a platform for experimentation and technical training for scholars, and forms a strong support for theoretical research and technical development in related fields, which is of great significance to the development of renewable energy access technology and its industrial development.

articleTitle: Redundancy based VSC-DC segmentation system for urban power grid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Voltage source converter (VSC) based DC segemenation system has great prospect applications because it can limit the short- circuit current level, prevent cascading failure, and improve the power supply reliability of the urban power grid. However, the capitalized cost and the volume are the main problems that hinder the development of the VSC-DC segmentation technology. To tackle these problems, this paper proposes a novel redundancy based VSC-DC segmentation design to decrease the total demanding capacity of the VSC converters, realizing the ecomonic and practical interconnection of different AC zones for urban power grid. Firstly, the topology of the redundancy based VSC-DC segmentation system is proposed in details. Secondly, the design principle of the proposed system is discussed. Moreover, an equal power loading rate based emergency control strategy is proposed to make full use of the proposed redundancy based VSC-DC segmentation system. Finally, a case of three zones interconnected by the proposed system is adopted to validate the correctness and the effectiveness of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Prediction of direct power control strategy based on dual vector Vienna rectifier model
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In the traditional finite set control model predictive direct power control of Vienna rectifier, because the optimal voltage vector acts on the whole sampling period and only implements deadbeat control for reactive power, there are some problems such as limited coverage of output voltage vector, high harmonic content of grid-connected current and large power pulsation. In view of this, a double vector model predictive direct power control (MPDPC) method is proposed in this paper. by constructing the predictive power model in α β coordinate system, the voltage vector is selected twice in each sampling period. the desired voltage vector can be synthesized by using non-zero voltage vector in the second voltage vector selection, so that the direction and amplitude of the output voltage vector can be adjusted. And the influence of action time on the selection of voltage vector is considered in the value function, which makes the selection of voltage vector more accurate. The results show that compared with the finite set model predictive direct power control, this method has lower harmonic content of grid-connected current and less power pulsation.

articleTitle: A simple boost converter for renewable energy system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper presents a simple boost converter which generates higher voltage gain with several components. Owing to output capacitors in series, the proposed converter not only achieves two times gain of basic boost converter, but also reduce volume of output capacitor. Diodes achieve zero reverse recovery loss which improve efficiency. The basic operating principle and gain derivation of the presented converter are detaily discussed. Finally, a prototype experiment is performed with 20-V input voltage, 100-V output voltage, and 200-W output power to verify the performance of the presented converter.

articleTitle: Simulation of electric-thermal coupled field of power cable terminals and a failure case study
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The electrical and temperature fields are important factors affecting the performance of insulation materials, which causes the aging of insulation materials. In this work, the electric-temperature coupled field model is established using ANSYS for highvoltage cable terminals. It is found that the temperature of the cable terminal increases with the operating current and the dielectric dissipation factor of insulating silicone oil. The maximum temperature of the cable terminal is 22.6°C during normal operation. When a short circuit fault occurred, the maximum temperature of the center conductor reached 45.3°C. When the impurity present is copper, the local temperature of the cable termination is highest. When the dielectric dissipation factor starts to grow from 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, the average temperature of the insulating silicone oil rises rapidly by up to 11°C. Based on a failure case, it is found that the abnormal high temperature of cable terminal is closely related to the dielectric loss of insulating silicone oil.

articleTitle: A novel multi-channel weighted convolutional neural network for fault identification of high-voltage circuit breakers
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: To solve the problem that single-channel vibration signal input cannot fully express fault feature information and early diagnosis of high-voltage circuit breaker (HVCB) faults, a multi-channel weighted convolutional neural network (MCW-CNN) is proposed and applied to HVCB vibration signal characteristic learning and fault diagnosis. Firstly, wavelet transform is used to extract the time-frequency features of the vibration signal. The vibration signal is converted into multi-channel image input, so as to give full play to the excellent performance of CNN in image feature extraction. Secondly, according to the difference in image frequency and bandwidth of each channel, the dynamic receptive field is used in the convolution layer to extract image features. Aiming at the difference in the intensity of shock features carried by each channel image, a multi-channel fusion method based on kurtosis weighting is proposed to enhance the channel fault features with strong shock features. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by fault diagnosis test of HVCB. Through the fault simulation experiment, the results verify that the MCW-CNN can effectively extract the fault features of the vibration signal, and the recognition accuracy is significantly higher than that of the traditional method.

articleTitle: Influence of instantaneous heavy rain on outdoor insulation of AC and DC stations and the preventive solution
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Under instantaneous heavy rain, external flashover sometimes happens on vertical bushings of power equipment, both at DC and AC outdoor stations, leading to insulation failure of power transmission and transformation. In this paper, we investigated the flashover accidents caused by instantaneous heavy rainfall and summarized the common characteristics of this kind of failure in operation. We also performed heavy rainfall flashover tests, by up-and-down method, on insulators adopted in substations and converter stations of different surface material/hydrophobicity. It was found that surface hydrophobicity had little influence on flashover voltage under heavy rain. On the other hand, the influence of water-cut sheds on rain flashover voltage was researched. The flashover characteristics under various configurations of water-cut sheds were obtained, which showed that the water-cut shed had a great effect on enhancing the flashover voltage under heavy rainfall. It was found that the mechanism of heavy rain flashover was mainly decided by the shape of rainfall, which was different from pollution flashover. In conclusion, the only effective solution to prevent rain flashover in AC and DC stations is the adoption of the water-cut sheds, which should be considered by the maintenance in AC and DC station operation.

articleTitle: The fault of distribution network based on genetic algorithm optimized BP neural network
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to better protect the stable operation of distribution ring network and accurately find the fault zone, this paper proposes a method to locate the fault zone of distribution ring network by optimizing BP neural network through genetic algorithm according to the characteristics of voltage, current and phase angle changes when the fault occurs. The method comprises that following steps: firstly, establishing a transition resistance estimation model of BP neural network optimized based on genetic algorithm; Secondly, through the combination of particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and transition resistance estimation model, the transition resistance step is optimized to get the optimal value, and the fault simulation is carried out to establish a fault feature database. Then, the estimated value of transition resistance is obtained according to the fault information through the BP neural network model. Finally, the fault zone estimation model of BP neural network optimized based on genetic algorithm is used to determine the fault zone. A large number of simulations show that this method is suitable for distribution ring network and has a good fault location effect.

articleTitle: Research and application of ice melting power supply for OPGW
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In recent years, the ice melting techniques for power transmission line has been making great achievements in China, but none of them can be applied to the deicing of OPGW (optical fiber composite overhead ground wire). OPGW contains communication optical fiber, which has special structure and high requirements for ice melting temperature. At present, deicing technologies can not be directly applied to the deicing of OPGW, and icing of OPGW becomes a technical challenge. Based on the DC ice melting technology and considering the characteristics of OPGW line, this paper develops an adjustable voltage DC ice melting power supply to meet the needs of OPGW ice melting. The fuzzy PID control method of DC ice melting device is simulated and the prototype is trial manufactured successfully. A promising ice melting performance is obtained through the field engineering test.

articleTitle: Steady-state distribution characteristics of moisture in oil-pressboard insulation for converter transformer
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The converter transformer is the core equipment of the UHVDC transmission project. Oil-pressboard insulation is the main form of transformer insulation. Moisture is a key factor affecting the performance of oil-pressboard insulation. At present, Oommen_'s curve is mainly used to calculate the moisture content of pressboard according to oil-pressboard moisture equilibrium curve and the moisture content of oil. Whether Oommen_'s curve is suitable for oil-pressboard insulation of converter transformer becomes a problem. KI50X-Weidmann insulation combination is selected as the research object. It can be found through experiments, the use of Oommen_'s curve to evaluate the moisture content of oil-pressboard insulation used in converter transformer will cause a large error. In response to this problem, this paper carried out an experimental study and the main work and main conclusions are as follows: Aiming at the combination of KI50X transformer oil-Weidmann pressboard, moisture equilibrium characteristics were obtained through experiments. The moisture equilibrium curve and moisture equilibrium relationship of KI50X-Weidmann oil-pressboard insulation system at 30°C, 60°C, 70°C and 85°C is obtained. This paper analyses the reasons for the difference between the measured value and estimated value, and puts forward the correction method. Oil-pressboard moisture equilibrium curve of is close to Oommen_'s curve and no correction is needed at 60°C and 70°C. At 30°C, the moisture content of pressboard needs to be corrected by 21.95% upward. The water saturation solubility KI50X insulating oil is 100.81mg/kg lower than that of the oil used by Oommen at 70°C, which verifies the influence of insulating material properties on the steady-state characteristics of moisture distribution.

articleTitle: Parameter adaptive control of virtual DC machine based DC microgrid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to suppress the fluctuation of the bus voltage in a DC microgrid, the virtual DC machine technology can be applied to the DC converter. However, it is difficult for the conventional control method of virtual DC machine to ensure good dynamic performance, since its parameters usually keep constant. To settle such problem, this paper proposes a parameter-adaptive virtual DC machine control strategy. Firstly, the small signal model of a typical buck converter with virtual DC machine control is established. Based on the proposed model, the bode diagrams of the system are drawn. Secondly, the effects of the inertia and damping coefficients of the virtual DC machine on the DC bus are analyzed in detail.The adaptive control of virtual DC machine parameters is then proposed, giving the principles of adaptive adjustment of inertia and damping coefficients. Finally, simulations are carried out to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comparative study on electrical and mechanical properties of UHV GIL post insulators
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Post insulator is one of the key electrical components of DC GIL, which supports the central conductor and electrical insulation. The design of a safe, stable and reliable post insulator structure is related to the overall safety of the transmission system. In order to optimize the electrical and mechanical properties of single post insulator in UHVDC GIS, based on the finite element calculation method, a three-dimensional finite element simulation model of post insulator is established, and the electrical and mechanical properties of three kinds of post insulators with different structures are verified. The results show that the distribution of electric field and stress field on the surface of post insulator low-voltage end insert is relatively concentrated, and the maximum value of electric field and stress field of insulator appears at the gap of umbrella skirt; During the structural design, the surface of low-voltage end insert and the structure of insulator shed should be paid more attention.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of silicone rubber cleaning and repairing agent and its application in maintenance of composite external insulation equipment
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Due to the arid and rainless environment in northern China and the adsorption of pollution by DC electric field, the surface of EHV/UHV composite bushing and post insulator coated with RTV is seriously polluted and the hydrophobicity is lost, which brings risks to the operation of power grid. Conventional decontamination methods such as high-pressure water flushing and manual wiping can only remove the floating ash on the insulator surface, and the hydrophobicity is damaged after decontamination. In this paper, a special silicone rubber cleaning and repairing agent for composite insulation is developed, but there is a lack of testing standards and methods, which brings concerns to the application. This paper discusses the test methods of silicone rubber cleaning and repairing agent, and the test results are analyzed. The research shows that the cleaning agent has good insulation, pH is neutral, does not support combustion, the residue after volatilization does not reduce the insulation strength of silicone rubber surface, the desalination rate and cleaning rate exceed 80%, and the hydrophobicity of insulator can be restored to HC1 after decontamination. It has a good application prospect in pollution removal and hydrophobic repair for composite external insulation equipment.

articleTitle: Database construction of insulator impulse test and prediction of flashover voltage based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The lightning impulse flashover characteristics of insulators are the basis of lightning protection analysis methods and external insulation design of transmission lines. The parameters such as the leader propagation model, the U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</sub>, and flashover path are quite different. When the mechanism of long-gap discharge is not clear, it is difficult to obtain a universal insulator impulse flashover model. Therefore, this paper firstly analyses a large number of test data under lightning impulse voltage of insulators and air gaps, including different voltage levels, impulse waveforms, meteorological conditions, insulator materials and structures and other working conditions, and analyse structure of the data. Then, we build a database of insulator impulse flashover tests including all test conditions. Finally, machine learning and prediction are carried out for the flashover voltage of composite insulators with different voltage levels, a learning model is proposed, and it is verified that the learning error can be controlled within 4%. The research results provide a shared data platform and research ideas for the study of lightning impulse flashover characteristics and models of insulators under different conditions. It is expected to improve the accuracy of insulator lightning impulse flashover criteria on the basis of reducing lots of repetitive tests.

articleTitle: Physical modeling and simulation analysis of dynamic characteristics of pin power diode
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The physical description of the dynamic characteristics of power electronic devices is particularly important for the analysis of the dynamic characteristics of power electronic devices based on the new power system. Firstly, the physical model of pin high-power diode is established to analyze the changes of current and voltage when the power diode is turned on and off. Then, the dynamic simulation model of the power diode is built based on Simulink. The characteristic of the model is that the resistance diode inductance circuit (RDL circuit) is used to simulate the transient current in the process of on and off, and the physical process is explained. The first mock exam of the universal ZP1000A type PIN power diode is carried out on this model platform, which proves the main performance of di/dt and dv/dt of power electronic devices and the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Power loss comparison of IGBT based H7-CSI and H6-CSI
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: H7 current source inverter (H7-CSI) has drawn attention from scholars in recent years due to its flexible switching capability and low common-mode advantages, but its power loss issue has not been fully analyzed. This paper investigates the power loss of insulated gate bipolar transistor-based three-phase H7-CSI and discusses the differences in modulation operation as well as the switching loss characteristics between H7-CSI and conventional three-phase H6 current source inverter (H6-CSI). On this basis, a switching loss measurement model was proposed to evaluate the power loss of H7-CSI, which is also compared to the H6-CSI. The results show that the H7-CSI has a superior efficiency performance than the conventional H6-CSI topology over the complete operating range, which confirms the H7-CSI to be a more cost-efficient solution for the current source inverter applications.

articleTitle: Approach of breaker topology error identification based on power station
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the identification of the breaker topology errors in power plant and substation, a fast optimization approach of the breaker topology error identification based on generalized state estimation is proposed. Firstly, all physical nodes' voltage are considered as state variables. Then, according to the voltage state variables on both end of closed breakers in the power system, the constraint matrix is built. The voltage state variables are divided into independent variables and dependent variables; The optimal value of independent variables are obtained by iterative method according to the least square method. And then the value of the dependent variable is estimated from the estimated value of the independent variable; According to the voltage state of each physical node in the system, the augmented Jacobian matrix, analog residual and Lagrange multiplier can be calculated; As a result, bad analog data and breaker topology error would be find by the standardized multiplier and standardized residual. Finally, a 110kV substation in Shandong Province is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the model and method.

articleTitle: Research on soft start strategy of converters applied in photovoltaic power generation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that LLC resonant converter in photovoltaic power generation system generates overshoot current during startup , this paper proposes an improved soft-start control strategy based on the characteristics of traditional phase-shift soft-start and frequency-reduced soft-start control strategies. The control strategy reduces the overshoot current in the resonant cavity during start-up, shortens the time required for soft-start, and the output voltage rises smoothly to a stable voltage. Firstly, the frequency reduction soft-start and phase-shift soft-start are analyzed in detail, and then the traditional phase-shift soft-start is optimized. Through the analysis of the relationship between the output voltage gain and the duty cycle, a new expression of the duty cycle with time is proposed Mode. When the frequency converter starts, the optimized phase shift control and frequency reduction control are used at the same time. Finally, through the smulink simulation platform, a 100W full-bridge LLC resonant converter is built to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the control method.

articleTitle: Bidirectional load modelling method for ten thousand nodes power grid EMT simulation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: After the distributed generation connecting distribution network, the load presents a bidirectional power characteristic. For the large-scale power grid EMT simulation, an accurate load model is the premise of correctly simulating the response of the AC/DC system to the fault. Bidirectional loads are characterized as voltage and frequency dependent power sources that cannot be directly incorporated into EMT computing networks. This paper proposes a bidirectional load modelling method for 10,000-node power grid EMT simulation. The bidirectional load is connected to the power grid through a proposed innovative interface method which realizes the conversion of bidirectional power load into instantaneous current. The proposed bidirectional load modelling method is applied to the EMT transient program of ADPSS, and the correctness and effectiveness of the bidirectional load modelling method are verified by comparing the field and simulation waveforms for the small-scale power grid and the large-scale regional power grid EMT simulation. The comparison results show that the proposed method has high simulation accuracy and can satisfy the EMT simulation requirements of the 10,000-node grid with large-scale bidirectional load.

articleTitle: Study on fracture cause of porcelain insulator of 220KV transmission line
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Porcelain insulators are widely used in EHV and UHV lines because of their excellent mechanical properties. Recently, the porcelain insulator of a 220kV transmission line tension tower in Shandong Province broke, which directly affected the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In order to analyse the fracture cause of porcelain insulator, the insulation resistance test, electromechanical damage composite test, morphology analysis and metallographic structure analysis of faulty string insulator and adjacent string insulator are carried out in this paper. The results show that the insulation resistance and electromechanical failure load test of porcelain insulator meet the standard requirements, and the electrical performance is normal. The fracture of porcelain insulator is mainly caused by the damage of iron cap. The raw material of broken porcelain insulator iron cap is gray cast iron, and its mechanical properties are far lower than those of nodular cast iron or malleable cast iron required by the standard, which is easy to be damaged in the process of stress; At the same time, there are casting defects in the iron cap of the broken porcelain insulator, and there are micro cracks before hot galvanizing. With the stress of the insulator string during operation, the cracks gradually expand, which eventually leads to the fracture failure of the iron cap and the broken string. The relevant research process can provide reference for the quality control of porcelain insulator fittings.

articleTitle: Research on a new space vector modulation strategy of the improved quasi-Z source four- leg matrix converter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to overcome the low voltage utilization of matrix converter, a new quasi-Z source network is introduced into matrix converter (QZS-4LMC), and a new improved dual space vector modulation strategy is proposed. Firstly, the improved QZS-4LMC topology and its working principle are analyzed. On this basis, a dual-space vector modulation strategy based on the action time allocation of shoot-through zero vector is proposed. Then, a detailed simulation is carried out on the Matlab/Simulink simulation platform, and a TMS320F28335 prototype controlled by FPGA and DSP is designed for preliminary experimental verification. Compared with the traditional quasi-Z source three-phase four-bridge matrix converter, the feasibility and superiority of the improved quasi-Z source topology and control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Heat dissipation improvement and experimental verification of converter transformer valve side bushing based on water cooling technology
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: As the key equipment of the converter station, the UHV converter transformer valve side bushing simultaneously carries the high voltage and large current of the whole electric system during operation. With the gradual increase in the transmission capacity of Chinese power grid, the current carrying capacity of the bushing is also increasing, and the heating problem of the bushing is getting more and more serious. If the bushing runs at high temperature for a long time, it will accelerate the aging of components such as epoxy core and electrical contacts, which will affect the service life of the bushing. In this paper, according the thermal effect of the bushing's conductor, the heat dissipation ability of bushing is optimized. A design of using forced water cooling to dissipate heat from conductor is proposed. The effects of current amplitude on the thermal field distribution both of the traditional and water-cooled bushing were studied by 3D electromagnetic-heat-flow coupling method. The rationality and effectiveness of the optimal design were verified by the temperature rise test, which provides a solution for reducing the thermal effect of the bushing.

articleTitle: Power surplus mechanism and fault ride through strategies of the hybrid cascaded UHVDC system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Hybrid cascaded dc technique has the advantages of long-distance and large capability transmission of the line commutated converter(LCC) based HVDC, and also the advantages of supplying multiple receiving ends, flexible operation and good system supporting ability of the voltage source converter (VSC) based HVDC. It is a good solution for the efficient use of large scale clean energy and the construction of energy internet. Chinese Baihetan-jiangsu UHVDC project is the first hybrid cascaded UHVDC (HS-UHVDC) project in the world. Power Surplus is a serious problem for the HS-UHVDC, which can cause overvoltage of the VSCs, making the system fail to ride-through the ac faults. This paper reveals the power surplus mechanisms of the HS-UHVDC system. Two energy dissipation devices, that is the controllable arrester scheme and the thyristors &blocking diodes are proposed and compared in detail. Then the ac fault ride-through control strategies and the parameter design method of the energy dissipation devices are proposed. It is shown that with the proposed energy dissipation method, the VSC overvoltage can be suppressed and the ac ride-through can be realized, thus solving the power surplus problemofHS-UHVDC effectively.

articleTitle: A novel topology to improve commutation failure immunity of HVDC based semi-controlled lc oscillator submodule
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the continuous increase of the commutation capacity of the DC project, the commutation failure has more severe impact on the transmission of active and reactive power, which seriously threatens the safe and stable operation of the power grid. A novel topology is proposed to improve the commutation failure immunity of LCC-HVDC (Line-Commutated-Converter High Voltage Direct Current). With semi-controlled LC oscillator sub-modules paralleled at both ends of the valve arm, the topology can not only increase the commutation voltage, but also can make the valve arm thyristor current zero-crossing early to turn off, thereby speeding up the commutation. Firstly, the topology and operating principle of sub-module are introduced. Additionally, the inductance and capacitance parameters in the sub-module are designed. Finally, the simulation results show that LCC-HVDC with semi-controlled LC oscillator sub-modules can be immune to commutation failure to a great extent. Compared with the solution of connecting the H-bridge sub-modules in series in the valve arm, the topology is more capable of resisting commutation failure under the unit converter capital cost.

articleTitle: Influence of breaking current and arc energy on SF6 decomposition products under arcing conditions in high voltage switchgear
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> is widely used in high voltage switchgear due to its excellent insulation and arc extinguishing performance. It is an important method for fault diagnosis and electrical life assessment of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> switchgear to detect and analyze gas decomposition products. Breaking current and arc energy have a significant effect on the species and concentrations of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products so relevant studies were carried out. A test platform for SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products of switchgear under arc discharge was built and a series of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition tests with breaking current of 0.8kA, 5kA, and 31.5kA were carried out on a 40.5kV SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> circuit breaker. The decomposition components were detected by a gas chromatography. It has been found that the larger breaking current is, the more species of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products are. When breaking current remains constant, the higher accumulated arc energy is, the higher concentrations of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products are. After 31.5kA breaking test, the order of the generation amount of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products is SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>>CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>>>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>>CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>>>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The influence of breaking current and arc energy on SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition products is clarified, which is important for the fault diagnosis and electrical life assessment of high-voltage SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> switchgear based on decomposition products analysis.

articleTitle: Reactive power compensation optimization of high voltage transmission network based on artificial bee colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to reduce the network loss and operating cost of the transmission network, an optimization method for reactive power compensation of the high-voltage transmission network based on the artificial bee colony algorithm is proposed. The optimal model of reactive power compensation for transmission network is established by calculating the power flow to determine the state of power network. After the artificial bee colony algorithm is improved by the general learning strategy, the reactive power compensation optimization scheme is obtained by solving the model with the algorithm. In the simulation experiment, the global optimization speed of the improved artificial bee colony algorithm is improved, and the loss of the electric network is reduced by about 53.07% after the application of the compensation optimization method.

articleTitle: Dynamic fault reconfiguration of multiport active bridge converter for reliable bipolar DC system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: A dynamic fault reconfiguration method is proposed for dual-transformer series-connected active bridge converter with interconnected dc bus and integrated energy storage devices applied in shipboard bipolar DC system. The proposed converter can achieve both short-circuit fault-clearing at the source port and the load ports, thus effectively improving its reliability under complicated conditions. If short-circuit occurs on one of the output terminals connected with bipolar dc bus, the proposed fault reconfiguration method will enable the faulty terminal to be isolated to maintain the constant power transmission between storage devices and healthy terminal under monopolar mode. While if short-circuit occurs on input terminal connected with storage devices, the proposed fault reconfiguration method will ensure the supported power feasibly exchanges between two terminals connected the bipolar dc bus under the source-port fault mode so as to maintain the constant output power of certain terminals. Based on all of the operation modes, power transmission model and zero voltage switch (ZVS) operation boundaries of all switches are analysed for circuit parameters design. Besides, the control strategies under bipolar mode, monopolar mode and source-port fault mode are analysed respectfully according to the dynamic characteristics. Finally, performance of the proposed fault reconfiguration method has been tested in Matlab/PLECS environment, in verification of the converter reliability and flexibility.

articleTitle: Virtual power balance control method for DAB converters in power electronic transformer
