publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Aimed at the power electronic transformers (PETs) including the dual-active-bridge (DAB) converter, an integrated practical solution is discussed for realizing the unit power factor, power balance in each cell, and efficiency improvement simultaneously. Meanwhile, the virtual power component and the dynamic power component are introduced to realize the dc-link and transferring power balance, and a multi-module power balance method based on triple phaseshift (TPS) is proposed for the DAB converter to achieve excellent performance. In addition, the mechanism for output voltage fast adjustment in the voltage or load disturbance cases is analyzed in detail. Finally, the experimental results are developed in the three-cell PET experimental prototype, and the performance of the integrated practical solution is verified.

articleTitle: Single-pole break fault characteristic analysis for ring flexible DC distribution grids
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Positive and negative voltages/currents may present long-term unbalance after single-pole breakage faults in ring flexible DC distribution networks, which endangers the safe and stable operation of the system, whereas little research on it has been implemented. Therefore, characteristics of the single-pole breakage fault are studied. First, by establishing the equivalent model of the system before and after the fault, the voltage and current characteristics of the single-pole breakage fault on the DC line, the tie line between the sending-end converter and the DC bus, and that between the receiving-end converter and the DC bus were analyzed. Then, the influence of system grounding mode on the characteristics of the single-pole breakage fault was discussed. In addition, the impact of sudden load change on the fault characteristics was studied. Finally, the model of a ring flexible DC distribution system was built in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: New low loss 4.5 kV 1800 a IGBT4 module and its system benefits in PTD applications
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The paper introduces the latest development of a new IHV B 4.5 kV trench field-stop IGBT and emitter-controlled diode, which have been specially designed for the field of power transmission and distribution (PTD). As widely known, this area of application is highly sensitive in terms of electrical efficiency, i.e., the reduction of converter losses. Besides considering the chip structure of the IGBTs and diodes, the authors present a new approach for lowering conduction losses by raising the gate voltage. They investigate the impact on the lifetime and reliability of the dielectrics exposed to higher stress. The resulting performance improvements are quantified at the module level, but also at the system level, determining the benefits of a typical 320 kV / 1 GW transmission system with and without increased gate voltage.

articleTitle: A multi-port hybrid DC circuit breaker based on controllable active oscillation circuit
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The hybrid DC circuit breaker (HDCB) is widely regarded as one of the most promising solutions to solve fault current interruptions of VSC-based DC grids. However, a large number of power electronic modules connected in series in the transfer branch lead to considerable cost of the conventional two-port HDCB. In order to effectively solve this problem, a multiport hybrid DC circuit breaker based on controllable active oscillation circuit (CAOC-MPHDCB) is proposed in this paper. By sharing the expensive transfer branch, the proposed CAOC-MPHDCB can effectively reduce the construction cost. In addition, the main branches are only composed of an ultra-fast mechanical switch, and the CAOC can utilize a pre-charged voltage with low amplitude to generate a negative voltage with high amplitude on the transfer branch to assist with the current commutation. Under this design, the proposed CAOC-MPHDCB has the advantages of low operation loss, low voltage level of pre-charged system and high reliability. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed CAOC-MPHDCB is verified based on PSCAD/EMTDC simulations.

articleTitle: Active power control optimization strategy of photovoltaic assisted frequency modulation considering LVRT
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Voltage and frequency problems may occur at the same time under large disturbance faults, with the large-scale new energy connected to the power grid. The fault ride through control strategy of photovoltaic inverter gives priority to reactive power during low voltage period, so there is a lack of active power control. An optimal control strategy of photovoltaic reactive power priority and auxiliary frequency modulation is proposed for LVRT control, aiming at the frequency stability of weak current network caused by excessive active power imbalance during LVRT. By sampling the frequency deviation signal of the system as the input signal, it realizes the adjustment of active power control parameters during LVRT, and carries out system auxiliary frequency modulation, including frequency difference discrimination link, parameter selector and parameter switching control. Finally, this paper concludes that the active power optimization control strategy of LVRT control can improve the frequency stability of the system significantly during low-voltage period by simulation, which is on the premise of ensuring the low-voltage reactive power support.

articleTitle: Continuous regulation strategy of DC voltage for full-bridge modular multilevel converter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The continuous regulation of a wide-range dc voltage is an emerging requirement for the modular multilevel converter (MMC) extended to the medium-voltage direct current (MVDC) distribution network. Under this requirement, a full-bridge MMC (FB-MMC) is an attractive medium-voltage converter solution due to the full-bridge sub-module (SM) can output the negative voltage. However, the FB-MMC applied to the MVDC power distribution network cannot achieve a wide-range continuous regulation of dc voltage due to the limited number of SMs and the coupling relationship between the capacitor voltage and the DC voltage of the conventional control strategy. Therefore, a novel control strategy is proposed for the medium-voltage FBMMC in this paper to ensure that the capacitor voltage of SMs is constant when the dc voltage is continuously regulated in a wide range. Simulation results based on Matlab/Simulink validate the correctness and effectiveness of the presented strategy.

articleTitle: Energy control technology for MMC during fault ride through
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Integrating the energy dissipation unit inside the converter is a cost-effective solution for fault ride-through of surplus power in offshore wind power systems. To address the problem of low accuracy of the existing self-consuming converter control strategy, an energy dissipation unit control strategy based on DC voltage hysteresis control and step throwing is proposed to achieve accurate control of the dissipated power during fault ride-through, and to control the DC bus voltage and sub-module capacitance voltage to fluctuate within the allowable range. Simulation results show that the proposed self-consuming converter control strategy can effectively achieve fault ride-through under different fault strength conditions, and the capacitor voltage ripple is reduced by more than 20% when using the optimized control strategy than the basic control strategy.

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of key technologies for frequency modulation parameter optimization of large-scale centralized access to renewable energy power generation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: By 2021, the installed capacity of northwest of china renewable energy is 127.69 million kw, including 68.61 million kw of wind power and 59.08 million kw of photovoltaic power. After large-scale renewable energy clusters are connected to the power grid, the whole power grid presents high power electronic characteristics, the problem of power system stability is prominent, and the safe and stable operation of the power grid is facing great challenges. Facing the increasing shortage of traditional frequency modulation resources and the rapid development trend of renewable energy in the network, it is urgent to carry out the work of using the active power regulation ability of wind power and photovoltaic to participate in system frequency modulation. From the perspective of power grid operation demand, this paper puts forward the optimization scheme of primary frequency regulation control parameters of renewable energy power generation. The cluster simulation modeling technology based on different types of inverters and the extraction and optimization technology of key parameters improve the active support ability of renewable energy and new energy. Through the application in practical equipment, power station and power grid, good results have been achieved. The research results have good popularization and application value for improving the frequency stability of regional power grid.

articleTitle: Study on transient recovery voltage characteristics of on-load tap charger during switching process
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The frequent voltage regulation operation of on-load tap charger (OLTC) for HVDC converter transformer leads to higher requirement for reliability during switching. At present, the converter transformer adopts two kinds of OLTC in practical project: oil immersed OLTC and oil immersed vacuum OLTC. The Transient recovery voltage (TRV) generated in the switching process of transition contact may cause equipment breakdown and damage. According to the action characteristics of OLTC and dual equivalent circuit of transformer under transient operation, the electromagnetic transient model of the combination of transformer and tap changer is established. The TRV characteristics during OLTC normal operation and HVDC short-circuit fault are analyzed. In addition, the transient overvoltage level during transition contact switching with current chopping or restriking is considered. The variation law of TRV peak value and rise rate is summarized, which provides technical support for equipment design and selection.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of three-winding planar transformer for three-port high-frequency resonant converter
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: To improve the power density of three-port high-frequency resonant converter using wide bandgap devices, a three-winding planar transformer is proposed. By analysing the topology and working conditions of the converter, the design requirements for the three-winding transformer are clarified. Based on the equivalent circuit of the three-winding transformer, the magnetizing inductance of transformer is directly and accurately controlled by the air gap of the core. The factors affecting the accuracy of air gap reluctance and transformer loss are analysed and some improved schemes are proposed. According to the optimized design process of the transformer, the method of selecting the optimal core size is given.

articleTitle: Design of polar coordinate vector current control strategy for VSC connected to weak power grid
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of subsynchronous oscillation when voltage source converter is connected to weak power grid, according to the design steps of the modern control theory based on the state space method, this paper designed a control strategy of the converter, which can effectively improve the stability of the weak synchronous system. Modern control theory takes into account all independent state variables from input to output, thus it can connect the internal state of the system with the external input and output effectively.The paper constructed the state equation of weakly synchronous AC system in static coordinate system, and then the polar coordinate representation of the system state equation is obtained by using complex transformation and Euler equation. The vector current control object of VSC is the vector current injected into the weak AC power grid. By adjusting the injection current of the weak AC power network in the amplitude direction and phase direction of the polar coordinates, the stability control of the VSC connected to the weak AC power grid is realized. Finally, the effectiveness and stability of the designed control strategy are verified by electromagnetic transient numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Behaviour level simulation of DC-DC power module and application in satellite power supply and distribution system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In this paper, a behaviour-level modelling method based on external characteristic parameter extraction is proposed. For the problems of low solution efficiency and poor convergence of the physical model of DC-DC power module in switching mode in the simulation of aerospace power supply and distribution system, this method equates the DC-DC power module as a "black box" model, which describes the external functional performance characteristics rather than the internal composition structure and principle. While maintaining the system level simulation accuracy, the simulation efficiency is greatly improved, and the problem of poor convergence caused by multiple time scales is avoided. The simulation results show that this method can effectively solve the problems of low precision, low efficiency and poor convergence of traditional system level simulation and has obvious advantages over traditional schemes.

articleTitle: Long-term DC voltage test method of HVDC wall bushing with resin impregnated paper capacitor core considering electro-thermal coupling coefficient
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: HVDC wall bushing connects the valve hall and the DC field in the converter station, which is the core equipment in HVDC transmission system. The resin impregnated paper capacitor core inside the bushing withstands long-term full DC voltage and full load DC current during operation. Thus, 2 hours long-term DC voltage test and temperature rise test are required to verify its insulation and thermal performance. However, internal discharge faults caused by overheating of current carrying structure still occur frequently in recent years, which means the insulation and thermal defects of the bushing under long-term electrothermal coupling stress can not be completely inspected only IEC standard test. In this paper, the influence of temperature on internal partial discharge measurement and electrical field calculation of resin impregnated paper capacitor core of HVDC bushing are carried out, and the electro-thermal coupling coefficient is given. Finally, a new long-term DC voltage test method during manufacturing process is proposed. This new method has important theoretical significance and engineering application value for internal defect evaluation, discharge or thermal fault diagnosis, as well as estimation of the reliability of both insulation and thermal performance in the life cycle of bushing.

articleTitle: An improved phasor estimation method based on matrix pencil and weighted least square
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved phasor estimation method based on matrix pencil and weighted least square to enhance the estimation accuracy during transients such as faults. First, the frequency components contained in the fault signal are approximately estimated by matrix pencil method. Afterwards, the primary frequency components are determined to construct the fault signal model according to the magnitude of reference factor. Finally, the unknowns within the fault signal are solved utilizing the weighted least square algorithm to obtain the phasors. Numerical experiments validate that the proposed method presents higher accuracy of phasor estimation compared to the existing phasor estimation methods, even with measurement noises. Moreover, the proposed method requires only a portion of a cycle to accurately calculate fundamental frequency phasors, and works with a relatively low sampling rate of 4k samples/sec.

articleTitle: A simplified plasma model to calculate leader discharge channel temperature
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Leader inception and development are essential physical processes in long air gap discharge, while the discharge characteristics are not well understood. Here, we present experimental observation and simulation results under 10 m long air gap discharge. In order to capture the favorable conditions for leader discharge, a simplified 0-dimensional plasma model is used to simulate the leader discharge channel. The evolution characteristics of the electric field, temperature, plasma density and the resulting nonlinear resistance of the discharge channel are obtained. This model has higher computational efficiency and has been verified to reproduce the streamer-to-leader transition process. Based on the measured current data of 10-m air gap as the input of the model, simulation results show that the temperature of streamer stem within the dark period may be above 2000 K. The channel temperature is relatively stable in the process of leader development, which is maintained at about 4500 K.

articleTitle: The hidden dangers analysis of the control logic on HSGS switch in Guizhong station
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Restricted by the Earthing electrode current, the metal return becomes the most commonly connection in converter stations after unipolar blockade or unipolar outage. Therefore, it is very important for the safety and stability of the whole HVDC system whether the switching operation between single-pole ground return and single-pole metal return is safe and stable. Combined with the interlock logic of HSGS switch (high speed grounding switch) in Guizhong Station and the simulation operation, this paper analyzes the operation sequence of metal return, and points out the interlocking logic provided by the DC station control system can not prevent the risk of DC unipole locking caused by human misoperation under specific conditions. In addition, according to the current topological relationship in the operation of metal return, this paper presents a scientific modification plan with electric quantity interlocking, which can prevent the operators from misoperation and provides reference for the interlocking logic to other HVDC transmission system.

articleTitle: Resistivity of silicone gel/ceramic substrate interface in power modules
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The high electric field stress at the triple points (silicone gel, ceramic substrate, and copper) posts a big challenge to development for high-voltage power modules. However, the resistivity of silicone gel/ceramic substrate interface, which is vital to electric field at triple points, is neglected. Therefore, this paper established an interface resistivity calculation model for interface resistance measured by four-electrode method. It was found that the silicone gel/ceramic interface resistance is different to surface resistance of bulk phase for over 2 order magnitude. Through the 430 nm gold layer, the interface resistivity was calculated as 108Ω·m approximately, which is lower than that of bulk phase for 4-5 order of magnitude. This is because that the molecule chains in interface region are easier to move and with higher relaxation frequency compared to bulk phase. The decrease in interface resistivity will increase the electric stress in silicone gel and ceramic bulk phase, which should be arouse great attention in evaluation of design for high-voltage power modules.

articleTitle: Multi-tone Morlet wavelet-based high-frequency resonance parameter estimation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Accurate estimations of high-frequency resonance (HFR) parameters are useful in HFR mitigation, early warning, and status monitoring. This paper proposes a novel multi-tone Morlet wavelet (MTMW) that consists of multiple Morlet wavelets (MWs) with different center frequencies and can be truncated for HFR parameter estimation. The MTMW parameters, i.e., scale factor and center frequency combination, are optimally selected for HFR parameter estimation. Simulation test results indicate that the proposed MTMW-based estimator has higher accuracy than the MW-based estimator and the interpolated discrete Fourier transform. The response times of the MTMW-based estimator for HFR phasor estimation are always shorter than 30 ms.

articleTitle: Flashover characteristics of contaminated post insulators covered with snow
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The conductivity of contaminated insulator surface increases during snow melting, which is easy to lead to pollution flashover. In this paper, the effects of equal salt deposit density (ESDD) and snow height on the surface flashover voltage of porcelain post insulators are studied, and the snow flashover process is simulated by glass plate. The test results show that the flashover voltage of snow-covered insulator decreases with the increase of ESDD. The relationship between the flashover voltage and the ESDD is a negative power exponential function. When the conductivity of cooling water used for snow making is very low, the thicker the snow on the insulator, the higher the minimum flashover voltage during snow melting. The reason may be that the uneven snow melting leads to the longer flashover path and the large loss of NaCl in the pollution layer with the melting of snow. The simulated snow covering test using the glass plate shows that the arc develops along the glass surface inside the snow layer, and the arc path almost coincides with the melting area of the snow layer.

articleTitle: Reverse Blocking IGCT optimized for medium-voltage solid state current breaker by proton irradiation
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The high conduction loss and bulky cooling systems are two critical limitations of the solid-state circuit breaker (SSCB), which requires the switches used in the breaker to exhibit a low on-state voltage and a low leakage current. In this study, the reverse blocking integrated gate-commutated thyristor (RB-IGCT) is optimized utilizing proton irradiation to moderate these limitations. First of all, the effects of carrier lifetime on leakage current and on-state voltage are analysed, and the fundamental mechanisms vary with the spatial positions of the irradiation defects. Then, the proton irradiation model is established through pre-experiment and SRIM simulation; the effects of irradiation parameters on the RB-IGCT are studied in detail, including dose, energy, and beam energy spread. Proton irradiation can effectively reduce leakage current at a relatively low dose, while the increase in onstate voltage is much smaller than electron irradiation. The best optimization of leakage current and voltage drop occurs when the irradiation region is located between the forward-biased junction of the transistor and the depletion region under rated voltage.

articleTitle: Analysis of AC line single-phase reclosing strategy which connecting with MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The reclosing strategy of AC line which connecting with MMC-HVDC transmission is an issue deserves intensive research. The electromagnetic transient characteristic during AC line reclosing is studied in this paper, with Chongqing-Hubei back to back MMC-HVDC project as an example. The influence of fault ride through control logic of MMC-HVDC line disconnection is analyzed. The analysis results show that after the line disconnection, the positive sequence controller and the negative sequence controller have an interaction effect, which causes the control system to be unstable. The overvoltage the overcurrent may occur when the fault is recovered. Therefore, when single line with MMC-HVDC operates and the break fault occurs, the power transmission of the straight line should be minimized during the fault time, or the reclosing function of the AC line should not be enabled.

articleTitle: Testing application of SPN technology in power communication systems
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: During the period of “The Fourteenth Five-Year Plan”, higher requirements have been put forward for the comprehensive support and guarantee capabilities of the communications profession. Slicing Packet Network technology has the technical characteristics of ultra-broadband, ultra-low latency, flexible slicing and centralized control. This paper proposes to use the new Slicing Packet Network technology to solve the problem of the development of power communication network. In order to verify the adaptability of the Slicing Packet Network technology in the power communication system, the service carrying capacity, protection capacity and slice isolation capacity are tested, focusing on the relay protection service. After fullscenario and full-service testing and comparison, Slicing Packet Network is more in line with the development of power communication network compared with the traditional technical system.

articleTitle: Economic dispatch for interconnected power network considering optimal transmission switching
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The benefits of optimal transmission switching (OTS) have been shown to improve the operation economy of power system by co-dispatch of generators and network topology. In this paper, on the basis of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), an economic dispatch model for interconnected power network is proposed taking OTS into account. Firstly, the whole system is decomposed into a set of decoupled subsystems through the branch tearing method, thus the decentralized parallel OTS can be conducted within each subsystems. Then the decomposition and coordination method based on ADMM is used for optimal computation of the different sub-systems. The proposed method provides an alternative way to solve the economic dispatch problem with OTS of interconnected transmission power network. Numerical analyses on a 14 bus system demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method

articleTitle: A multi-port interline DC power flow controller
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: For high voltage direct current (HVDC) grid, the utilization of DC power flow controller can increase the DC current control freedom. This paper proposes a novel multi-port interline power flow controller (MIPFC) based on capacitive energy transfer mechanism (CET). It is constructed by full-bridge sub-modules (SMs) and thyristor valves. The proposed CET-MIPFC presents desirable characteristics such as low cost, high efficiency and small footprint. Firstly, the n-port CET-MIPFC topology is introduced. Afterwards, taking the three-port CET-MIPFC as an example, the topology structure, operation principle, and parameter design are elaborated. Meanwhile, the corresponding control schemes are deliberated to ensure its line current control and energy balancing. Furthermore, simulations are carried out which confirms the validity of the CETMIPFC.

articleTitle: Comparative study on pollution chatacteristics of post insulator and suspension insulator
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The research on the pollution characteristics of insulators is of great significance to the design, operation and maintenance of polluted external insulation. The pollution characteristics of insulators can be obtained in a short time by using the artificial pollution characteristic test device to carry out the pollution tests of post insulators and suspension insulators in a simulated environment. The results of artificial pollution test show that when the equivalent salt deposit density (ESDD) of insulator surface is less than 0.6mg/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the no soluble deposit density (NSDD) is less than 2.0mg/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the amount of pollution on insulator surface increases with the increase of pollution period. As the wind velocity increases from 1 m/s to 6 m/s, the surface contamination of insulators gradually increases first and then decreases. The pollution accumulation difficulty of post insulators and disc suspension insulators is different at the same wind velocity. When the wind velocity is 2m/s, the pollution degree of post insulator is about twice that of disc suspension insulator. When the wind direction is fixed, the pollution on the leeward side of the insulator is characterized by boundary layer separation.

articleTitle: Study on the evaluation index strategy for the security and stability of receiving power grids integrated with multi-terminal flexible direct-current transmission systems
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the construction and operation of ultra-high-voltage transmission grids, the mixed AC/DC backbone transmission system has been formed in China. Interactions between AC/DC systems on the system stability are increasingly prominent. From current research, it shows that applications of the multi-terminal flexible DC system in the receiving-end power grid is helpful to improve receiving capacities and reduce security risks induced by multi LCC-based DC systems centralized-infeeding. However, evaluation strategies for the security and stability of receiving power grids considering the integration of multi-terminal flexible DC systems are far from perfect. In this paper, operation characteristics of multi-terminal flexible DC transmission systems integrated in the receiving power grid are studied, and the corresponding evaluation index strategy and improvement measures for the safety and stability are proposed. During the “14th Five-Year” planning period, the proposed evaluation strategy and improvement measures are applied and verified in Jiangsu transmission system.

articleTitle: Development of an impedance model identification device for renewable generators
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Recently, with the rapid deployment of renewables such as wind and solar photovoltaic, wide-band oscillations have emerged gradually, which have brought out a serious threat to the stability of the power system. To deal with such oscillation issues, the impedance model method is extensively adopted. However, the existing method for the impedance model identification (IMI) is mainly applied to the electromagnetic transient models of the renewable generators (RGs), which may deviate from the actual operation. In this paper, an IMI device is developed, which can be used to identify the impedance model of the actual RGs. Firstly, the main structure and principle of the developed IMI device are introduced. Then, based on the device, an IMI platform is further constructed. Finally, the impedance model of the direct-drive and double-fed wind turbine generators (WTGs) is obtained based on the developed IMI device and platform, and according to the impedance models, the characteristics of the two types of the WTGs are analysed.

articleTitle: Application of DC switch in intelligent distribution network
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The more and more obvious "multi-source" characteristics of the distribution network make the traditional distribution network development model no longer suitable for the development needs of the distribution network in the new era. At the same time, higher requirements are put forward for the safety and reliability of the power supply of the distribution network. At present, DC switch (including DC circuit breaker, DC load switch, flexible multi-state switch, etc.) has been widely used in flexible DC transmission and distribution system, and its advanced technology and operational reliability have been verified. In the intelligent upgrade of traditional AC distribution network, the application of DC switch and power electronic technology will play an important role in promoting. High design and manufacturing costs of DC switches hinder their application in AC power distribution systems. Aiming at several typical application scenarios, this paper solves the fatal problem of traditional distribution network by optimizing the configuration of DC switchgear, which opens up a new idea for the intelligent transformation of distribution network.

articleTitle: Damping control strategy of MMC-HVDC connecting to the PMSM-based wind farm for subsynchronous resonance suppression
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: It is a typical power electronics based system when flexible high voltage direct current (HVDC) converter station connects to the permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) based wind farm. This system may have the risk of subsynchronous resonance needed to be studied. Firstly, the linear models of modular multilevel converter (MMC) considering the inner dynamics and the grid side voltage source converter (GSVSC) considering the dynamics of phase-locked loop (PLL) are established. Secondly, the participation variables and participation factors are used to identify the key parts affecting the unstable eigenvalues. Thirdly, a damping control strategy simulating the performance of paralleled impedance at the points of common coupling (PCC) is proposed to suppress the subsynchronous resonance. And then, the parameter selecting ranges of damping controller are analytically calculated. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed damping control strategy and the correctness of parameter selection are verified by the electromagnetic transient simulation models

articleTitle: Research on fault-tolerant control strategies of single-phase cascaded H-bridge rectifier
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The cascaded H-bridge rectifier (CHBR) is widely used in high-power fields and has become a research hotspot now. CHBR is usually constrained by the operating environment and should be restored as soon as possible after a fault. However, traditional fault-tolerant strategies have a great loss of power factor on the grid side and a long recovery time. This paper proposed a novel fault-tolerant control strategy. Compared with the traditional strategies, the novel fault-tolerant control strategy has a faster recovery speed after the malfunction, and its transient recovery process has less impact on the power grid. Simulation and experiment results show the effectiveness and good recovery performance of the proposed fault-tolerant control strategy.

articleTitle: A novel on-line IGBT junction temperature estimation method based on the peak value of electromagnetic radiation signal at IGBT turn-off
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Investigation about the junction temperature estimation of IGBT modules is significant in reliability research and design ar-ea. In addition to temperature-dependent electrical parameters and thermal model methods, the non-contact approaches have attracted more attention with the increment of IGBT power level. In this paper, a novel on-line IGBT junction temperature estimation method is proposed based on the peak value of electromagnetic radiation (EMR) signal induced by the fast turn-off collector to emitter current. An EMR near field probe is used to measure the EMR signal and the peak value is proposed as a characteristic to calculate IGBT junction temperature. The principle of junction temperature estimation method based on EMR was studied firstly. Then, a single pulse test platform was established to investigate the relationship between IGBT junction temperature and the EMR peak value. The influence of load current was also investigated. The linear dependence of IGBT junction temperature on the EMR peak value was found and the temperature sensitivity ranged from 0.091mV/°C to 0.375mV/°C with the average Vpeak of 26.8mV and 128.5mV respectively. Thus, the EMR peak value can be regarded as a temperature-dependent characteristic to implement non-contact IGBT junction temperature estimation on line.

articleTitle: A novel contactless current sensor for the two-core cable based on TMR chips
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: In recent years, the introduction and application of magnetic field sensor chips in the field of power system measurement has greatly improved the Contactless current measurement technology based on magnetic field chips. However, the currents of the two conductors of two-core cable are equal and opposite, showing zero magnetic field to the outside, making the traditional method of inverting current based on magnetic field invalid. In this paper, a noncontactless two-core cable current sensor is proposed based on four uniaxial tunnel magneto resistance (TMR) chips. According to the Biot-Savart law, the current of two core cable can be directly deduced by the magnetic induction intensity obtained by the four uniaxial TMR chips. The results show that the assembly angle of the sensor does not affect the results, which brings less constraints to the installation of the sensor. Simulation models and examples were established and analyzed to verify the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed contactless current sensor.

articleTitle: Low frequency oscillation suppression of combined hydropower and wind power generation system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The western and southern regions of China are rich in hydropower. In recent years, with the development of wind power, the joint power generation and long-distance transmission of wind and hydropower has become the new normal. Long-distance transmission systems may have low-frequency oscillation (LFO) problems, and at the same time, affected by the hydropower, there may be ultra-low frequency oscillation (ULFO) problems; and affected by the wind power, there may also be sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) problems. In this case, how to design the oscillation suppressor? There is still a lack of relevant research at home and abroad. This paper firstly designs an LFO controller, and the design goal is to suppress LFO while not deteriorating the oscillation of other frequency bands. Secondly, analysis on amplitude and frequency characteristics of the LFO controller's key links is conducted. Thirdly, the paper constructs a test system for combined wind and hydropower generation system sent to the load center over a long distance, and different mixed proportion scenarios for the combined wind and hydropower generation are considered. Finally, the effect of designed LFO controller is verified by time domain simulations.

articleTitle: Detection algorithm of multi-task transmission line hidden trouble based on shared features
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The hidden trouble of transmission lines is an important cause of transmission line trip or blackouts. It is important to identify the hidden trouble of transmission lines in time and accurately and take necessary measures to ensure the safe operation of the transmission line. There are many kinds of hidden power faults, and the sample distribution is very uneven. The single deep learning model is difficult to guarantee the accuracy of hidden power faults detection. This paper presents a multi task hidden trouble detection algorithm for transmission lines based on shared features. Firstly, the common algorithm of detection of different hidden targets is analyzed, and then it is used as the basic feature extraction network of detection of different hidden targets, at last, multi task target detection is carried out by using different frame regression algorithms, the final detection result of hidden danger can be obtained by combining the detection results of different hidden danger. The proposed algorithm is tested in the test set to test the shared characteristics of the multi task transmission line hidden trouble target detection algorithm

articleTitle: Autonomous global path planning method for substation remote patrol robot
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Current robot path planning methods only consider local obstacle avoidance, and there are conflicts between global planning path and local planning path, resulting in the planned path is not global optimal and the planning efficiency of the method is low. In order to solve the above problems, the autonomous global path planning method of substation remote patrol robot is studied. After establishing the kinematic plane model of the remote patrol robot, the kinematic relation of the robot in space is determined according to the coordinate relation. Artificial potential field is introduced to calculate the initial heuristic information of ant colony algorithm, and the left and right planning path is obtained by bidirectional search. Experimental results show that the average path planning time of the proposed method is 22.92ms, and the number of robot collisions is significantly reduced, which effectively ensures the safety of patrol work.

articleTitle: Fault interaction analysis approach for hybrid AC/DC power grids
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Heretofore, the comprehensive fault analysis approach for AC/DC hybrid grids has not been sufficiently investigated. Inspired by the conventional symmetrical components method, a novel “sequence component network” model based on the mapping relation is proposed to study the characteristics of AC (DC) side after DC-side (AC-side) faults in AC/DC hybrid grids. Subsequently, the AC-side electrical characteristic after DC-side faults was discussed employing the “sequence component network” model. Finally, taking into account the influence of different grounding modes, a DC-type integration system model of PV stations was established in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Control strategy overview and analysis for UHVDC system with parallel converters
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The paper gives an analysis about the control strategy of particular multi-terminal ultra high voltage direct current system with parallel converters based on overview of the reference materials. Main argument focus on the respective control mode for two inverters, i.e. whether one voltage-control while another current-control or both voltage-control. After comparison of the suitability for parallel converters structure with adopting MTDC and UHVDC control method respectively as well as considering the development of HVDC project technology, this paper prefers that both parallel inverters should adopt present UHVDC control but with extra DC current balance function, also called extinction-angle control.

articleTitle: Research on low frequency side short circuit fault of low frequency AC transmission (LFAC) system based on modular multilevel matrix converter (M3C)
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Nowadays, Low frequency AC transmission�iLFAC�jbased on modular multilevel matrix converters� (M3C) has become a practical solution in some power transmission areas such as offshore wind farm integration or increasing AC transmission capacity, etc. This paper proposes a general method to analyse the fault characteristics in low frequency (LF) side(50/3Hz) of M3C-LFAC system. First, the topology for two typical application scenarios of M3C have been introduced. Next, the circuit of the M3C frequency conversion station is mainly studied. M3C can be regarded as MMC with three more middle bridge arms. Then three possible grounding methods of LFAC system: Ygyg, Ygd connection transformer and valve-side star reactor through resistor grounding proposed in symmetric monopolar modular multilevel converters (MMC) are widely discussed. It shows that delta connection will ensure the isolation of zero-sequence components on both side and the low frequency transformer is necessary. Furthermore, this paper proposes that within few of milliseconds (0-15ms), the LF side fault of LFAC is similar to the DC-side fault of MMC based high voltage DC (HVDC) system which indicates that the RLC equivalent fault circuit work for LFAC as well. And during the time to the zero-crossing moment of LF circuit breaker(15-60ms), it can assume that the fault current in this stage is injected by a 50/3Hz voltage source. Finally, a point-to-point M3C-LFAC system as a case is developed in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the theoretical analysis. This paper can provide a reference for the future design of M3C-LFAC system.

articleTitle: A load-carrying capacity development method based on economy and security coordination and optimization
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: Power system operation is constrained by a multitude of factors, and the load-carrying capacity is relatively low. Worse still, the room for improvement is small even if system loads are added to the stability limit. In this sense, a economy and security coordination method is put forward in this paper to improve the load-carrying capacity. Loads that are greater than the limitation of stability limit annual load duration curve are cut as overloads, and load-cutting compensation is given to customers. Besides, customers also get compensations from the reserved loads as outage costs compensation based on EENS index. Both the two compensations make up the economic costs of system security. As long as the growth of economic costs is lower than that of electricity sales, there is still likelihood of the capacity going up. The proposed method is applied into IEEE RTS 79 system, and the result shows that such method is able to improve the load-carrying capacity dramatically, and make the most of transmission capacity.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of distributed photovoltaic operation and maintenance effect based on information entropy fusion model
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: With the widespread attention and research of distributed photovoltaic systems, the operation and maintenance management effect problems of distributed PV stations have become increasingly prominent. To this end, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to comprehensively evaluate the operation and maintenance management effect of the distributed photovoltaic power station is proposed. First, comprehensively considering the technology, benefits, and user evaluation factors of distributed photovoltaic operation and maintenance, a multi-level evaluation index system for evaluating the effectiveness of distributed photovoltaic operation and maintenance management is proposed. Second, the information entropy fusion model is used to determine the index weights, combine the advantages of Analytic Hierarchy Process and CRITICEntropy. Then, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to evaluate the effect of distributed photovoltaic intelligent operation and maintenance services. Finally, the feasibility and practicability of the proposed method are verified by the analysis of an example.

articleTitle: Fast verification of remote backup capability of transmission line phase-tophase distance protection based on impedance matrix
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The loss of secondary dc power in a substation will disable all protections, making them fail to trip when faults occur on power equipments. The remote backup capability of protections deployed in the upstream stations will become a crucial issue for the secure operation of power grids. In this paper, an impedance matrix-based method to efficiently verify the remote backup capability of phase-to-phase distance protection is proposed. The measuring impedance formula of the protection based on the impedance matrix is deduced. An analytical equation is established through combining the formula with the setting value of the protection. The remote backup capability is fast verified according to the characteristics of the equation solutions. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through case studies of a typical 500 kV substation.

articleTitle: Transient dynamic analysis of 550kV high-speed breaking circuit breaker transmission system
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The mechanical properties of the transmission system have a great influence on the operation stability of high-speed breaking circuit breakers. This paper designs a 550kV high-speed breaking circuit breaker drive system, establishes a transient dynamics simulation model of the drive system, and compares and analyzes the contact movement characteristics and the force of each component during normal and high-speed opening processes. The research results show that the moving contact displacement and speed simulation results are highly consistent with the experimental test data, and the maximum error does not exceed 5%; the peak stress of each component of the high-speed circuit breaker transmission mechanism is far greater than that of the normal-speed circuit breaker, and the maximum load occurs in the substation The starting time of the brake; the stress peaks of the components of the transmission mechanism of the constant-speed circuit breaker are within the safety margin, and the maximum stress values of the guide rod joint and the crank arm in the transmission mechanism of the highspeed circuit breaker during the entire opening process are respectively 1003.6MPa and 717.44MPa, exceeding the yield strength of the material itself, there is a risk of damage.

articleTitle: Energy tapping from modular multilevel converters for improvement of frequency events
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The decreasing use of synchronous generators (SGs) by renewable energy sources (RESs) in power systems has led to an increasing vulnerability to frequency excursions. Without the rotating shafts of SGs serving as a reservoir of energy to provide a naturally sufficient inertial response, control systems have been developed and implemented to achieve a similar effect. Other energy reservoirs, such as the inherent energy storage in modular multilevel converters (MMCs), are controlled to help compensate the power imbalances introduced by system perturbations in the grid and improve the inertial response. However, the level of improvement is dependent on the amount of energy available, which is dictated by the MMC and system configurations. In this paper, studies using electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations are conducted on a parametric basis to investigate how such factors impact the effectiveness of controlling the stored energy to improve the inertial response. These include the energy storage capacity of the MMC, the RES penetration level, magnitude of perturbation, and system inertia. The frequency response characteristics monitored are the frequency nadir and duration of the arresting period. Results show that the available energy does not necessarily improve the inertial response or in a linear manner.

articleTitle: Research on reactive power optimization method of distributed wind farm based on harmony search algorithm
publicationTitle: 18th International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2022)
abstract: The large-scale access of distributed generation brings challenges to the operation, control and protection of traditional distribution network. The reactive power coordination optimization problem of wind power connected to distribution network was studied in this paper. A reactive power optimization model considering economy and voltage quality was established, and AHP method was used to select the weight, which overcomes the problem that the multi-objective weight is subjective and difficult to solve. Moreover, harmony search algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm were introduced to solve the model respectively to avoid the shortcomings of traditional algorithm which is easy to fall into local optimum. Finally, the control strategy of distribution network reactive power optimization was obtained. The simulation results show that the proposed optimization model and algorithm can ensure the voltage quality and economic benefits of distribution network nodes under relevant constraints.
